description:
Our apartment is within walking distance of all entertainment venues, touristic and historical buildings, shopping centers and is in a location where you can easily reach anywhere you want. It is possible to easily reach metro, bus, ferry and tram stations.

Taksim Square: 700 meters
Istiklal Avenue: 300 meters
Bus stops: 100 meters
metro station: 700 meters
are located at these distances.

Note: Our apartment is located on the ground floor.
Note: The minibar is extra charge
Note: We collect ID information for system registration.

reviews.text:
I stayed here during my trip to Istanbul and was very happy with my choice!
The place is located right in the heart of Taksim — close to everything: cafes, shops, metro, and main attractions. Despite the central location, it was quiet and peaceful inside.
The room was clean, cozy, and well-equipped: comfortable bed, air conditioning, hot water — everything worked perfectly. The staff were very friendly and helpful.

Looks exactly like pictures very close to taksim square. Nice and clean. Only thing I would say is the night we was there the WiFi was down. Host was very responsive when we explained this to him. Overall very good value for money and very nice room

Overall a nice place, exactly like the pictures show, clean with one small problem that the drain of the shower was clogged mostly, check in was a little late but the host put the effort to make it as early as they can for me. totally worth the price tag.

The apartment is 20 square meters
1 minute to the M7 metro line
6-7 minutes to the M2 metro line

Very close to Florence Nightingale Hospital

description:
Located in Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museums, theaters, concert halls and cinemas, this unit is waiting to welcome its new residents. It is within walking distance to places such as Taksim, Şişli and Nişantaşı.

High speed Wi-Fi available.
Elevator, parking, 24/7 security, reception.
New & High quality furniture.
You can enjoy the city view from your private balcony.
Please kindly check all the photos for details.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text:
My family and i had a wonderful short stay here, everything was as described and we had all amenities and facilities available.
During our 3-4 days we had the smallest glitch of a bulb not working in the bedroom, this was sorted within minutes which was much appreciated as we were traveling with a 2 year old.
The staff were extremely helpful as well and were kind enough to help us with our luggage during check out.
Nothing negative to stay about my experience here, definitely worth the price and would recommend/stay again for future visits, thank you to the entire team for being so accommodating and making our stay pleasurable!

This is a great Airbnb. Clean, quiet, uncluttered, walkable to many places and easy to get a taxi to the rest. The host was the most responsive host we have ever had. She replied immediately any time I texted. She was very positive and helpful with a couple requests that I had. The biggest amenity of this Airbnb was the gym, pool, and saunas (both wet and dry). If you have been traveling and unable to exercise, this is the perfect place. Thank you.

Had a good stay in Istanbul, short 15 minute walk to Taksim but do bear in mind that its an very steep incline or a short 5 min uber ride. Place was great with the access to the Spa area which we utilised quite a bit due to the weather being quite cold so it was a treat! Host is very responsive and helpful whenever we had any issues. Would recommend.

Fotoğraftaki gibi değildi daire bakımsızdı.Temizliğin biz gelmeden yapıldığını düşünmüyorum.Özellikle mutfak ve banyonun temizliği özenli şekilde yapılmamıştı.Konum ve ortam olarak aile ile gelebilenecek bir yer değil.Nihan hanımın hızlı cevap vermesi ve güvenlikli site içerisinde olması en olumlu şeyler.

Good place, a bit of a walk to taksim square but overall there are a lot of things close by. The heat was blasting but the front desk was nice and turned it off upon request. Other than that it was a comfortable stay...

description:
It's in the historical city center.
5 minutes by walk to Istiklal street.
The studio is located on an authentic street where local families live and children play outside.
On the basement floor of a renovated old townhouse

reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful stay here! Everything was great from start to finish. The host was incredibly responsive and made sure I was fully settled in — anything I needed, he was right there and always super prompt.

He truly went above and beyond. He even bought an ironing board just so I could iron my hijab comfortably, fixed a light near the kitchen sink without delay, and arranged for a cleaner to come in and clean the bathroom right away when I needed it. I really appreciated the effort, care, and thoughtfulness. Just a heads-up: there are stairs and a bit of uphill/downhill walking to reach the place — but that’s Istanbul for you!

Overall, a fantastic experience and I would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!

It was my last minutes booking. Although the building looks a little old from the outside, the interior is completely different and much nicer than expected. I felt comfortable staying here. The Wi-Fi was strong and reliable, which allowed me to get some work done during my stay.
The location is very convenient, with easy access to tourist attractions and plenty of good food options nearby. The room was clean and comfortable, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend this place!

We had a nice stay at Mr Mehmet place, it was clean and neat with basic needs. I loved so much the hot water it was so good, the hairdyer was perfect. My baby enjoyed the small cozy studio. The neighborhood was a bit noisy at night as children plays outside and but we loved to see how people here live everyday. They are so nice and good people, thanks a lot to Mr Mehmet who met all our expectations we are truly happy to have been there so close to Istiklal street and Taxim square.
Her şey tek kelimeyle kusursuzdu! Evin temizliği, konumu ve ev sahibinin iletişimi mükemmeldi. Kendi evimde gibi rahat hissettim. Kesinlikle tekrar konaklamak isterim, herkese tavsiye ederim

Konaklama surecimde bir tek internet konusunda sorun cektim o da ev sahibi mehmet beyle alakasiz sebeke problemiydi ama surec boyunca surekli benim ihtiyaclarimi sordu ve benim yanimda oldu. Eve gelicek olursa -1. Katta oldugu icin telefon cekmeme problemi yasadim kebdi internetim de cok iyi cekmedi fakat ev genel olarak cok temiz duzenli ve rahatti bir daha gelirsem mutlaka burayi tercih ederim!!

description:
★ Airport Transfer / Safe and quality service
(Please get a quote.)
★ Exclusive Location Near to Nisantasi
★ Third Floor (have lift)
★ Excellent air condition system (have 3 A/C)
★ Modern Decoration, Large Screen TV, Dining Table in the Living Room
★ Fully Equipped Kitchen

This amazing and spacious 3 bedroom flat is located in the heart of Istanbul. With only 8 min walk to Osmanbey Metro Station and 15 min walk to City's Shoping Mall.

reviews.text:
We stayed 3 nights with our 3 children in this very spacious and well appointed flat. We enjoyed having 3 bedrooms, bedding was comfortable and heating efficient. We were however disturbed by very noisy neighbours (upstairs and downstairs) every night who seemed to be making excessive noise all throughout the night. We raised this with the host (all flats in the building are Air BnBs he manages) who assured us he would warn them but we were unable to enjoy our stay due to the lack of sleep every night. The road is also very noisy.
Apart from this, the listing is conveniently located 10min on foot from the nearest metro station and a short walk to the nearest bakery, supermarket, etc. The host was always very responsive and reactive whenever we got in touch or needed more soap, dishwasher tabs, etc

Abdullah’s apartment in Şişli was an excellent choice for me and my two kids (15 and 20). The location is truly convenient everything we needed was within a few minutes’ walk, which made our trip so easy and comfortable. The bus station is about 4 minutes away, and the metro is around a 10 minute walk, so getting anywhere in Istanbul was simple. We also loved having great bakeries nearby perfect for breakfast and snacks during the day.The apartment itself was exactly what we hoped for: clean, safe, and well equipped with everything we needed for our 6-day stay. It felt comfortable from the moment we arrived, and it was a great home base after long days exploring the city. The building and area also felt secure, which matters a lot. What really made the experience stand out was Abdullah’s hospitality. He made us feel at home and was genuinely attentive and kind. If you’re looking for a place in Istanbul with an amazing host and a great location, , I highly recommend staying here.

I appreciate for the host. We came to spend Christmas as a family. The apartment’s location is nice. You can visit the places nearby. The apartment is clean, spacious, organized. The kitchen is nice, bedrooms and living rooms are nice. There is always hot water available. The apartment is peaceful. The host is very responsive. We are grateful. Great place to stay. Highly recommended!
Everything is Super clean . Exactly as the photos. The building is good . The location is also great. The host is very responsive and friendly . We felt at home

This was a lovely flat, we were impressed instantly. It is very spacious with plenty of beds - all completely comfortable. Very clean and comfortable.
Abdullah was extremely helpful and on the ball. Walkable to great transport and Taksim, however be aware that it is quite hilly around that area.
Great stay great place, thank you

description: Experience the mystical charm of Balat, home to sacred springs and ancient churches. Our flat features a panoramic terrace with breathtaking views of Istanbul, including Hagia Sophia, Galata Tower, and the Byzantium walls. Steps away, discover the healing waters of Blachernae Ayazma and other Byzantine sanctuaries. Just 30 seconds from the sea, tram, and ferry, our location offers tranquility, history, and fast access to top attractions in 5 minutes. Enjoy the magic of this unique heritage.

reviews.text:
Great value and location for our group. Beds were good enough for one night.
Hosts were responsive to any and all requests.
Hot water in showers and towels were freshness
The apartment is spacious, clean, and warm, suitable for a group of 6 on a vacation.
The neighborhood is friendly, with various places to eat and small local businesses to buy from.
Thank you, it was nice staying

It was a great vacation for us. The photos matched the real house. It is 3 min walk to public transportation which was awesome because we got wherever we want in 10-15 mins everytime. It was clean and tidy smelled really nice like cleanliness. The host was responsive kind and attentive. Thank you for everything. Definetly we will be back.

The host was very responsive to any issues we had. When we arrived, the hot water wasn’t working, but the host came round and fixed it within 20 minutes of messaging! They were friendly and gave clear, helpful instructions for everything.
The main reason I booked this Airbnb was for the terrace, which was absolutely stunning. It’s first come first serve and for most of our stay, our neighbors were using it from early morning until night. Every time we went to use it, they were already there. On the rare occasion it was free, the smell of cigarette smoke was so strong it made it hard to enjoy.
The only real issue was with cleanliness. When we arrived, we found a pair of men’s underwear and a chewed plum seed, which was off-putting. There was also a strange odor in the kitchen and toilet area, so we had to keep the windows open to air it out.
The stay had its highs and lows, but the host's responsiveness and the beauty of the terrace when we could use it were definite highlights.

Our stay at this beautiful villa was an incredible experience. The spacious interiors and high ceilings created an airy atmosphere and the coziness made us fell truly at home. It was very clean and comfortable. The private sauna and turkish hamam was fantastic allowing us to relax. Location was best! Balat we loved exploring the colorful streets, historical Byzantine churches, and vibrant local cafes. The tram station is just a short walk away making it incredibly easy to reach the city center and other attractions. The host was always responsive and helpful. We highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique and relaxing stay in Istanbul. We would definitely love to come back!
Excellent stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Communication was smooth, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Highly recommended.

description: A comfortable private studio with a balcony in an iconic building in Kadıköy, designed for an independent stay. Enjoy your own space and the freedom of being close to the cafés, bars, restaurants and everyday life that make Kadıköy one of Istanbul’s most vibrant neighborhoods. With excellent transport connections, Meltem studios are a practical home base for discovering the city or settling into Istanbul for a longer stay. Guests also have access to Nest Digital Nomad House co-working space.

reviews.text:
Great location, friendly staff but with a building site feel.
The accommodation is very centrally located, easy to get to and surrounded by everything you need for a successful stay. The communal area is a real plus - cosy and ideal for working or relaxing. The staff are friendly and the Wi-Fi connection was excellent, which was great for working remotely.
Our room was on the top floor with a small balcony, which looked really nice at first glance. The decor is minimalist and modern. Unfortunately, a closer look revealed a few flaws: The heating didn't work and was just leaning against the wall, the door handle to the balcony kept falling off and the breeze was blowing all over the place. This 'building site feeling' was not just in our room, but throughout the building - as if it was still being renovated.
Nevertheless, I would definitely come back for a short stay (<4 days) in Istanbul as the location, price and staff are really great.

The location of the Airbnb is just perfect! It offers easy access to Marmaray, the Kadıköy metro, buses, and trams, making it simple to reach the other side of the city. The neighborhood has nice bars and cafes, and I felt very safe. However, this is a mini studio within a social co-housing hub, so the kitchen, living room, and many other areas are shared. This means you don’t have complete privacy, and people can see you coming and going frequently. The reception was mostly unstaffed, and I had to send a text before arriving to ask for directions to the Airbnb, which was a first for me on this app. That said, communication with the hosts was smooth after that initial contact.

Great place, great stay! Everyone is friendly and helpful. You can get some snacks and beverages and the coworking space is nicely air conditioned. There is an equipped kitchen and a space outside to have some smokes (there were little kittens outside, which was just too cute to handle).
Asya is a great host and really forthcoming, she made us feel very comfortable. I wish her all the best in her future endeavours and look forward to coming back!

Asya’s place was easy to find and really easy to access!
Our room had many beautiful windows which was great to let light in during the day, however, the bathroom was visibly dirty around the toilet and around the tooth brush holder. In addition to that, the bathroom had a horrible smell that got worse during our time there. Thankfully, the situation got solved as we were able to move rooms where there was no smell. Would still recommend based on location and for how easy the check in and check out process was.

Nice room with windows all around, minimum furniture. There are other buildings close by, so you can’t leave the curtains open often.
The place is like a hotel/hostel rather than an apartment. It seems to have a nice community and probably would be great to mingle for a long stay.
The area is local and commercialized, huge street market nearby. We found some great places to eat, all walkable. 15-mins walk to the ferry pier.

description: Our facility is located in the oldest part of Istanbul. What we love about being in our neighborhood is that you are located between 6 amazing 'must see' areas in the heart of Istanbul - Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and Sultanahmet Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Istanbul Archaeological Museum complex. Many of Istanbul's most popular attractions are within a 10-minute walk - our location is super central and there is no need to take the metro or bus after checking in.

reviews.text:
Location: close to public transportation (tram), within easy walking distance of many major attractions, such as the Grand Bazaar and Hagia Sophia/Blue Mosque. Also within walking distance of many good restaurants.
Service: Offers all the services described in the Airbnb listing, with friendly reception staff.
Fair price.
I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made everything easy. I’d definitely stay here again.
Location is walking distance from Grand Bazaar, lots to do. Our host made everything worth it. Very helpful and attentive. Thank you!

Adil is an amazing host, he lets us check in early and check out late. Adil place is very clean, spacious, quiet and close to major attractions. The kitchen is fully equipped with cooking equipment. Highly recommend!
Son derece kibar bir beyefendi. kaldığınız yer düzenli olarak temizlenir. Temiz tutulur. fiyat, temizlik ve konum olarak mükemmeldi.

description: In this centrally located place, you can cool off with the air conditioners in the house and easily access everything.

reviews.text:
We loved the location of the apartment it was very close to Beşiktaş Square and the market. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and cozy.
Tarik was very kind and always responded quickly. He was also very helpful and provided us with anything we needed. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this place.

Check-in was easy and quick, the apartment is in wonderful location. You can walk to cafes, bars, the seaside and the ferry. It is clean and quiet. There is everything i need in the kitchen. I will recommend it to my friends who will travel to Istanbul.

It was a good place close to a lot of cafe and restaurants, and pretty much walkable. But if someone has issues with stairs (knee, foot problem), then this would certainly be problematic as there is no elevator in the building and there is quiet a a lot of stairs. Tarik was helpful and trying his best as a host, he even helped us carry over our luggages.
Really nice place to stay with a great location. Very friendly, helpful and responsive host. Very quiet also during the night time. Close to many shops, cafes and restaurants.

Check in was easy and quick, the house is clean, bright and airy. Area is very safe for female single traveller. close to Nisantasi & Beskitas harbour so pretty good base for exploring and living like a local. Many cafe restaurants bars around. Host Tarik is helpful, gave good suggestions about local experience. Loved the dinning clubs and would be happy to stay there again next time i’ll be in Istanbul

description: Welcome to Bomonti 42 Suites, your cozy two-bedroom city getaway! Each suite is designed with modern style and comfort, featuring a fully equipped kitchen and soft, high-quality bedding for a relaxing stay. Just a 7-minute walk from the nearest subway station, it’s easy to explore the city’s top sights, restaurants, and shops. Perfect for both work and family vacations, Bomonti 42 Suites is your home in the heart of the city!

reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay at Bomonti 42 Suites. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and nicely designed, and the location was very convenient. The hosts were responsive, helpful, and made a real effort to make sure we were comfortable throughout our stay.
The only small downside was the elevator, which is quite compact. It can fit around two to three people, but if you have shopping bags or luggage and your hands are full, realistically only about two people can use it comfortably at a time. Since we were a group of four, this was a little inconvenient occasionally.
Other than that, everything was great and we really enjoyed our stay. Thank you for hosting us!

I spent about 5 months at Emir’s and Yasemin’s and place. I enjoyed discovering a new neighborhood that is walkable and easy access to the metro. The apartment is very well located, well kept, clean and comfortable. The area is relatively quiet with many amenities close by, including grocery stores, restaurants and cafes. In fact, the owners just opened a very cute cafe downstairs from the apartment. Emir and Yasemin were extremely responsive and whenever issues come up, they always acted very quickly and very professionally to address them. The fact that both Emir and Yasemin spoke perfect English made the communication with them very smooth. Yasemin made several recommendations for restaurants nearby and is always helpful whenever I had a question about life in Istanbul. I really enjoyed my stay at Emir and Yasemin’s place and I highly recommend their apartment.

I had a wonderful stay at Yasemin’s flat in Şişli. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a pleasant stay. The location is perfect – close to shops, cafes, and easy access to public transportation, also parking availability around the place, making it very convenient to explore Istanbul.
Yasemin is a great host, very kind and helpful, always ready to answer questions and provide recommendations. She made sure everything went smoothly during my stay.
I truly enjoyed my time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!

Great apartment in great location, many cafes and restaurants nearby. The place is cozy and has everything we needed. Very clean.
We appreciate the communication with the host, cleanliness and how pictures were matching the reality! Just be ready for a second bedroom, which is small and very dark, as the window is facing the inner gutter as many apartments in Istanbul have.
Emir is the greatest host I have ever been communicating with, responding very fast and proactively providing solutions. We even switched the apartment after the original one toilet was not working and he came late in the night to help!
Many thanks for everything Emir and Yasemin. :-)

Amazing host, very responsive and helpful! Always in touch! They allowed us to check in a bit earlier, which I am very grateful for and also there is a nice cafe which belongs to owners downstairs where we were able to keep our luggage since we arrived very early in the morning. The apartment was very clean, warm and cozy. The furniture is a bit outdated but it wasn’t an issue at all. The location is also good and quite walkable, there are few grocery shops nearby, walking distance to Bomontiada and around 15-20 minutes by foot to Nisantasi. Thank you for the great stay!

description: Everything you want to explore is right outside the door of this place.

reviews.text: I'm traveling often to Istanbul and this location is really peaceful and clean, it was described exactly like was in reality. We loved to stay there. Definitely recommend place.

At the beginning when i saw the area i was disappointed but after i checked in i was surprised, they supplied me a parking front of the hotel and easy check in . The room and furniture were very clean . The area was great easy for shopping and restaurants were very close , Ayhan was very responsive and great host . You wont be disappointed. Me and my wife were very satisfied. Highly recommended.
Convenient location and clean apartment host was more than accommodating

Gece 3 te giriş yaptık ve o saate kadar sağolsunlar bekleyip irtibatta kaldılar. kolayca girişimizi gerçekleştirdik. en ufak probleminizde sağolsunlar hemen ilgilendiler. oda gayet temiz,herşey ilandaki gibiydi. memnun kaldık.ücretsiz otopark mevcut ve arabamı pek kullanmama gerek kalmadı. çünkü yürüme mesafesinde tramvay hattı mevcut. oradan istediğiniz yere kolayca ulaşabiliyorsunuz. alışveriş ve restoran,lokanta vs hemen yakınınızda. sultanahmete gezerek yarım saatte yürüyerek gidebildik. lokasyonu çok güzel. fırsatımız olursa tekrar konaklamayı düşünüyoruz.

The room was clean, it was warm (we stayed in December). There are many places to eat and shops in the vicinity. The location is quite close to walking distance to the Grand Bazaar, Mosques, etc. Upon arrival we were nearby but still the GPS was not helping us and I wrote to Ayhan who immediately came and took us to the accommodation. Thank you very much, Ayhan!

description: Stay in a stylish, ground-floor apartment in historic Galata — steps from Galata Tower, cafes, and shops located in most beautifull and quiet street of Galata Ideal for couples & digital nomads&smallfamilies with fast Wi-Fi, A/C, full kitchen, and workspace. Short Walk to tram, ferry, and Istiklal Street,metro. Cozy, quiet, and central!

reviews.text:
Good place. Walking distance from Galata Tower, lots of cafes, vintage shops, and workshops around. The place itself is small and cosy, with lots of little details. The bathroom is clean and pleasant to use. The host is responsive (there was a problem with a shower head that had been fixed within a day). Close to the best tram lines for tourists T1 and T2.
Cons: Smaller than you'd think, but still capable of hosting 3 people. There is a huge gas boiler/space heater right there in the living room; we would like it if we knew that beforehand. Soundproofing is nonexistent. We could hear every step from the hall's staircase and from the street. We stayed in February, and the weather was quite cold outside. Unfortunately, there was a vent hole directly in the window glass that we couldn’t close. This was likely a safety precaution due to the gas boiler located right in the room. As a result, we were subjected to some unpleasant drafts.

Galata’s place is in a fantastic location, with plenty to do nearby, easy access to the metro, and just a short walk to Galata Tower. The apartment has a water heater in the living room that makes some noise at times, but it didn’t affect our stay.
The hosts were very friendly and accommodating—flexibility with check-in and check-out, provided a baby cot, and shared helpful local tips. The space was a bit smaller than I expected, but it was perfect for our little family.

Stay here!! The perfect location, so close to everything you need, clean, cute, and the best host! He was SO accommodating. Our flight landed very early in the morning and he changed everything around so that we could check in early to a beautiful cozy home. He had such great communication and went above and beyond by even stopping by to see if we needed anything. My partner and I work remotely and the WiFi was great. AC is in the bedroom only and cooled down the house. Felt very safe and loved being less then a minute walk to the grocery store, pharmacy, food options, metro, and the tower.

A couple of weeks have gone by, and I’m still wondering—what’s better: the place or the host?
Honestly, the apartment looks exactly like the photos. The price is worth it for the wood flooring alone, but there’s so much more. All the essentials are there, plus a bunch of lovely extras that make it feel special.
It’s not huge, but it’s just right for two people. And the neighborhood? Absolutely unbeatable.
The host was incredibly welcoming—helped us check in a bit early and check out a bit late. Super responsive the whole time.
Truly grateful and so happy I chose this place!

Great place, right in the middle of everything and at the same time on a hidden street which means no crowd and noise. Very responsive host, everything as described. The apartment I would say is small, but I think for this price and location which is in the middle of a historic place - it’s a very good apartment to stay. We would stay here one more time for sure.

description:
Stay in the Heart of Istanbul: Sultanahmet Guesthouse
Located in Istanbul's historic Fatih district, our guesthouse in Cankurtaran offers a memorable stay. Within walking distance to landmarks like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia,Basilica Cistern and Topkapi Palace, our guesthouse features 2 bedrooms, a bathroom, a kitchen, and a living room, accommodating up to 6 guests. Enjoy free Wi-Fi,TV and street parking. Experience we offer the rich history and vibrant life of İstanbul in Sultanahmet!

reviews.text: We stayed at Berker’s for 3 days to visit Istanbul lovely city. It’s situated in best part of city, in Sultanahmet. Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, archaeological museum & other places of interest, are about 8-10 min walking distance. Public transport connection easy, get the tram from Sultanahmet about 10 min & you go anywhere. The place was clean, everything as described. We asked Berker for something not in the house & he found it for us. Great. Berker is fantastic lad. Very helpful & kind. Communication with him absolutely brilliant. Very helpful. He found a taxi for us too which was fantastic. He can helps with lots of things. Getting the key not a problem at all. Any problems were sorted out immediately. He was ready for everything. The day we left, our flight was in evening. Berker was so nice, he asked us that if we wanted, we could stay another 3-4 hours, because other customers had to come very late in the evening. We thank Berker making our visit more beautiful.

Great location, the blue mosque and other very famous places are within 10 min walking distance. The apartment is clean, a little bit small but reasonable considering the price. Berker is a very nice host, always responded promptly.

We had a wonderful stay at Berker’s Airbnb with our family! The space was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The location was convenient, making it easy for us to explore the area. Berker was a thoughtful and responsive host, always ensuring we had a smooth and pleasant experience. We highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a cozy and hassle-free stay. Thank you, Berker, for making our trip so enjoyable!
Ev sahibi park yeri konusunda yardımcı herzaman iyi bir iletişimimiz oldu. Eski bir bina ancak ev temizdi 10/8 konum çok iyi. 4 kişi çok rahat kalınır tavsiye ederim.

Tumer House was comfortable and Berker was very helpful and responsive. The location is fantastic in Sultanahmet, everything is within walking distance, including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, the Basilica Cistern, and Topkapi Palace. Perfect for sightseeing.

description:
Our flat is in the middle of culture, entertainment and shopping centers. We are just a few steps away from public transportation points such as metro, metrobus, ferry and historical tram.

Our flat consists of 1 bedroom, 1 living room + full kitchen, bathroom + WC and a small balcony.
There is a strong internet network specific to the flat. There is a smart TV, ceiling fan in the living room and AC in the bedroom.

You will feel at home in this stylish apartment in the center of Kadıköy.

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my week here! The apartment was very clean and looked exactly like the photos. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my stay. Check-in was very easy, even though I arrived in the middle of the night.
As other reviewers have mentioned, the apartment is on the 5th floor with no elevator. It was totally fine for me day to day, but getting luggage up and down was definitely a challenge.
One thing I hadn’t seen mentioned in other reviews is that the apartment is on a very small street where large groups of mostly men gather to play cards. I never had any actual issues with anyone, but as a woman, it could feel a little intimidating at times, especially since you have to walk through the groups whenever entering or leaving the building.
Other than that, the neighborhood is lovely, with so many amazing food and coffee options nearby.
I was happy with my stay. The place is in a great location, clean and had everything described. Bulent was responsive and helpful. Worth it!

We had a great stay at this apartment! The place looks exactly like the photos—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The neighborhood is lively and full of fantastic restaurants, cafes, and bars, so there’s always something to do nearby. Just a heads-up: the vibrant nightlife means it can get a bit lively in the evenings, but we enjoyed being in the heart of the action. Check-in and check-out were super easy. Overall, we were very happy with our stay and would recommend it!
Host was very responsive and helpful. Location is great - lots to do and eat nearby. Apartment is as per the photos. Please be mindful it is on level 5 and access is only via a thin spiral staircase!

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment. The location is great, the apartment is nicely furnished and very functional. On colder days, we also really appreciated the efficient heating. And last but not least, Bülent is an exceptionally wonderful host who was always very helpful.

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. The apartment is located in the basement and does not get any sunlight. The price is therefore affordable. Please take this into account when booking!

reviews.text: Çok memnun kaldım İstanbula geldiğimde Murat beyin evlerini tercih ediyorum sorunsuz harika bir ev sahibi evleride oldukça temiz fiyat olarakta makul
Genellikle iyiydi fakat televizyonu internete bağlamakta ya da sıcak su konusunda problemler yaşadık bodrum katı olması sebebiyle biraz rutubetliydi ama fiyatına göre bende ideal bir hizmetti.

Bu, Murat Bey ve arkadaşlarının ev sahipliği yaptığı dairede dördüncü konaklamam oldu ve her seferinde aynı kaliteyle karşılaştım. Kadıköy ve çevresinde konaklama ihtiyacım olduğunda her zaman ilk tercihim Murat Bey’in daireleri oluyor. İyi bir ev sahibi olarak konforlu bir konaklama için gerekli olan her şeyi sunuyorlar. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Konaklamada 1 numaralı daireyi kullandığım için bazı konularda pişmanlık duydum, fön makinası hiçbir şekilde çalışmıyordu. Tv WiFi ile bağlanmadı çünkü modem uzakta gözüküyordu, tvyi internet olmadığı için kullanamadım kendi internetimi görmedi telefona da bağlanmadı. Teknolojiden iyi anlarım. Odada üşüdüm. Çünkü klimasını ısıtma modunda 30 dereceye ayarlamama rağmen soğuk çalıştı ve bir saatin ardından soğuk çalışmaya devam ettiği için artık onu da görmezden gelip kapattım. Son olarak yatağın bir ayağı yamulmuştu bu yüzden dolayı yatağa çok dikkatli bir şekilde girip çıkmak zorunda kalıyordum. Giriş mükemmeldi onun dışındaki durumların düzelmesi gerekiyor. Yine de puan kırmadım. İşletmenin düzelteceğini düşünüyorum.
Very good. Clean and affordable

description: You will find all kinds of shops and entertainment centers around you in the most popular area of Şişli, just a 3-minute walk from Osmanbey metro station, where you will be as comfortable as your home and stay safely and peacefully. Everything for transportation, shopping and relaxation will be waiting for you. We will be neighbors with you in our family building and will be happy to assist you with your requests at any time.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5
I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb apartment! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The bed was super cozy, and the Wi-Fi was strong, which was perfect for both relaxing and getting a bit of work done.
The location was excellent—close to local shops, restaurants, and public transport, yet in a quiet and safe neighborhood. It felt like a real home away from home.
Mr Erdem was incredibly welcoming and responsive, always available if I had any questions. Check-in was smooth, and I really appreciated the thoughtful touches around the apartment, like fresh towels, toiletries, and a guidebook with local recommendations.
I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Erdem is nice person and great host. He lives upstairs and is very responsive and supper helpful.
The apartment is in the great location, close to metro and buses, and walking distance to most tourist spots in the center. The place is very comfortable and very clean, equipped with all basics and even with cleaning supplies.
I highly recommend!

We have stayed in many different countries and in many different houses, but I can say that Erdem's house is the most successful in terms of cleanliness. The house is centrally located, within a 5-10 minute walking distance to the metro. It is well-heated, and the kitchen is equipped with all the basic tools you might need. The bed was very comfortable for us. Lastly, we had no issues during check-in or check-out, it was smooth and quick. If we need to stay in this area again, we will definitely choose Erdem's house.

All the reviews are true—Erdem is such a kind and welcoming host, and he really goes out of his way to make sure everything is perfect. The apartment is cozy, with a fully stocked kitchen, lots of storage, and thoughtful little touches that make it feel like a real home. We stayed for a week with our two small kids and it was super comfortable for a longer stay.
The neighborhood feels more local than Taksim or Sultanahmet, which we really enjoyed. It made groceries and meals out more affordable, but it was still lively and full of character. Just a 2-minute walk puts you right into the hustle and bustle of the city, and the metro is less than 10 minutes away—so getting around Istanbul was really easy.
We’re so glad we chose this place—thanks again, Erdem!

Erdem's apartment isn't fancy, but it is perfect. It is perfectly clean and comfortable. And it is perfectly located in a local neighborhood with lots of cafés, restaurants, and shopping. There's even a grocery store right across the street. The apartment is on the first floor of a small building with a lovely cross-breeze that keeps the apartment fresh and airy. The apartment is well laid out for a couple or single person, has an easy access entrance, and a washer AND dryer (a huge asset if you're planning more than a week in Istanbul). Erdem himself is a impeccable host. He helped me beyond the call of duty when I first arrived and answered every inquiry quickly and pleasantly. And the fact that he and his family live next door made me feel safe and relaxed. I would definitely stay there again.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Echo is a brilliant host. In terms of location, the house is close to transport links (trams at Tophane) and the shopping high street (İstiklal Avenue). What really stood out was the hospitality. Echo went above and beyond, thoughtfully providing snacks and bottles of water, which was really nice of him. Everything was clean, comfortable, and just as described. I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others. Thanks again :)

Great value for money. The apartment is very atmospheric, cozy and very clean! The neighborhood is my favorite: artistic, with lots of local crafts shops and best museums (in my opinion).
I stayed in many airbnbs around the world, and I can say Echo’s apartment is just wonderful. Great hot shower (believe me, in many cases it shouldn’t be taken for granted). The kitchen is compact, but has everything you need.
The bed in the bedroom is very comfortable. All the linen was fresh and smelled nice! Same for towels.
The only thing to be aware of is that living room faces street and even with windows closed you can hear some street noise like people talking loud. So a person sleeping on the couch shouldn’t be a light-sleeper.

We had a very pleasant stay and would especially like to thank Echo, who was incredibly kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our time here. Communication was excellent from start to finish, and he genuinely cared about making sure we were comfortable.
The apartment is clean, well maintained, and in a great location. It is a very good option for visitors looking to explore the city and enjoy their stay.
For guests planning to spend most of their time sightseeing, we think it is a great choice. If, like us, you plan to spend many hours working from the apartment, it is worth noting that the space is better suited to one person working rather than multiple people at the same time. As the apartment is on the ground floor, it is also a bit darker than we personally prefer for spending long days indoors.
That said, these aspects are very much related to our specific needs, and they did not take away from the excellent hospitality we received.
Thank you again Echo!

Echo’s apartment is really beautiful (even better than in the pictures), thoughtful furniture and new/clean equipment in the kitchen and bathroom. We loved the location on a side street, central yet walkable to the tram station or Istikal Caddesi as well as some lovely coffee shops and stores. Even if it is on ground floor it was cool and quiet at night.
Ekrem, the host, was always friendly and responsive.
We enjoyed our stay very much and we can only recommend it further!

We loved staying at Echo's place in Istanbul. It was the perfect balance of quiet and peaceful while being in exactly the right location to walk to most places or easily take the tram. Echo was really helpful and very communicative, without being in any way intrusive. He did a brilliant job of welcoming us and looking after us during our stay. The apartment is towards the top of a hill, opposite the Russian Consulate, which has a 24-hour police presence outside. We found this reassuring, although the area itself never felt unsafe. I think we read in one of the previous reviews that the bed was small — that is not the case; it is a standard double size. We walked or used the tram (less than a 10-minute walk away) to get to all the main sights and found the location very convenient. There are also lots of nice places to eat on the street itself and nearby. If we were visiting Istanbul again, we would not hesitate to stay here. Highly recommended!

description: The apartment is a 3-minute walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue. The apartment is 38 km from Istanbul Airport and 41 km from Sabiha Gökçen Airport. In line with the requests of our guests, transfer from the airport to the apartment can be made by private vehicle. The apartment is within walking distance to all public transportation. Cleaning can be done during the stay at the request of our guests, but this is paid. The earliest check-in time is 2 pm and the latest check-out time is 12 pm.
