Tam olarak fiyat performans 👍🏻

Cengizhan's place is just 5 minutes walk from Taksim. Elevator facility, the availability of front office receptionist, cleaning staff, responsiveness of the host, well equipped kitchen, clean sheets, natural light, HVAC facility, microwave & washing machine, iron box, good WiFi and Netflix, what else do you need to feel at home!
The host was very accommodating, kind and professional. Would definitely return again when in Istanbul. (reviewed for two bedroom apartment)

Great place to say. literally 3mins walking to central of Taksim Square. We as tourist really appreciate the location. Espescially nearby to Metro (Train station).
4 adults stayed there with comfortably. Clean. Space are just nice not too big not too small. With the price we pay, i can give 10/10 rating.
Smart TV with wifi, 24/7 High speed wifi access.
Lift a but too small, those who bring many luggage need to carry few times up. But not an issue because the reception will assist us bring up the laggage.
Will recommend the place to friends & families who visiting Istanbul in future.

Check-in was super easy, it was in a great spot very close to Taksim square. The apartment itself was decent, looked like the photos, except for some small details and broken things here and there (shower towel holder falling, lights flickering, the floor felt like it wasn't flat).
The biggest issue was the extremely slow and crammed elevator, and since the apartment was on the 4/5th floor, I had to take it every time, it took legitimately MINUTES to go up or down if the elevator wasn't already on the floor you're on, and it was super hot.
The AC was very cool which was amazing in the hot summer days of Istanbul, overall the apartment was great and would definitely recommend it, just be prepared to walk up some stairs now and then.

The place is nice , clean and looks just like the pictures. It’s not fancy, but it’s comfortable and has everything you need. The location is amazing — only about 5 minutes’ walk to Istiklal Street and Taksim Square. The area is lively, safe, and full of restaurants, shops, and everything around you. For the price and location, it’s definitely worth it. I recommend it.

description:
Antoine Galata is located in the 160 year old Grade II Listed Urgliavich Building next to the Galata Tower.
The building was fully renovated in 2012. All apartments are luxuriously refurbished with top-of-the-line amenities.
Galata Neighbourhood is where the heart of the City beats with some of the best restaurants and cafés in town very conveniently located.
Shopping for daily amenities, souvenirs and other needs is very easy and safe in the neighbourhood.
Location is extremely central.

reviews.text:
Great view and very convenient location for tourists, right in front of Galata Tower.
However, since it’s in a tourist area, nearby restaurants are quite expensive. Also, the elevator only goes up to the 5th floor, so you need to walk up to the 6th floor via steep stairs, which may be difficult for elderly guests.
Upon check-in, the floor did not seem properly cleaned and there was noticeable dust. During our 5-night stay, towels were limited and additional replacements required extra payment, even though we expected daily changes.
The toilet flush handle was broken at check-in. Although we were told it would be fixed the next morning, it was not repaired until the day before checkout, which caused inconvenience.
I would consider staying again if the property improves on cleanliness and service, even at a slightly higher price.

This flat was just perfect in terms of amenities and decor. Its biggest asset is the view to the Galata Tower which is right outside your window. You’ll have a huge balcony at your disposal and the views to the Bosporous are stunning. Being on the top floor meant that the noise from the hassle and bustle on the streets doesn’t reach the flat. Everything you could need is within walking distance and if you can navigate the metro system there’s a station just opposite the building. There is a modern lift which is very handy when you have to move luggage. The owner is very responsive and helpful. All in all one of my best stays.

This apartment is absolutely amazing. The views are breathtaking and truly unforgettable. We had the best time staying here. As Beyoğlu is our favourite neighbourhood, the location couldn’t have been more perfect. Everything was exactly as described, and Naz is super kind and responsive. We would definitely love to come back again.

We loved the apartment, the balcony view is breathtaking and perfect for walking around the local cafes, restaurants and attractions. We loved the extra touches Naz left like coffee pods, water and cleaning materials. We cannot find any fault or criticism. We will definitely come back to stay again!
Naz hanim gercekten cok nazik ve ilgili bir ev sahibi. Hersey temiz ve duzenli idi. Konum olarak zaten tarihi olarak Istanbul un en guzel yerlerinden biri. Kesinlikle tavsiyedir.

description:
The facility is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, and Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay like their own home.

reviews.text:
Overall, the stay was nice. The location is great, very central. Fatih and his team were responsive and kindly provided an early check-in.
We ultimately decided on 4 stars because our first impression wasn’t ideal. On arrival, although the apartment was clean, we found a personal waste item in one of the bedrooms, which understandably raised oconcerns. When we raised this, it seemed the team initially didn’t understand what the item was & we appreciate there was a misunderstanding. However, their initial response was very dismissive. Once the misunderstanding was cleared up, the conversation improved, but no gesture of goodwill was offered & it left us feeling that our concerns hadn’t been taken seriously.
The bathroom light switch also kept buzzing electricity and the shower was switching quickly between hot and cold, as other guests have written.
Aside from that, the location is great (it can get noisy as expected in the city centre) and the hotel staff were very kind.

I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this Airbnb! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very responsive and always replied quickly whenever I had a question, which made everything smooth and stress-free.
One gesture I really appreciated was that they kindly provided tissues and even changed the towels during my stay, which showed great attention to guest comfort and hospitality. These thoughtful touches made me feel well taken care of.
The location was also excellent and convenient for exploring the area. Thank you for the great hospitality. I would definitely stay here again!

We enjoyed our stay at the apartment. The apartment is in a great location near bars, restaurants, and just steps away from Istikal.
There were a few things that could be improved:
1) The water in the show is either extremely hot or cold. There is no in-between. We asked the host to adjust it, and he sent someone to look at it, but they were not able to fix it.
2) If you are sensitive to smoke, this may not be the place for you. There are people who smoke in the hallways, and you can sometimes smell smoke in the apartment. However, it is impossible to avoid cigarette smoke anywhere near Istikal or Taksim since people are constantly blowing it in your face.
3) You are in the middle of the action, so it is loud outside. Earplugs are a must for sleeping.
4) The curtains on the windows in the main bedroom do not block the light from the street. If you need a dark environment to sleep, this may not be the place for you.

Konaklama sürecimiz son derece memnuniyet vericiydi. Ev, temizlik ve düzen açısından beklentilerimizin üzerinde bir standart sundu. Fotoğraflarla birebir uyumlu olup, konumu itibarıyla oldukça avantajlı bir noktada yer almaktadır. Ev sahibi misafirperver, iletişimi hızlı ve çözüm odaklıydı. Konforlu ve huzurlu bir konaklama deneyimi için gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

no hot water，no one help us check in，we take two big luggage without elevator, even no tissue for the room,no AC，There’s a broken socket in the bedroom with exposed wiring, and some trash hasn’t been cleaned from the room

description:
😇Our apartment is centrally located in Cihangir, Beyoglu, and Taksim. It's close to all tourist attractions. It's 600 meters from Taksim Square and 500 meters from Galataport. The Fındıklı tram stop is 300 meters away. The Kadıköy-Adalar ferries to Kabataş are 600 meters away.
Our 2-bedroom apartment has 2 double beds and 1 sofa bed.
The apartment is open to both sides, with 14 steps to the first floor. There's no elevator İnternet Smart TV and Netflix
Heating and hot water are available 24/7

reviews.text: The place is very close to Taksim Square — about a 10-minute walk — which was great and made it easy for us to get everywhere. The apartment is clean, comfortable, and exactly like the photos, and all the basic necessities were available. The host was cooperative, respectful, and easy to communicate with. Overall, it was an excellent experience and I would definitely recommend the place to anyone

It was a great stay at Hasan's place. As soon as I made the reservation he responded right away. Very clear instructions and it was made very easy to access the apartment. I loved how easy and quick Hasan made it for me to have my stay. The house was clean, fresh linens and towels, which was very necessary for me as I travel often. The flat is like in the photos, the location is walking distance from Taksim square, basically the heart of the city. The transportation hub is near as well. I found a couple of nice cafes and restaurants nearby. Definitely would be best for a longer stay as well. Thumbs up

hasan was a wonderful host and he made sure everything was taken care. check in instructions were very clear, apartment was very clean and all basic necessities including water and coffee were provided. the area is walking distance to all taksim, galataport and the cafes in cihangir.

We've had a very pleasant stay at Hasan's place. Travelling with two children under two met all our needs and Hasan provided two baby cots and a highchair as we requested. All amenities listed were available.
Location is perfect, close to Taksim going uphill and close to tram station downhill. It was perfect for baby strollers as there were no stairs on the way.
Hasan was very responsive and provided clear instructions! There are many shops, restaurants and cafes nearby and a beautiful children park across the tram station.
We would definitely book this place again!!

Konumu çok merkezi. Yokuş inip çıkmakta sıkıntınız yoksa bir çok yere erişimi yaya olarak sağlarsınız. Daire güvenli. Muhit sakin. 4 kişilik aile olarak rahat bir konaklama yaşadık. Ev sahibi hızlı dönüş yapıyor ve çözüm sunuyor. Tavsiye ederiz.

description: Newly renovated 1+1 apartment near Osmanbey metro station.This modern space offers everything you need for a comfortable stay with accessing elevator.There are 58-inch smart TV with Netflix and 2 Air conditions. The bathroom features a refreshing shower, and you'll find a convenient washing machine for your laundry needs.The kitchen is equipped with a 4-eye electrical stove, dishes, silverware, and kitchen utilities, allowing you to prepare your own meals.Enjoy your meals at the dining table.

reviews.text: Clean new place to enjoy! Near the subway station, comfortable bed, and quiet at night to sleep, communication with host was pretty quick and easy, thanks

The listing was misrepresented. Before booking, I confirmed with the host three times that this was a private apartment, as I was renting for a month. Each time, the host confirmed this. In reality, it is an apart-hotel with constant guest turnover.
There was significant noise for 4 consecutive nights, with ongoing noise afterward. The host stated the noise came from a neighboring building, but it felt as if it originated within the same building due to shared structure and acoustics.
The listing was disclosed only one exterior security camera, while in fact there are cameras installed on each floor in common corridors.
The host failed to manage communication constructively, and did not take steps to de-escalate the situation. Noise concerns were minimized, no apology was offered, and the communication contributed to escalation rather than problem-solving.
This place may be suitable for short stays, but it is not appropriate for those seek a quiet, private long-term stay.

Great stay! Everything was perfect.
I stayed for about a month and loved everything about this apartment and neighborhood.
Mr. Mert, the host, was extremely helpful, very kind and responsive.
Highly recommend.
Great location and apartment. Check in was very easy. Definitely recommend
Herşey tertemizdi ve mis gibi kokuyordu konum olarak güvenli ve kolay bulunur ulaşım konusunda heryerde çok yakın.

description: Fully renovated atypical studio apartment located in the hotel area of Taksim neighborhood. Despite being centrally situated, it’s on a relatively calmer street. 5-min walking distance to Taksim square, metro station and airport shuttle.

reviews.text: It was a good stay I was here for almost one month. The apartment is great for one person has a kitchen bathroom bedroom and a functional apartment with the basics that you need. It is in taksim so close to metro and bus stations also walking distance to the square I felt very safe. Özgür was always available for me as needed fixed issues when they arose and communicated well. He greeted me at check in to help which was nice and gave excellent recommendations. I would stay with him again. The bed is comfortable and I appreciated the desk for remote working. The apartment was also having good heating for the winter. Thanks Özgür :)

The apartment is wonderful! Perfect for a long stay — and most importantly, it truly has everything you might need to feel at home.
Brand new dishes, utensils, even the knives are new and everything is so nice and clean ☺️
Lovely bathroom with high-quality fixtures, a fully equipped and convenient kitchen, and a super comfy mattress in the bedroom. The view from the window is beautiful!
Close to the metro, buses, trams, and major attractions.
Fast internet. There’s also a great space for working.
The street feels very safe, even for solo travelers.
Highly recommend — 10,000%!

This place was home for me and my cat for two months, and everything was perfect. The unit was perfectly clean when i checked in, exactly as described. No surprises at all. The host, Özgür, was always responsive and incredibly helpful all the time. Thank you so much for everything!

We had a great time at Ozgur’s place. The neighbourhood is very lively and it seemed very safe. There is a 24/7 supermarket with very good prices just around the corner and a little cafe place called “Armagan Cafe”. If you stay here, please make sure you get your breakfast there.
The apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, even a shared washing machine and dryer. Bed and linen/towels were clean and comfortable.
Ozgur is very friendly and always reachable on wp. He makes sure all guests are comfortable.
All in all, we recommend this place and would stay again!

We had a great time at Oznur's accommodation.
It's a small but comfortable studio with everything you might need in the kitchen.
Tip for those taking public transport from the airport: take the M11 and connect to the M2 to get to Taksim metro station. We trusted Google too much, took a bus after the M11, and spent a long time stuck in traffic.

description: Discover your modern home in Istanbul's vibrant Cihangir! Perfect for long stays, this stylish apartment comfortably fits 2 guests. It features a unique brick wall, a dedicated workspace with fast WiFi, and a modern glass-walled bathroom. Located just a short walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, it's the ideal base for digital nomads and explorers. Enjoy the privacy of your own space in the heart of the city.

reviews.text:
Great location near Taksim and the airport shuttle, just one small street away from Istiklal, yet quiet and calm. Nice view of a Greek Orthodox church, and a police car is often parked nearby, which adds a sense of safety.
Very budget-friendly price for a compact, minimalist room. Everything matches the photos, and check-in is simple and contactless. Overall a good option for a short stay if you plan to walk a lot around Istanbul.
Please note: heating is via air conditioner and the room can feel a bit cold on the first night while it warms up. The bathroom has a floor-level shower, so the bathroom area can get wet. The apartment is a bit worn in some places. The door uses a code lock and is secure from the outside, but there is no additional internal latch.
Great value for money with excellent location.

I booked this accommodation because the photos appeared appealing, but it did not meet expectations. Before writing this review, I informed the host about all issues mentioned, but received no response.
Upon entering, I noticed very high humidity, visible through large water stains on the ceiling. The sofa was visibly dirty, and all towels as well as the bedding, duvet and pillows had stains. Overall, the living area appeared clearly unhygienic. Additionally, a power outlet was hanging loosely from the wall, which is a safety concern.
The bathroom was in even worse condition: the toilet had stains and traces of feces, and the sink, faucet and all holders were not properly fixed. The entire sanitary area appeared neglected and unhygienic.
The so-called “reception” was consistently dark and unstaffed.
Overall, the stay was very unpleasant due to the clearly insufficient cleanliness and hygiene. Apart from the central location, there were no positive aspects.

Had a wonderful stay at this place, looked exactly like the photos and the description. Everything was clean and well organized. In a great location and an excellent view.
The hosts are very helpful and responsive.

Excellent location right in the center of Istiklal Street, Istanbul. The host has thoughtfully provided everything you could possibly need inside the house. Very comfortable and convenient, absolutely worth it !

Great flat in area with lots going on. All in one room - kitchen area - bathroom - sleeping and sofa - but fine if on own or with someone you know very very well. Good layout and felt uncluttered and a nice place to hang out
The host was helpful
Near metro and not too far from the bus stop that comes from the airports
Lots of shops and food places nearby
Lift was working

description: Located in the heart of Istanbul’s most touristic center, right at the foot of the iconic Galata Tower and just steps away from all major public transportation. Nestled in a neighborhood rich with history, this spacious high-ceiling apartment offers 24-hour security, exposed historical brick walls, original ceiling paintings, and separate bathroom and toilet facilities. Ideal for large families seeking comfort and character in a truly authentic setting.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—spotlessly clean, cozy, and in a great location. Tijen was incredibly communicative and provided clear instructions. We especially loved the comfortable bed and also the fully equipped kitchen. Galata Tower just few steps away and Show Supermarket also nearby..Highly recommend this listing to anyone visiting Istanbul

We spent 4 nights at Tijen’s place with an 8 and an 11 year old. What made our stay memorable were a) the location, which was central, walkable, and easily accessible to all parts of the city. Two grocery stores were located conveniently on either side of the building. b) Tijen was the most helpful, and responsive air bnb host I’ve ever come across. Five stars! We had a very comfortable stay and would consider staying here again in the future.

Tijen’s place is in a very good location. It is on the first floor, but you have to go up a flight of stairs. She was extremely accommodating, letting us check in early. The house is beautiful. You can see the Galata tour from the bedroom.

Tijen is a very responsive and kind host. She helped us find the metro and recommended a place with delicious pizza. She always replied quickly and stayed in touch throughout our stay.
The apartment is located in a very tourist-friendly area, right next to the Galata Tower, so it was easy to walk to many attractions. It was also convenient that taxis could easily reach the location. The area also felt quite safe, and we were comfortable walking around even in the evening.
The house is on a hill, so be ready for a little leg workout 😄 But overall the location was very convenient. The apartment had all the essentials we needed for a comfortable stay.

It was our first time visiting Istanbul and let me tell you this apartment is in the heart of it all. The airport trip was 35 min away and once we stepped outside the taxi, you are greeted by the famous Galata Tower which is right outside the apartment. Tijen was waiting at the apartment and gave us all the information needed to make our stay super comfortable. The apartment was just as described in the pictures with all the amenities. Super clean apartment, with so much history in front of the door steps. Me and my family cannot wait to book again with Tijen, as we truly fell in love with Istanbul. Thank you again for everything.

description:
You can enjoy fun with your whole family in this wonderful place.
All the residents of the apartment are families. Renting to anyone other than families is not welcomed.
Parties are strictly forbidden in the apartment. We kindly ask you to be more sensitive about the noise after 9:30 pm.

reviews.text:
I truly enjoyed my stay at Yasarbey’s place. The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. I especially loved the large panoramic windows and the calm, comfortable atmosphere. The location was great — close to everything I needed, yet peaceful.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you again!

My family and I were visiting Istanbul for the first time. Instead of staying at a hotel, we wanted to rent an apartment. But we didn’t know what to expect. Fortunately, we chose the right apartment from Mr. Yaşar.
If I had to describe the Airbnb apartment in one word, I’d choose “fantastic.”
The apartment was easy to get to from the airport (and back). Check-in was straightforward. My first impression of the apartment was that it was very clean and in excellent condition. We felt right at home, which was very important to us during our stay.
Also, I left my spare cell phone in the apartment on the last day, which I didn’t realize until I was at the airport. At first, I thought it was in my suitcase. Then I received a photo from Mr. Yaşar. Fortunately, a friend of mine was also in Istanbul after we’d flown out, and Mr. Yaşar delivered the phone to her. Not everyone would go out of their way to do something like that. I’m therefore very grateful to Mr. Yaşar.

Ev oldukça düzenli ve temizdi. Fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Ev yakınında birden fazla market bulunuyor. Konumu çok iyi. Oldukça geniş ve ferah bir daire. Ev sahibimiz iletişime açık ve her saat mesajlarımıza dönüş yaparak yardımcı oldu.
gayet temiz ve düzenli bir ev. konum iyi. marketlere yakın. otopark sorunu yok. arkadaşlarımla çok rahat bir konaklama yaşadık
The apartment was clean and host communicated clearly. The presence of AC is an advantage of the apartment particularly under summer. However car parking places were unfortunately quite limited.

description: Enjoy a modern stay in Beyoğlu — close to Taksim! This stylish apartment offers a bedroom, living room, kitchen, and bathroom with heating and seasonal AC (May–Oct). The building has elevators, 24/7 security, a café, and paid social facilities (gym, pool, and sauna). Starbucks and Sheraton City Center Hotel are next door, and you can find us easily by searching “Safezone Homes” on Google Maps 🌿

reviews.text: Overall, the apartment was clean, comfortable, and enjoyable to stay in. It takes a bit of walking to reach some of the main attractions, but considering the price, it offers great value for money. The indoor parking was a big advantage. There are plenty of shops, restaurants, and other essentials nearby, making it very convenient. Having a small convenience store at the entrance of the building was also a nice bonus. Overall, I would happily stay here again.
Great stay! The suite was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, and the whole experience was smooth. I would definitely stay here again.

A great host. I felt very well taken care of. Communication was effective, solution-oriented, and helpful. The residence was high-end, comfortable, and stylish. The internet was exceptional, more than enough even for remote workers who spend long hours on video calls every day

I want to thank Adam for his hospitality and his help :)he was responsive and tries to help as he could:) great appartment great location everything was smooth and easy .we really had a great staycation in the apartment we mossed it already;) I highly recommend it ..and we will not think twice to come back😍
Great host,

description: The apartment is located on the 3rd floor and there is no elevator, so guests need to use the stairs. It consists of two separate suite rooms and has a private terrace with a beautiful view. The location is excellent: very close to the metro and tram, in the touristic area but on a quiet street. Major attractions such as Grand Bazaar and Sultanahmet are about 15–20 minutes walking distance.

reviews.text: The place was exactly as advertised. Clearly newly refurbished and really comfortable. The location was also great as it was close to many must-see places, as well as being close the metro. We had one incident where we needed help with the flush in the toilet and the host was very responsive and was there to help immediately. Overall, very nice stay.

Excellent Hospitality, will definately return and recommend to my friends and relatives. Great communication from the start to finish. Went the extra mile in helping to carry my big luggage during check in, responded swiftly on the blinds and contacted us when we left our stuff behind and made sure we were able to pick it up the following day. Location of the apartment is a very plus point for us as its near to many local eateries and groceries shop as we travelling with young picky eaters. Perfect location as its near to many attractions and public transportation is just a few walks away. Let’s just say everything is just perfect which made our vacation in Istanbul Turkey unforgettable ❤️ Thank You Halim & Latife!

the hosts have been fantastic hosts, waiting for you at the door before your arrival and taking the time to seeing you off. They have been helpful in arranging at the eleventh hour to make amendments to my transfer to the airport. They went out of their way to assist bcoz language was an issue communicating with the driver. I would highly recommend this apartment , value for money too. Good job, Latife and Halim.

Great location and very modern apartments. Our hosts were wonderful and nothing was too much trouble. They sorted our transfers andeven booked a bosphorus cruise night where we were picked up from the apartment and had a great night.
Nice place, the owner was very helpful and always responded quickly.

description:
This room, which is within walking distance to popular areas and metro bus stops in the center of Istanbul, is suitable for long and short-term stays, and we always have an open garden.
Access information is automatically displayed in the arrival information 48 hours before the reservation, and everything is as specified in the system.

reviews.text: Great value for money! The location of the hotel truly can’t be beat; just a 5-minute walk from Istiklal Street, the vibrant heart of Istanbul. There are plenty of shops, bars, and restaurants nearby, and both the bus and metro stations are within a 5–10-minute walk, making it easy to explore the entire city. The room was simple but clean and absolutely fair for the price. The only issue was the shower, which leaked a lot no matter what we did, but that’s easy to overlook given the excellent value. Overall, definitely recommend!

Had difficulty in finding the hotel as there were two listings on Google maps (shouldve used Kaira hotel & aparts not Kaira hotel and aparts). the host was responsive, checkin process went smoothly. The room was clean and location is close to Galata, highly recommended.

I’ve stayed in many places in this neighborhood over the years and Mehmet’s place has been the best! He was very kind, the place was very clean and everything smelled great. The bathroom was also perfect and there was good hot water. I will definitely come back!

Not easy to find, not very responsive But very clean and fair location best the Galata tower. If you are traveling with Motorbike the place do not dispone of free safe parking spot. I wish I had known in advance.

Overall, we had a pleasant stay. The location was great and made it easy to get around and explore the area. The host was also very friendly, welcoming, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
The main downside was the cleanliness. The room itself could have been cleaner, and the bathroom in particular wasn’t cleaned to the standard we were expecting. With a bit more attention to housekeeping, this would be a much better place to stay.
Overall, it’s a good option if location and a friendly host are your priorities, but I hope the cleanliness is improved for future guests.

description: Our room offers a spacious and comfortable living space in a 1+1 layout. Two double beds and a sofa bed that can be opened are placed to ensure the comfort of each of our guests. With its fully equipped kitchen, you have the opportunity to prepare your own meals whenever you want. The spacious balcony of the room offers a perfect environment to enjoy the city or to relieve the tiredness of the day. Every detail has been carefully considered to ensure that our guests have a pleasant and comfortable stay.

reviews.text: place was new refurbished. everything was new and clean. despite of being on ground floor but was very quiet and peaceful. just the location was not good.first we went to the given address but the real flat was 2 street down the hill with very steep and narrow street.difficult to walk specially with luggage and if you have elderly with you. even street was very dirty and busy. last day of leaving they helped us to keep our luggage till midd night which was very helpful.
The perfect option for anyone looking for a clean and modern room at a great price point and close to Taksim.
Gayet ilgililerdi. Fiyat uygundu. Taksim’de olması taksi ile ulaşımın birçok noktaya uygun olması sebebiyle tercih edilebilir.
Great host I totally recommend him
Teşekkür ederiz beklentimizi karşıladı

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Muharrems place was wonderful!! First impressions were very good. The room and bathroom was spotless and very modern compared to other Airbnb’s around the area. There is central heating which was very good considering it was cold during the month i stayed! House keeping cleaned our room everyday which is a first for an airbnb, and i thank the host very much!! Its located close to everything you need , subway , tram, bus stops and walking distance to the main attractions!!All in all its perfect place , great value for money!!! I would definitely stay again!!

We had a lovely stay, the place was very clean and modern, the beds comfy and linen fresh.
We had cold bottles of water waiting for us on arrival in a decent size fridge, there's a kettle and a supply of tea and coffee, but no cooking facilities.
There's a lovely spiral staircase to give you a bit of workout.
You're close to lots of shops, bars, sights and the tram, so a great location.
Everyone was extremely friendly, helpful and flexible.
You could have complimentary tea and coffee each day in the restaurant and 20% off food.
We recommend this place and would stay again.

We had a wonderful time staying at the apartment - the location is perfect, the place was clean and comfortable. Our host Muharrem and his team were brilliant, incredibly helfpul and accommodating. The food at the restaurant downstairs was lovely and we had a great experience. I would highly recommend a stay here!

Muharrem’s place us adhacent/above his restaurant at the quiet end of a street/ neighbourhood full of restaurants.
Just minutes to the water/ferries.
Right ne Sirkeci/Marmaray station ( ideal particularly for SAW airport) and about 12 minute stroll to the blue mosque.
Location is perfect and the apartment clean,modern, quiet and as described.
Easy 5 stars 👍

We had a wonderful stay at Muharrem’s place! From the moment we arrived, we felt truly welcomed. The host provided outstanding service throughout our stay and was incredibly friendly, helpful, and responsive. Everything was well organized, clean, and exactly as described. It’s clear that a lot of care goes into making guests feel comfortable. We really appreciated the warm hospitality and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!

description:
Located on the lively İstiklal Avenue, one of Istanbul’s most vibrant spots, our apartment stands out with its stylish and modern design. Situated in a building with an elevator, it offers a peaceful stay thanks to its soundproof structure that keeps the city noise outside.
Fully equipped kitchen and Washing machine is available in the apartment, making it ideal for long-term stays. With comfortable beds and modern decor, the apartment is perfectly suited for both short and extended stays.

reviews.text: Great apartment, clean, comfortable and well located. The host was very kind and responsive. Highly recommended!

The host was friendly and kind, we were asked to move to another apartment and in no time he found us an empty apartment. And the location is wonderful 2 minutes away from Isticlal street. You could find everything there and never need a taxi. But with that benefit comes something bad for sensitive people there is endless music from restaurants it stops only at 7 am, it’s very loud and people cheering and shouting too. So if you don’t sleep deep and well it’s going to be a problem. The apartment itself is pretty, but small for 2 people max. It’s not the cleanest and new. Actually depends on which apartment you get. First one we were had a good bathroom, but the second we moved in had broken bathroom. As it’s many of them in the same building but each has its own colour. We were promised to be in a green one. But when we arrived it was another one pink colour, no one told us in advance that we will be in another one. So I recommended it because of an amazing location for fair price.

I had a lovely stay here! The room itself is really nice, very clean, and just as pictured. The building has a great atmosphere and the location is super convenient, close to everything but still with plenty of character. The staff were also really friendly and helpful throughout my stay, which made a big difference.
The only thing to note is that if you’re a very light sleeper or after a more relaxed vibe, the street outside can get a bit lively into the early hours on some nights. I’m quite a light sleeper myself, so it affected me a little, but others might not notice it at all. Overall though, it’s a great place with lots of charm and I’d definitely recommend it!

This spacious studio apartment was a perfect choice for our little family. It was comfortable, practical, and very well suited for staying with a child. The atmosphere was especially quiet and peaceful, which made it easy for us to relax and feel at home.
Having a kitchen was a big advantage for us. We were able to prepare pasta and simple meals for our child whenever we needed, which made our stay much more convenient.
We also traveled with our little cat, and we truly appreciated the host for being pet-friendly and welcoming us so warmly.
The apartment is a great option for families, especially those traveling with children or pets. We felt very comfortable throughout our stay and would gladly choose this place again. Definitely a lovely and peaceful place to stay!

This apartment was excellent choice! It's amazingly located - so close to everything, so alive area! We were two girls and for us safety was a priority. I can say we didn't feel any discomfort even for a moment. The communication with Maksun was easy and positive.

description:
This beautiful room is very spacious and comfortable.
There is double bed, if you wish you can request two single as message.
The room has LCD TV with cable and AC.
WiFi.
24 hrs pharmacy and supermarkets.
My place have a great location. Metro, train, bus a block away
Clean and bright, Welcome!

reviews.text:
I think it is one of the best locations in Istanbul, great value for money. 4 minute walk to Taksim. 2 minute walk to Istiklal (Please don’t follow google maps to istiklal. Just cross the Tarlabasi road to the other side and walk straight ahead up the slope in front of you, you will be in the middle of Istiklal street in 2 minutes 😉). Also, Tarlabasi bus stop is right next to the residence.
The building staff was very kind and helpful. They provided us a three plug connector when asked, free water bottles (as much as we needed). There is a lift in the building, no issues throughout.
Rooms were neat and clean, cosy. Reasonably away from the hustle and bustle of Istiklal so no noise at night, we stayed for four nights and slept comfortably throughout our stay.
The only thing we faced an issue with was the hair dryer. It works for 30 seconds at a stretch then needs to rest for 4 minutes, good luck to the ladies with that 😂.
All in all, an absolute pleasure to stay here. 100% rec.

The host was very nice and welcoming.
The room was as seen in the photos, however the bathroom was not very clean and there was some dust on the furniture. Instead the bed was clean.
I was able to leave my luggages there and the host was again very kind.
It was near the area I needed and overall has a nice location to move.
Given the price, it's was honest.

Oda ve banyo temiz ve rahattı çok büyük değil ama benim ihtiyacımı karşılayacak kadardı klima vardı ve çalışıyordu bu sıcakta en önemlisi oydu benim için konaklama saati üzerinden değerlendirince fiyat bi tık yüksek ama genel olarak konumu dışında bir sorun yaşamadık çevredeki insanlar otopark sahipleri falan rahatsız olunacak gibiydi arabayı otoparka bırakıp oraya gidene kadar tedirgin oldum açıkçası çevredeki insanlar da size kötü bir şey yapıyormuşsunuz gibi bakıyor onun dışında iletişim kurduğumuz kişi çok tatlı biriydi bize yardımcı oldu teşekkürler tekrar

The hotel was accurate to the description. Nice and clean room with quiet air conditioning. 5mins walk from Taksim square. Nice staff allowing us to store our luggage before check in and after check out. Would recommend

This review is mixed and honest because we paid £25 a night and so it’s probably what’s expected. The hotel is well located for getting about the city but is next to where hookers tout. It doesn’t feel the safest and I wouldn’t stay here alone. We booked for a taxi transfer but the hotel couldn’t get us one (not their fault but we wasted an hour). The room is nice (simple and modern as per the pics) but we were without hot water for 75% of our stay. We did let staff know but it took a long time to be resolved. The hair dryer barely worked. The bed is uncomfortable and very much two joined singles. The bedding was too small (sheet and duvet) which revealed a stained protector and we came away with several bites which we can only assume were from the bed. Contact with staff was great and they were very responsive via online messaging. The room did its job but didn’t feel like a pleasant stay. If you can afford better then find somewhere better but for budget accommodation it was fine.

description:
Our place is located at the foot of the Galata Tower
Istiklal Avenue, Karakoy, tram and metro stops are within walking distance, and there is a supermarket right next to our place, as well as a shared terrace with a view

reviews.text: Her şey tek kelimeyle harikaydı, konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev tertemizdi, fotoğraflarda göründüğünden hiçbir farkı yoktu. Aynı zamanda konumu da çok iyiydi. Galata kulesinin hemen yanında harika bir teras manzarasına sahip çok güzel bir evdi. Muhit genel olarak canlıydı o yüzden kendimizi oldukça güvende hissettik. Ev sahibi iletişim konusunda ilgili ve yardımseverdi, bir ihtiyacımız olup olmadığını sorup yardımcı oldu. İstanbula bir daha gelirsek kesinlikle tekrar burayı tercih ederiz, herkese tavsiye ederim.

Galata kulesinin tam yanında etrafı açık ferah son derece temiz mükemmel konum otelden çıkınca Galata kulesi tam karşınızda ve her taraf mağaza restoran dolu ev sahibi çok duyarlı anında mesajlara cevap veriyor burayı herkese gönül rahatlığıyla önerebilirim.

Stayed here for a week. It was a great apartment with an amazing location right next to the Galata Tower. The rooftop amenity was an amazing experience and we got to enjoy the lovely night sky and view from the apartment which was amazing. Everything was clean and the host was super responsive and also offered an airport transfer for us which we paid for separately which was a generous offer. I don’t have anything bad to say about the apartment and service it was 10/10!

Öncelikle iletişim konusunda hiç sıkıntı yaşamadık. Biraz geç varacağımız için anahtarlar özel olarak teslim edildi. Oda küçük ama çok temizdi. Aynı fotoğraflardaki gibi. Sıcak su problemi yok. Eğer her gün bolca gezeyim sonrasında güzelce dinleneyim derseniz bence uygun bir seçim. Sadece Galata çevresi olduğu için biraz yokuş. Valiziniz ağırsa yürüyerek varmak uğraştırır :D Son olarak turistik yer olduğu için gündüz hep kalabalık ama pencereleri kapatırsanız içerisi çok ses almıyor. Geceleri de sakindi. Çevresinde bolca restoran ve mağaza var. Kısacası sıkılmayacağınız bir semt :) Tavsiye edilir.

We had a great stay at this place in Istanbul. It was clean, affordable, and in an excellent location, perfect for exploring the city. The host was very kind and always responsive to our questions. Highly recommended!

description: The apartment is located in the heart of Istanbul, at a central point connecting the old city and Beyoğlu areas. It's next to the Galata Bridge, perfect for walking to the old city, and near ‘Tünel’, the world’s 2nd oldest metro from 1875, which takes you to Istiklal Avenue in 90 seconds. A popular café is at the building's entrance. The flat includes AC, TV, Wi-Fi, a romantic indoor fireplace, hot water, and all other essential features for a comfortable stay.

reviews.text: I selected this apt for two reasons the location and the amenities. The location was great! Central with a lot of tourist places to see and good restaurants nearby. Unfortunately the amenities described did not really match . The apt described washer/dryer but there was only washer. It also described AC but the AC didn’t work and a repair had to be called in. Due to the electrical repair the kitchen malfunctioned and I was not able to use kitchen during my stay. Overall this place bare bones. If you are just looking for a place to crash a few days go for it but if you are looking for a longer stay apt I would say go somewhere else. Although I appreciated the host responding to the complaints I did not appreciate that a solution was not found regarding the kitchen. Also the towels were old and stained and even the bedsheets also were dirty so I would def not stay here again.

I'll start with the good things about this accommodation. The location is excellent, the apartment is large, and it was well-maintained before I moved in. However, it differs from the photos, and it definitely needs some repairs. But the worst part is the management. On Saturday, my internet connection was lost, and I was told that the landlord was conducting repairs and that everything would be back up and running the next day. However, it remained down for another three days, and they only started working on it after I contacted AirBNB support and demanded a refund and wanted to find another accommodation. They literally came running and fixed it in 20 minutes, amazing! It turned out that there was no problem with the provider, it was just a router issue. I missed 2 workdays because of these lazy people who didn't want to do their job, they left a terrible impression. I definitely recommend staying somewhere else, as there are many better options in this price range!

This apartment in Sultanahmet was a wonderful experience. The location is perfect restaurants, cafes, and all the historical sites are just a short walk away. The design of the apartment is stylish and modern, and it has everything you might need. You can make your coffee or tea in the kitchen, cook meals with the stove, microwave, or toaster, and there’s also a washing machine which is very convenient. The place is clean, spacious, and very comfortable. I truly enjoyed my stay here, it was an excellent choice. The meeting and greeting were also very warm and welcoming and professional. I would definitely recommend it for both comfort and location.

We stayed here for two weeks with our cat while we were in Istanbul for hospital appointments, and it genuinely felt like we were living in a Netflix movie. The high ceilings, stylish and slightly hipster interior, and having a café right downstairs gave us such a cool little Istanbul lifestyle for those two weeks. Everything in the apartment worked perfectly. We had no problems at all with the Wi-Fi, hot water or air conditioning. We also used pretty much everything — the washing machine, iron, stove, etc. — which made a big difference during a longer stay. But the absolute highlight is the location. The apartment is on Bankalar Caddesi, right next to SALT Galata. The moment you step outside, you are already in one of the most atmospheric parts of Istanbul. Every morning when we left and every evening when we came home, we felt like we were actually living the city rather than simply visiting it.

The apartment is in an exceptionally convenient location in terms of transport access: right by the tunnel leading to Istiklal Street, just 2 minutes from bus and tram stops, and about a 5-minute walk to the ferry. Personally, I had no issue with the trams and cars passing below the windows, as some other reviews mentioned—I actually enjoy the sounds of the city.
The apartment itself is a delight: high ceilings, huge windows, plenty of light, and a wonderful sense of space. From one of the windows, there’s a view of the Bosphorus, where you can watch the ferries go by. The apartment is impeccably clean, and the host and his assistant are always available and quick to help with any questions.
The staircase is beautiful, though if you’re traveling with luggage, be prepared to climb up to the 3rd or 4th floor. That said, Yunus, who welcomed us, was very kind and ready to assist with our bags.

description: Welcome to your stylish escape in the heart of Istanbul, located in the iconic Taksim360 development.

reviews.text:
5 stars without a doubt. If you’re planning to stay in Taksim, honestly don’t look further.
The apartment is centrally located in a very good building with security and a lift, which made the stay extremely comfortable and convenient. It’s also very close to Istiklal Street, so everything you need — restaurants, shopping, transport, and nightlife — is easily accessible.
What stood out most was the attention to detail. The hosts have genuinely thought of even the smallest things, and everything was exactly as shown in the pictures. The place was well maintained, comfortable, and felt professionally managed.
A special mention to the incredibly helpful staff. We had an issue with the washing machine during our stay, and they went completely out of their way to help by arranging for our clothes to be collected, washed, and delivered back to us. That level of service and care really made a difference.
Highly recommend this place and would happily stay here again.

Our recent stay at the Taksim 360 Residences in Beyoglu, hosted by Dose Apartments, was excellent. The apartment offered a beautiful city view overlooking Taksim, with a location that made everything incredibly convenient.
Local cafes, access to Istiklal Street, restaurants, shops, and even the taxi stand were all just steps away, which made our visit smooth and enjoyable.
This was our second time staying at a Dose Apartments property, and once again they delivered a great experience. The unit was cozy, thoughtfully designed, and furnished with good quality pieces that made it feel comfortable and inviting.
Everything was exceptionally clean, it smelled great, and the bed was very comfortable. The access-controlled building added an extra sense of safety, which we appreciated.
A special note of appreciation goes to the property manager, Berk, who provided outstanding support throughout our stay. He was attentive, helpful, and even assisted with luggage storage.
Highly recommend.

We had a wonderful stay, the apartment was spotless and exactly as advertised. Everything felt clean, well-maintained, and thoughtfully prepared for guests.
The beds were very comfortable, and the space was bright and sunny throughout the day. I especially loved the bay windows — they were perfect for sitting with a cup of coffee and people-watching in the mornings.
The host was responsive, polite, and easy to communicate with. They worked with me promptly on any questions or minor issues, which made the stay smooth and stress-free.
Another highlight was the building security. The personnel were attentive and professional, and I always felt safe during our stay.
Overall, this was a comfortable and pleasant place to stay, and I would definitely recommend it to others.

Perfect place to base ourselves for our Istanbul visit. The place is just minutes from İstiklal Street and Taksim Square, so everything was walkable. Our apartment was clean, modern, and well set up with fast WiFi and a Smart TV. Host team was responsive and check-in / check-out was smooth, even at odd hours. Would definitely stay here again 😄

Wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well equipped. The location was excellent and close to everything I needed. The host was very kind and helpful. I highly recommend this place and would gladly stay here again.

description: Our suite is centrally located. It's very close to restaurants and markets. The Sultanahmet Mosque and Hagia Sophia, Grand baazar are just a 7-10 minute walk away, and public transportation is just a 5-minute walk away.

reviews.text: Place is as described. Even a bit bigger than you would imagine. We like it because we don’t feel trapped in a little box. You receive nothing less than what is offered, the location worked perfect for us. Calm area. And Davut have proved to be the best Airbnb host we’ve ever met, and we’ve had some great ones. Ah! Let’s not forget it’s a great price. We are more than happy to recommend the place and to come back many more times.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! The apartment was lovely, clean, and had everything we needed for a comfortable vacation. The location was very convenient. A special thanks to the host, Davut, and his assistant, Hasan, for being incredibly helpful, kind, and hospitable. Davut even allowed us a flexible check-out time since our flight was late in the evening, which we highly appreciated. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting! 10/10

I stayed for 4 nights with kids (infants) and the house was awesome. The Hagia Sofia / blue mosque is walkable and close by . Ofcourse you have lot of restaurants / supermarkt nearby. Especially the host is very responsive and friendly. He is always reachable.
I would definitely recommend this place in terms of host , price and location.
Great stay at Davut’s place! The house was clean and comfortable, and Hasan was a very friendly and helpful host. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily come back!

I stayed here for a few days and had a wonderful experience. The place was very clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The gentleman working there and Mr. Davut were both very helpful, responsible, and kind.
I was extremely satisfied with my stay and would happily recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.

description: Just a few steps from Taksim Square, this beautifully designed home offers both comfort and style in the heart of Istanbul. The modern interior is thoughtfully furnished with high-quality amenities to ensure a relaxing stay. Enjoy the private jacuzzi room with a big-screen projector for cozy movie nights, or unwind in your own peaceful garden. Close to public transport and top tourist attractions, it's the perfect base for exploring the city.

reviews.text:
Bölgede pek çok noktada konaklamış biri olarak bu daireyi fotoğraf ve açıklamalarla oldukça tutarlı bulduğumu söyleyebilirim.
●Daha merkezî bir konum olamaz, zirâ Taksim meydanından 100 metre uzaktasınız. :)
●Bölgede gördüğüm en iyi dizayn edilmiş yeterli büyüklükte bir jakuziye ve kesintisiz sıcak suya sahip.
● Hava alınabilecek/sigara içilip oturulabilecek ufak şirin bir bahçeye sahip.
● Yatak odası büyüklüğü yeterli ve mobilyalar da gayet sıcak, yarı/modern ve hafif bohem bir ambiyans yaratıyor.
● Şahin Bey gâyet alakalı, sorulara hızlı yanıt veriyor ve çözüm üretiyor.
İlgililer için küçük dezavantajlar şunlar olabilir: bahçe katı olduğu için İnternet erişiminde bazı odalarda kesinti yaşayabilirsiniz. Bahçe, jakuzi odası ve giriş bölümünde sürekli çekiyor.
Banyo temiz ve duş alanı yeterli ancak bina tasarımı gereği biraz küçük.
Genel değerlendirme olarak; benzer olanakları sağlayan AirBNB'lere göre fiyat/performansı gayet iyi buldum ve yeniden konaklayabilirim.

Sahin was very kind and helpful during our stay. The place was lovely, clean and looks the same as in the photos. A great place for a weekend getaway! At this popular location, you still get the peaceful atmosphere inside the apartment and you get to explore around by foot. The only thing we didn't like was the bed because it's not comfortable at all so if you're staying a lot of days and need good nights of sleep, take that in consideration definitely.

taksim meydanına çok yakın, konumu gerçekten çok avantajlı. Ev sahibi oldukça ilgili ve yardımseverdi. Ev hem temiz hem bakımliydı özellikle jakuzi cok keyifliydi ve konaklamamı daha da özel kıldı. Bahçesi olması yeşillikler huzur vericiydi. Rahat ve konforlu bir ortam arıyorsanız kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Muhteşem bir konaklamaydı. Konum çok merkezi olmasına rağmen ev oldukça sessiz ve huzurluydu. Fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi her şey. Ütü masasından, wifi ağına kadar her şey düşünülmüş. Eksik diyebileceğim hiçbir şey yoktu. Jakuzi çok konforluydu. Extra yastık, yorgan mevcut. Lokasyon olarak hem yürüme mesafesi her yere hem de sipariş için uygun. Ev sahibi oldukça ilgili, anlayışlı ve hızlı dönüş sağlıyor. Kendimi evimde gibi hissettim.

Excellent location in Taksim Square. It's a little small but it is definitely a comfortable place to stay. The huge bathtub was exactly what we needed after all the running around in Istanbul. Close to metro and a ton of shopping. Lovely and sweet community cats greeted us with purrs and affection whenever we left and returned. Excellent place!

description: Modern 2-bedroom apartment in Moda, Kadıköy, located on a quiet street in a brand-new (2025) building. Features 1 double bed, 2 single beds, a bright living room, open kitchen, bathroom, and a balcony with a great view. Includes high-speed fiber internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, iron, vacuum, and full kitchenware. Elevator available. Just a 5-minute walk to metro, ferry, and public transport—perfect for families or remote work.

reviews.text: My stay was excellent. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and the host was professional and responsive. Highly recommended.”

The place is located on a quiet street, yet it’s still close to the ferry, as well as plenty of coffee shops and restaurants.
Everything was clean, the kitchen is well-equipped
The host were helpful throughout our stay and allowed us to stay a little longer in this apartment before our next check in

Nice, well located flat. The street is quiet but there’s a small supermarket and lots of restaurants within a 5-10 minute walk. Berk and Zisan were very helpful with resolving issues. Maybe worth noting that only one of the bedrooms has aircon.

Wonderfull experience to be staying at this place. It made our time in the city much cosier.
It was cold week when me and my friends traveled to Istanbul. So a lot of the times we just enjoyed coming home after a long exiting walk or just stay home and cook food when it was raining.
The apartment was comfortable for 4 people. Clean, homie and quiete.
Berk as a host was very helpful, he responded positively and quickly to all our requests.
Thanks!
Nice apartment, very comfortable and clean. Great location, close to metro and ferry. We really enjoyed our stay

reviews.text: I had a great stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect — close to shops, cafes, and public transport. The host was responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. Loved the view, and would stay again.

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was very easy to find and is conveniently located close to the city center, cafés, and restaurants. The place was exactly as shown in the photos, very clean, and well maintained. Berke was extremely helpful and responsive throughout our stay. We were very satisfied with everything and would definitely consider staying here again. Highly recommended!😊⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Daire yeni, temiz ve oldukça konforluydu. Yataklar çok rahattı ve özellikle Türkiye’de pek sık rastlanmayan elektrikli panjurlar bizim için büyük bir artı oldu. Almanya’da panjur kullanmaya alışkın olduğumuz için bu detay konaklama kalitemizi ciddi şekilde artırdı.
Konum da oldukça avantajlıydı. Kadıköy Çarşı’ya yaklaşık 200 metre mesafede, Kadıköy İstasyonu’na ise yürüyerek yaklaşık 10 dakikada ulaşılabiliyor. Binaya girişin PIN koduyla yapılması kendimizi güvende hissetmemizi sağladı.
Ev sahibiyle iletişim çok iyiydi. Tuvalet kâğıdımız bittiğinde hemen yardımcı olup yenisini getirdiler. Bu ilgileri için ayrıca teşekkür ederiz.
İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimizde gönül rahatlığıyla bu konaklamayı yeniden tercih ederiz. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederiz.

What an incredible stay! I spent a week here, and it was honestly one of the best Airbnb experiences I've ever had.
The hosts were absolutely wonderful—warm, kind, and incredibly responsive. They were always available whenever I needed anything and truly went above and beyond to make my stay as easy and enjoyable as possible. They even stored and transported my luggage for me, which was such a thoughtful gesture and something I really appreciated.
The apartment was spotless, beautifully maintained, and so comfortable. It felt like a home away from home. The location in Kadıköy was perfect—just a short walk to the ferries and surrounded by amazing restaurants, bars, and cafés. Everything I wanted to see and do was right at my doorstep, making it the ideal place to stay while exploring Istanbul.

Perfect stay in Kadıköy! The apartment was spotless, beautiful, and very comfortable—felt just like home for our family.
Berk was an amazing host: super responsive, welcoming, and always going the extra mile (even helping with parking).
Note: street parking is very difficult, so check with Berk about garage options.

description: Welcome to Bomonti 42 Suites, your cozy two-bedroom city getaway! Each suite is designed with modern style and comfort, featuring a fully equipped kitchen and soft, high-quality bedding for a relaxing stay. Just a 7-minute walk from the nearest subway station, it’s easy to explore the city’s top sights, restaurants, and shops. Perfect for both work and family vacations, Bomonti 42 Suites is your home in the heart of the city!

reviews.text: Burada 3 gün geçirdik. Evin konumu harika metro istasyonuna oldukça yakın. Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi ve tertemizdi. Evde ihtiyacımız olabilecek her şey düşünülmüş. Kendimizi çok rahat hissettik. Ev sahibiyle iletişim konusunda hiçbir sıkıntı yaşamadık. En ufak ihtiyacımızda hemen hallettiler. Konaklaması oldukça keyifli bir yerdi. İstanbula yolu düşen herkese burayı tavsiye ediyoruz.

We had a great stay and truly enjoyed our time at the apartment. The place was comfortable, well located, and suitable for our needs.
The host was very helpful and responsive whenever we needed anything, which made our stay much easier and more pleasant. We really appreciated the support and quick assistance throughout our stay.
Overall, it was a very positive experience, and this definitely won’t be our last stay. We would happily recommend this place and look forward to coming back again.

Ev fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi temiz ve düzenliydi. Uzun süreli konaklamamızda kendi evimizde gibi hissettirdi. Evin konumu çok merkezi hem çevresinde pek çok olanak barındırıyor hem de başka konumlara ulaşım açısından çok kolaylık sağlıyor. Ev sahipleri, konaklamamızın nasıl gittiği herhangi bir sorunumuzun olup olmadığıyla ilgili her zaman ilgi ile yaklaştı ve çabuk çözümler ile gönlümüzü kazandılar. Bizim için güzel bir konaklama ve deneyim oldu. Yine bu bölgede işimiz olduğunda tercih edeceğimiz ve tavsiye edebileceğimiz bir adres artık bizim için.
Emir was a great host and the location was great.
herşey dört dörtlüktü . evin yeri temizliği , düzeni , anlatılan talimatlar kolay ve konforlu bı konaklama sağladı.

description:
This beautiful and stylish apartment is the perfect retreat for solo travelers or couples who want to discover the excitement of Moda.
Within walking distance of the subway and ferry piers, it is very easy to get around the city. Discover nearby restaurants, cafes and shops that showcase the vibrant local culture.

reviews.text: Beautifully decorated and very artsy. The place felt comfortable and home-like. It was spacious, clean, and in a great location. Overall, it was a very good stay.

Tam ilanda göründüğü gibiydi; temiz, düzenli ve ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her şey düşünülmüştü. Konum oldukça uygundu. Tramvayla gelmek ayrıca çok kolay, eve yakın bir durak var. Ev sahibi de çok ilgiliydi — giriş öncesi iletişim hızlıydı ve her sorumuza nazikçe yardımcı oldu.
Kısacası çok keyifli bir deneyimdi.
We loved our stay in Kadiköy thanks to Mustafas appartment. We loved the location and everything is as it is described here. Would definitely love to come back and recommend this place to friends.
Harika bir konumda oldukça rahat bir ev. Mustafa’nın ev sahipliği, iletişimi ve evle ilgili desteği süperdi, memnunuz. Teşekkürler

The apartment is ideal for one/two person travelling, have all the amenities needed. Host is very responsive and easy going. The only drawback is that it can be a bit noisy due to its perfect location - advantage and disadvantage. Especially from Thu-Sun of the week, the street is quite noisy. However the apartment is close to everywhere, supermarkets, bars, restuarants and public transportation. Would stay again.

description:
Would you like a perfect stay in the heart of Istanbul's iconic Taksim district?

Enjoy a stylish room in the heart of Istanbul’s iconic Taksim district. This modern space is just a 1-minute walk from Istiklal Street and Taksim Square, surrounded by museums, landmarks, shopping, nightlife, and public transportation.

Important Note: Nevizade is a lively entertainment area. On Friday and Saturday nights, street noise and music may continue late. Guests seeking a quiet stay should consider this.

reviews.text: Muhiti kolaylıkla bulduk ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi, lokasyon olarak istiklal caddesine çok yakın olması ayrı bi avantaj oldu. Fiyat performans olarak memnun kaldık. Oda temiz ve düzenliydi. Tercih edilesi bulduk.

temiz ve olduğu konuma göre guvenliydi daha once de konakladim ve tamamen hoşuma giden bir yer oldu ev sahibi sorunlarımı hızlıca çözüp yanıtladı bu en çok hoşuma giden şey oldu teşekkür ederim ve herkese tavsiye ederim ☺️👍🏻

The Airbnb was in a very good spot, we had to walk for 2min to be in Istiklal street, and 13min to Galata tower. Also the host was very reactive and answers fast to our messages. The only thing is that the area at night doesn’t really feel safe, but as we were 2 friends we managed and we didn’t actually had any kind of bad situations. I would definitely book it again.

Great stay in the middle of Taksim, super close to everything. Price is spot on, very much worth it.
It was clean and they kindly allowed us to store our luggage so we can move around easy before our flight.

Definitely a good price but was a bit misleading. It was dark and tiny which I didn’t mind but looked a lot bigger in person. It looks very fresh in the pictures but was actually very run down with mold on the ceiling in the bathroom.

description:
🌟 Welcome to this modern and stylish 2 Bedroom Apartment located in Maslak Sarıyer, within the prestigious Maslak 1453 Complex.

The apartment offers a spacious living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and access to on-site facilities including a gym, sauna, and steam room.

🧹Daily complimentary housekeeping service is included for your comfort.

✨ We look forward to hosting you and wish you a pleasant stay!

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay in Citadines! The hôtel apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great and made it very easy to explore the city.
The host was very welcoming, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. Everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out, and we felt very comfortable during our time there.
Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you for a lovely stay!

We had a wonderful stay with Genius Living. I stayed here with my parents and aunt, and they were all extremely happy and comfortable throughout the trip.
The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described, and the team was responsive and helpful from check-in until departure.
The location was also very convenient for exploring Istanbul.
We truly appreciated the hospitality and would happily stay with them again in the future.
Highly recommended for families visiting Istanbul!

Amazing place, just like the photos. It was so good to be outside the city centre and have an entire apartment. Few things deserve flagging:
1. the staff at the reception were super attentive and helpful
2. the beds were very comfortable and the linen so clean and new
3. the gym is equipped with excellent machines
4. the balcony is completely private and spacious, part of the apartment complex
5. there is daily cleaning offered, no fuss made, it really makes a difference

The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and well-located. The check-in process was smooth and the communication with the host was easy and professional. The place had everything we needed for a pleasant stay. I would definitely recommend this property and would be happy to stay here again

The stay was overall very good. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a nice location. Everything about the place and the stay was great.
However, there were a couple of small issues. The heater in my room was not working, and the heater in the bathroom also didn’t work. Also, a deposit was required for the stay. In addition, the check-in was done at the reception, while I had requested a self check-in option.
Aside from these points, the apartment itself and the stay were pleasant.

description: Modern apartment in Kadıköy featuring 2 bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, living area, and TV—offering both comfort and privacy. Includes a compact kitchen, air conditioning, and elevator access. Located within walking distance to cafés, restaurants, markets, and public transport. Ideal for families or groups seeking a clean, comfortable, and centrally located stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
My daughter and myself had such a restful stay at Berk's modern loft apartment located in the popular Kadıköy neighborhood in Istanbul.
It was quiet, the beds are very comfortable, the bathrooms are modern, and with lots of amenities.
As we were between a hotel stay and getting on another plane- being able to do laundry was a game changer.
The dishwasher was wonderful and unusual with a kitchenette. The cooking space is small but this makes sense since one is surrounded by literally hundreds of amazing restaurants and cafes. Even the cafeteria-styled restaurants in this area are hearty delicious with massive portions at low prices.
This space is more like two studios with au suite bathrooms connected by a kitchenette. Great option for privacy for two couples or a family with kids.
Only two observations:
Though there is an elevator one still has to do two sets of stairs.
This is a converted attic space so the ceiling is unusual and low in parts.
Would stay again definitely.

Konum mükemmel. Kadıköy çarşıya, yeme-içme mekanlarına yürüme mesafesinde. Giriş çıkış son derece kolay, evi bulmak da aynı şekilde. Resimlerdeki gibi düzenli ve temiz konforlu bir evdi. Klimalardan birinin İki kişilik yatak odasında değil iki odayı birleştiren mutfak alanında olduğunu ve odaya girdiğimde çatı katının vermiş olduğu sıcaklığı görünce klimanın serinletmeyeceğini düşündüm ve bu beni gerdi( Sıcaklık hissi kişisel bir sağlık sorunumla alakalı) Ev sahibine yazdığımda klimanın yeterli geleceğini, gelmezse de bana bir vantilatör tedarik edebileceklerini söyledi. Bir süre sonra vantilatörü istemeye karar verdim ve hemen getirdiler. Ancak gece gerçekten dedikleri gibi oda yeterince serinledi ve ilk günümüzün ilk saatleri haricinde vantilatöre ihtiyaç kalmadı. Ne sorsam, ne istesem hızla ve büyük nezaketle karşılık verdiler, çıkış saati konusunda da sağ olsunlar yardımcı oldular. Neticede son derece tavsiye ederim ve tekrar kalırım.

A perfect, top-floor pad in one of the coolest, most balanced neighborhoods I've ever visited. The space was bright and clean with quirky architecture, plus views of the surrounding buildings and the water. The neighborhood was alive yet safe. Bustling yet intimate, communal. There are people out at all hours, but I never felt as though I needed to put my wallet in my front pocket. When you need sanctuary, the apartment is quiet and well insulated from the action. It's 2 blocks from the water, a few blocks from the ferry and metro, and nestled between so many restaurants, bodegas, vendor markets, and hidden streets with their own character, that I doubt I managed to see them all. I forgot to set up cell service and was able to do it at a nearby store; brought a broken camera by accident and was able to find a replacement at a nearby antique store. There's also a currency exchange nearby. Hosts were responsive and understanding. I'd love to stay here again and highly recommend it.

Berk was a very kind and helpful host. The apartment is in a very central and convenient location in Kadıköy. It was clean, tidy, and comfortable for our stay. The check-in and check-out process was smooth as well. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Kadıköy. Thank you, Berk!

Staying at Berk’s place was honestly a 10/10 experience. Communication with him was excellent, very responsive, even before coming. We were scared at first since this is our first booking without any comments and we think this is a brand new listing as all amenities inside were clean and looked unused. But we were pleasantly surprised to see that the listing is exactly the same as reality. Berk provided everything, and was responsive and quick when we needed anything else.
We recommend adding more hangers for more guests, and more towels for longer stays. Other than that, we had a perfect stay, the location was close to everything and we couldn’t ask for a better place. If we come back to Kadikoy, we hope to stay at Berk’s again.

description: My place offers a unique experience of Istanbul on the Bosphorus. You will like the light and calm of the neighborhood. If you prefer to get a different experience of Istanbul-one that has not seen full gentrification. The apartment is on a small dead-end street, overlooking a magnificent garden and harboring a view of the Bosphorus. Multiple public transport options to the city center. Ferries offer a fantastic way to get to the city center.

reviews.text: Suna's place is absolutely wonderful. It exceeded our expectations. The living room is an awesome space that has floor to ceiling windows overlooking a beautiful Ottoman mansion with mature landscaped gardens AND a balcony with Bosphorus view where the tankers honk their fog horns as they steam by. As if that doesn't wow enough, as you walk into the bedrooms at the other end of the flat the view is of is of the forest and the foliage of a ginormous Magnolia tree fills the window. The evening sun here was beautiful. The flat is really spacious and really nicely decorated with thoughtful and stylish touches. You can tell Suna has put her heart into it. The kitchen is more than fully equipped and the Moroccan style bathroom is huge with great powerful walk in shower. Suna was generous and quick to respond to any queries on the phone and we met her father who was on hand living nearby who was also perfectly helpful. We were visiting family in Sariyer so the location was perfect for us, but we also loved the neighbourhood of Buyukdere and walking the steep hills and exploring the streets full of old wooden houses. It was Super easy to get a bus from the street outside to lots of places including the metro ten minutes away. We also took the river boat from nearby Sariyer to Eminonou which took about an hour and was an epic way to get to the city centre. My dream air bnb. I can thoroughly recommend it.

Lovely apartment with fantastic view over the bosporus and the neighbouring garden. Very quiet so you can relax and forget the hustle and bustle outside. Excellent location, public transport in front of the door, and two local central areas with everything you need in walking distance. The apartment is very comfortable. It also has a filter for drinking water so no need to buy bottled water. Suna's dad welcomed us and showed us around and both Suna and her dad were quick to answer questions here and there throughout our stay. Definitely recommended.

Fotoğraftakilerden çok daha güzel bir ev. Hem salon hem odalar yeşilliğe ve muhteşem ağaçlara bakıyor. İstanbul'da olup da, İstanbul'un bina kalabalığında hissetmemek büyük bir ayrıcalık ve bu evin en büyük özelliği gerçekten bu.
İkincisi, salondan denizi görebiliyorsunuz. Gemileri duyuyorsunuz. Her gün Sarıyer'de, Büyükdere'de yürüyüş yaptık. Bu 2 özellik kadar güzel olan bir şey daha; evin kendi bir ruhu var. Her yerde sanat ve kitaplar... Sadece tablolardan bahsetmiyorum, renk seçimleri, yer karoları bile özgün. Bu insana, bu evi, kendi eviymiş gibi hızlıca benimsemesini sağlıyor.
Biz, kaldığımız günler dışarıdan hem market hem de yemek siparişi verdik, adresin bulunamaması gibi bir durum yok. Kendimiz de bolca yemek yaptık. Yemek için gerekli tüm malzemeler var. Hatta hepsi çok şık!
Suna hanım etrafta gidilebilecek mekanlarla ilgili öncesinde bize detaylıca bilgi verdi. Tüm önerilerini denedik, harikaydı! Zaten kendisi oldukça iletişime açık ve pozitif bir insan!
Oldukça kullanışlı bir ev. 4 kişi rahatlıkla kalabilir. Yatak odası dışındaki odadaki yataklı kanepe de çok rahat. Evde TV ve perde yok. Ama zaten dışarıdan sizi görebilecek bir kimse de yok. Yine de rahatsız olursanız, panjurları kapatabilirsiniz. Biz pek gerek duymadık. Daireye ulaşmak için merdivenle 2. kata çıkıyorsunuz. Zorlayıcı değil. Kış sezonu gidecekler için, ev kombili.
Suna hanım'ın minik ama baya sağlam bir hoparlörü var, böylece bolca müzik, yemek, deniz havası, ağaçlar, sahilde yürüyüş, tekrar ağaçlar, balkona gelen kedi, yenilen balıklar, börek, kazandibi, muhallebi şeklinde bir Sarıyer maceramız oldu. Herkese öneririz :)

Suna is a great host and location of the apartment is amazing.
The apartment itself made me feel like I was at home and it had everything I needed for my 1 month stay.
Kids playground is 2 mins away, tons of places to eat were also very close, as well as a supermarket.
Neighbors were very friendly. Parking was never a problem.
Suna was available via messengers / Airbnb chat whether it was a question about apartment or things to do or where to eat.

Speaking as a couple who spent one week in Istanbul, Suna’s place is a spacious and lovely apartment with gorgeous views of the Bosphorus and overlooking a beautiful garden. Suna was an excellent and communicative host and made everything very easy for us (her father even came to the Metro to pick us up after a long day of travel!). If you’re planning to visit the centre of Istanbul, take note that it is quite far away (generally 60-75 minutes by transit, door-to-door) although it is well-served by public transit and the weekday ferry is a beautiful way to get there. A 10-minute walk to the lovely small town of Sariyer and a perfect getaway for those who don’t want the hustle and bustle of living right in town.

description:
COMFORTABLE ACCOMMODATION, CENTRAL LOCATION, AND ONLY 10–12 MINUTES FROM THE AIRPORT

Our new hotel, located in the city center, offers a comfortable stay with its luxurious, modern and hygienic rooms. Restaurant and cafe services are available. Our rooms have air conditioning, a 42-inch TV, tea, coffee, and water.
We offer 24/7 reception, free WiFi, paid airport transfer, quiet rooms, and early check-in/late check-out.

Dear guests, we hope you have a pleasant and comfortable stay.”

reviews.text: Great place to stay. It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was welcoming and responsive, and the location near the airport was very convenient. Highly recommended.

The apartment was clean and exactly as shown in the photos. The location was easy to find, and the neighborhood was lively and convenient. The host was very helpful and responsive throughout my stay. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it.

The staff was very nice, friendly and profesional. Easy check in. Communication with the host spot on. The room was simple but clean and looked after, the same as discribed on the pictures. Definitly recommend!
Very nice hotel, conveniently located near to the airport. Offers airport transfer as well which makes things easier.
