It was a pleasent stay for 1 night near the airport, place was clean and pretty much great overall. Room is a bit small but its very practical for a stay near the airport

description: Ou 'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.

reviews.text:
Appartement fidèle aux photos, très bien situé pour découvrir Istanbul, proche T1 et embarcadères.
A savoir que l'appartement n'est pas réellement prévu pour manger sur place, pas de table / chaises ni de fourchettes, ce qui en soit n'est pas si dérangeant : on mange plutôt a l'extérieur.
Bon accueil et disponibilité au rendez vous
Muhit olarak en güzel yerlerden fiyat performans olarak değerlendirmek lazım iki yatak odası vardı tek klima yeterliydi İstanbul geceleri serin olduğu için inada çok gerek yok
Konaklama için teşekkür ederiz bilinçli ev sahibi geri dönüşleri hızlı ve güvenilir konum olarak mükemmel tavsiye ederim

Mustafa bey gerçekten ilgiliydi esnek giriş sağladı teşekkür ederiz kendisine tekrardan. Konum olarak da tramvay duraklarına çok yakın Galataport’a çok yakın biz altı kişi konakladık çok memnun kaldık. Lavabo biraz küçüktü ama olsun işimizi gördük hallettik. Ek olarak yanınıza kağıt havlu ve havlu alabilirsiniz
konumu cok güzel

description: Luxury designer duplex in the heart of Galata with breathtaking views of the Galata Tower and the Bosphorus. This unique apartment features a fireplace, private jacuzzi, and two exclusive terraces reserved solely for guests. Enjoy outdoor dining, relax around the fire pit, and experience custom-designed interiors that blend comfort, style, and the historic charm of Istanbul. The perfect setting for a memorable stay above the city.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at Tunahan’s place in Istanbul. The view was absolutely amazing, and the location was perfect. Close to everything and very convenient for exploring the city. Tunahan was a great host, very helpful and welcoming. He even helped us carry our luggage upstairs and arranged a taxi for our departure. We really appreciated his kindness and hospitality. I would definitely recommend staying here. Thank you, Tunahan, for a great stay!

The place is exactly as you see in the pictures, and the location is fantastic. There are plenty of restaurants, shops, markets, and bars nearby, making it very convenient.
The building and the apartment are truly a piece of art. Tunahan is a great host and speaks English very well.
Definitely recommend staying here!

It was just amazing the house was perfectly clean very nice and comfy it has a very nice terrace and a beautiful view we had all things we wanted the location is very good everything is around restaurants super markets everything you need, Turuhan is a very nice an a kind man he very helpful and he responds promptly and quickly we really appreciate that.
Highly recommend the accommodation.
Thank you very much Turuhan for everything you’re a blessing 🙏🏻

I had a wonderful stay at Tunahan’s apartment in Istanbul. I really enjoyed the house, especially the beautiful terrace and the excellent location, which made it easy to explore the city. Tunahan is a true Superhost: friendly, helpful, and professional. He responded very quickly every time I contacted him and was always attentive to my needs. I highly recommend staying at his apartment and would gladly return in the future.

Galata’daki deniz manzaralı evde harika bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Türk hamamının keyfini çıkarmak çok özeldi. Tunahan son derece ilgili ve misafirperver bir ev sahibi. Binanın tarihi dokusu konaklamaya ayrı bir güzellik katıyor. Ev hem çok merkezi bir konumda hem de metro, tramvay, Galata Kulesi ve Galataport’a yürüme mesafesinde. Manzara, konfor ve konumun birleşimi sayesinde unutulmaz bir deneyim yaşadım. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim. 👍

description:
Great view of the Bosphorus and a perfect central location. The M4 Metro, Marmaray, Ferry Piers, Metrobus, the Bull Statue, and Kadıköy Pier are 350 meters away from all central transportation options.

Stunning Bosphorus view and excellent central location, 350 meters from all central transportation options: M4 Metro, Marmaray, Ferry Piers, Metrobus, Bull Statue, Kadıköy Pier

reviews.text:
Anyone considering staying here should know that this is a very crowded and unclean area of Istanbul, though there are cleaner, more pleasant areas nearby with easy access to public transportation.
The apartment and building smelled strongly of cat urine, and there was cat feces in several areas. The host did not disclose that the elevator was out of order, despite the apartment being on the fourth floor with a narrow spiral staircase. The washing machine is also shared, and we couldn't use it upon arrival because someone else was already using it.
The apartment looks much nicer in the photos than it actually is, and even the advertised view is misleading—the actual view is mostly blocked by surrounding buildings.
The host was not rude, but I personally felt uncomfortable in the apartment and did not get a good feeling from the space. My main issue is that important details that would have been dealbreakers for me were not disclosed upfront. Guests should be given accurate information

Right in the centre of bars and restaurants which was really convenient! Though I recommend bringing earplugs especially on the weekend.
Super clean and tidy, really comfortable bed and great communication from the host.
We didn’t mind it, but be aware that this Airbnb is on the top floor with a broken elevator.
Overall a great place to stay!
Temiz ferah ev konum çok basit

It's right in the heart of Kadikoy, and I loved experiencing all of the town while staying here. If u are not bothered with stairs, you can experience the best sunset view of the whole Istanbul. Really nice stay, good price. Loved it.

Gündoğdu bey çok iyi bşr ev sahibi, herşey yazıldığı ve fotolarda görüldüğü gibiydi, temizlik ve hijyen çok iyiydi, klima çalışıyordu, olması gerrken tüm imkanlar vardı, çok memnun kaldım, iklnci kez Gündoğdu beyin bu evinde kaldım, her iki konaklamam da çok iyiydi, beklentimi fazlasıyla karşıladı, teşekkürler.

description: Iconic Galata Living! Stay right next to the Galata Tower with a stunning tower view from your window. Located in the heart of Beyoğlu, our authentic & elegant apartment features 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 modern bathrooms, a cozy living room, and full AC. Just steps away from Karaköy, Istiklal Street, Metro & Tram. Perfect central base for families and groups to explore Istanbul. Welcome to your stylish home!

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at the flat near Galata Tower. The apartment was lovely, clean, comfortable, and very well located in the heart of Istanbul. Many of the city’s historic landmarks are within walking distance, and the excellent access to public transport, including the tram and ferry, made exploring the city incredibly easy.
What made our stay even more enjoyable was our host, Ezgi. She was extremely kind, generous, and welcoming. She always responded very quickly to our questions, both before and during our stay, and kindly provided everything we asked for.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. A fantastic location, a comfortable home, and a wonderful host!

Very friendly, responsive, and caring host. We were even able to leave our luggage at the apartment before check in.
Right under the Galata tower. Not so quiet because Istanbul does not sleep early. But it didn’t bother us.
Supermarket, restaurant, cafe, and many other shops within the walking distance (2-3 min).
30 min walking distance to Ayasofya, grand bazar, and Taksim square.
Very clean apartment with extra towels, bed sheets, and blankets if you want to change.

Well.. I was skeptical at first as we were the 1st guest in this new to Air bnb place but Ezgi assured me that the place will exceed our expectations.
Well it really did.
Clean and ample space in the apartment with very responsive and friendly hosts.
Right in the centre of Galata with a great view of the tower itself from atleast 2 bedrooms.
Well equiped and smart kitchen with a spacious lounge and good sized bedrooms with tastefully done decor.
Though it did get a little noisy at night but thats something very much expected if you intend to stay in city centre.
Over all - a great stay at a great place and good hosts.
Looking forward to staying again.
Highly recommended
Thank you Oner and Ezgi

Ezgi’s place was a fantastic base to explore Istanbul from! 6 of us fit comfortably in the apartment, it was spacious and comfortable. It’s in a great location, right by the Galata tower. The hosts are very responsive and check in was super easy :). Thank you!

We had an amazing stay! The apartment was spotless, beautifully maintained, and exactly as shown in the photos. From the moment we arrived, it felt warm, cozy, and truly like a second home. Everything we needed was available, and we felt comfortable throughout our stay.
I highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting the area. A very special thanks to Önder for being such a kind, welcoming, and helpful host. He was always responsive, thoughtful, and made sure we had everything we needed. He is genuinely one of the best hosts we’ve ever had the pleasure of dealing with. Thank you, Önder, for your outstanding hospitality. We would be happy to stay here again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
I stayed in Mustafa’s place for 1 month and it was perfect! The location is in between Pera & Kasımpaşa and is more residential & quiet, but only a 5-minute walk to various shops, restaurants and sites in Beyoğlu. 15- minute walk to Galata Tower & Istiklal Street. I also easily walked to
Cihangir and up to Dolmabahçe Palace. Though there are other transpo options.
There are a few markets close by (5 minute walk); A101 had everything İ needed. Tepebaşı hill is a hike, but good for cardio haha. There are other ways to walk/find a taxi, too.
The place was comfortable and İ had plenty of space to work as well as relax. The Wifi was very strong! And having a washer available was worth the price alone haha. Other features this place has that others usually don’t: a large refrigerator, 4-burner cooktop and dishwasher.
Mustafa is very helpful and messaged me recommendations of things to see& always answered quickly when I had a question. He even hailed a taxi for me when I checked out.

Mustafa is responsive however, here are a list of issues I experience during this trip.
- construction for the last 2 weeks , constant noise for 8 hrs a day
- mold in bathroom (Mustafa claimed this formed during my stay, I have pictures with timestamps that prove otherwise)
- broken cabinet in bedroom, broken or almost broken chairs
- kitchen sink clogs constantly, even after he had me use the drano stuff, I still had issues after a day or so
- I had to clean the vacuum because it wasn't clean, it was very very very disgusting to clean (the filter was clogged, it wasn't sucking until I fixed it)
- some cabinets all have his stuff, not much room for ours
- exposed outlet in bathroom (you can see wires)
- bidet in toilet not fully working, half pressure
- kitchen stove, only 2 burners work automatically after you fiddle with it, need to use a match for others
Maybe the other positive reviews are for people who only stayed a few days, but if you are staying a month, please don't.

Mustafa was an excellent host: always responsive, and accommodating. The apartment is exactly as described. The linens are clean, the shower is hot, and you have everything you need.
I especially liked the neighbourhood. Very close to Galata (a bit of a hill up, which I appreciate, but very close), and yet very local. You get the best of both worlds.
Highly recommended.

Wonderful stay. The flat is very cozy and feels like home. It’s warm, a great kitchen for cooking, charming decor, and very quiet at night. The internet was solid, and the bed was comfortable. Mustafa was an excellent host. He was always quick to communicate and ask if I needed anything, and even met me for a late evening check in. The location is really nice, close to Taksim and the metro, and easy to get anywhere in the city. I’d highly recommend Mustafa’s flat!

A+++ vibes and Mustafa was extremely helpful and responsive. Great natural light, comfortable, felt like home immediately. Great balance between peaceful neighborhood and walkability. Open your windows to let in a beautiful symphony of Mosque chants a few times a day if you like. The bakery right next door is as good as it smells and is open all the time. Great soup and durum options just around the corner. Bus stop just down the street, very easy public transport here.
More of a true local feel than you’re going to get if you stay too close to Taksim or Galata.
Cute, lively tribe of cats and kittens next door.
Highly, highly recommend!

description: Studio of Pera Residence are glorious and have an area of 75 sqm.Tastefully decorated with modern furniture, Pera Residence's Studios have a marvellous design, relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.text: Place is as shown in photos, staff at front desk are very helpful and polite. Ideal location, 2 mins walk to istiklal street and 2 mins walk opposite way to main road. WiFi is pretty fast. The place could be a bit cleaner tho everything was clean but bedsheets did have stains and wall paint was chipping down to cement. Only one inconvenience was the address and host responsiveness the address on Airbnb is wrong and took me two streets down to another hotel took me about 20 mins after getting out of cab to find the Airbnb and I messaged host multiple times to get exact address to which he never responded.

Pera Apartment is actually a hotel with a front desk. The location is superb, just steps away from Istiklal Street and surrounded by great cafes. The staff is very friendly, and the check-in was impressively fast. The rooms are spacious.
However, the interior needs urgent
renovation. There were mold stains on the walls, and the bathroom hygiene was disappointing - the shower seals were yellowed and stained. For this price point, I expected a much cleaner environment. Cleanliness is a top priority for me, so I couldn't give it 5 stars

Great location. The apartment is spacious and has been beautifully designed. The presence of the elevator was very welcome. We appreciated the full size mirrors, the curtains - as they managed to block well the light - and the big terrace.
The best part though was Murat, the concierge who tried his best to fix the shortcomings in the apartment. He also helped us with several orders from online Turkish shops when we encountered unexpected difficulties.
Unfortunately the very first impression was not a good one: the exterior kitchen wall was damp, the curtains were filthy, the bed lamps were missing, the terrace door was not closing completely and had a cracked window pane, the shower hose was almost broken. The once beautiful furniture set shows signs of dirt and old age.
Air conditioning wasn’t cooling properly in the beginning and it was very noisy.
The TV didn’t have Netflix/HBO apps.
The internet was terribly slow.
The apartment was incredibly noisy at night, till around 2 am despite being oriented towards the back of the building, away from the main streets.
Such a beautifully designed interior in such a perfect location should be properly maintained and ready to welcome tourists. Murat was incredibly helpful but there were constantly things to mend and still not all the issues were solved until our departure.

Konumundan dolayı fiyatı oldukça yüksek ama sunulan hizmetin daha kaliteli olması gerektiğini düşünüyorum. En azından içeriğinde 0.5 litrelik su ve 1-2 adet çikolata bulunan karşılama paketi olabilir. Odada kullan at terlik, jakuzi için köpük topları olması gerektiğini ve odada sunulan bir hizmet varsa bunun konuk gelmeden önce verimli çalıştığından emin olunması gerektiğini düşünüyorum (Yerden ısıtma, IPTV). Televizyonda bulunan hiçbir özelliği verimli bir şekilde kullanamadık ve pes ettik. Odanın konforu, genişliği, banyonun genişliği ve temizliği iyiydi. Yatak konforlu ve oda rahatça uyumak için uygundu.

Konum harika ev temiz rahat kullanışlı ev sahibi hızlı ve anlayışlı istanbulda gezmek isteyen kesinlikle burada kalmalı. Yatak rahattı camı kapatınca ses yoktu mutfak malzemeleri yeterliydi ve tabiki temizdi teşekkürler pera

description:
This 1BR apartment is located at the heart of city’s coolest neighbourhood ''Moda'' walking distance to Kalamış Coast, shops, restaurants, famous bars, markets and all transportation. Just a 5 minutes walk to the famous “Boğa Heykeli”.

- Designed with taste, this apartment will be ideal for anyone who is seeking comfort, a “home like” atmosphere, accessibility to major tourist attractions.

-Self check-in is also available using the password
-The sofa is prepared for the third person.

reviews.text: Deniz and Gamze are very nice hosts. The communication was perfect- easy and fast. The apartment is in the centre of Kadiköy which is nice if you wanna go to bars, restaurants and clubs in the evening. At the same time the apartment is located to the backyard side of the building so no loud street voices. The apartment is as described in the pictures, not super new and might need a renovation soon. But overall its a very comfy place with a very good value for money.

Stayed for 13 days... Entry was smooth. Picture perfect place to stay. 1st floor, you can not use lift for this floor.
A major problem is drinking water. You have to buy it. It is hard to buy drinking water if someone stays for a long time!
The cleaning service was provided for only once within these 13 days. Also, there was some problem with commode, sometimes few drops of water coming out of commode causing terrific situation.
Overall it was nice. Everyone was responsive for any help. Enjoyed staying there. 👍🏻👍

Great location in Kadiköy, Deniz and his team were very helpful at all times. The place was nice but needs maintenance. The AC wasn’t working properly. The kitchen was not very welcoming, just few frying pans and small cutlery so don’t expect to be able to cook anything; big fridge! That’s a plus!. The bathroom is a little dated and in general the whole apartment, the picture on the wall and decorative details needs to be replaced except the rug. The disappointing part is that the pictures don’t reflect the reality of the place. We would recommend Deniz to update the photos in their ad. Still, it’s a good place for the money.

The ladies working there were lovely and very helpful and the location was great. But the studio itself had many negatives and the pictures weren’t accurate. The bathroom had many issues. It was in desperate need of an update, the sink wouldn’t drain properly, the toilet wouldn’t stop running and sounded like a waterfall. Very difficult to sleep with such a loud noise. They did try to fix it twice but it ended up worse so we gave up. The wardrobe in the bedroom was falling apart and the mirror on the door was broken. Again we mentioned it and they put a sticker over it to cover up. The kitchen could have been a bit better equipped. For the location I would recommend, but unfortunately not the studio itself.

The apartment is well located but wasn’t as nice as the pictures. It was very humid and unclean.
The mirror in the room was broken and there wasn’t any AC in the bedroom only in the living room.

description: The apartment's location is close to the historical Fatih Mosque, which is an Islamic architectural masterpiece, and the Golden Horn (Haliç), one of the most important values of Istanbul, by walking. There is easy access to Fevzipaşa Street from the building, where you can discover unique and authentic local products and various cafes and restaurants.

reviews.text:
Excellent appartment! I booked this appartment for our family reunion: 5 people of 3 generations stayed together during 1 week and nevertheless there was enough space and privacy for all us.
It looks exactly the same as on photos, well furnished, the kitchen has all required devices and dishes for home cooking.
Location is great! Many sightseeing places are reachable by foot. It is in 1 min walk from Fatih Mosk and a small bazaar next to it, in 7- max 10 min walk downstreet you will reach the Golden Horn with its spectacularious view at the city. On Wednesdays there is a market on the street. They start molding market constructions from early morning, and finish by cleaning works next night. For us this was not a problem.
The hosts: Faruk and Rashid were both very responsive, immediately answering and providing support when needed. Rashid also helped us to organise a taxi (at a reasonable price) to airport at 3 a.m. and stayed in contact with us all the time. Grateful for this!

We are a Malaysian family of 5 with 3 grown daughters. We all absolutle looooove Faruk's place!! Definitely staying there next time!
SUPERB LOCATION: The beautiful Fatih Mosque, shops, wednesday bazaar & nice restaurants are at your doorstep. It is not a tourist area so they offer local prices. Very near to bus stops so takes only 15 mins to get to Sultanahmet tourist areas & Balat. Saves time & money!
SUPERB APARTMENT: Gorgeous apartment & nice layout giving lots if space for family. Ultra clean, comfy beds, bedding & linens, 2 sofas convertible to beds, kitchen with high quality appliances & complete and high quality tableware, modern furnishings, super clean bathrooms with good bathroom fittings, and I can go on and on. Kitchen was big with 6-top stove & a microwave. I cooked just like it was at my own home! Love the pots & pans.
SUPERB HOST: Very friendly, informative & responsive 24/7.
All in all, if it were a hotel, we would rate Faruk's place 6 or 7 stars!!

I would rate our overall experience at Maide's apartment at 2.5 stars (out of 5). On the one hand, the apartment itself easily deserves 5 stars for two main reasons. One: the location is excellent, especially to those who are interested in the Fatih area, mosque, bazars etc. It is only 2 or 3 minutes walk to one of the entrances of the beautiful mosque and similarly to the many cafes, shops, bakeries and restaurants in this area. It is also around 7 minutes walk to the shopping area of Fevzi Paşa. There was also a supermarket, just 1 minute away or less, that opened until midnight. Two: the cleanliness of the apartment and the building in general! I can easily say that this is perhaps the first rental property I would describe as ultra clean! In every sense of the word really! Clean and neat! There was nothing lavish about this apartment. It is quite basic. But sufficient and pleasant for your basic needs. It looked like a new apartment/building or a newly-renovated apartment/building. I have to emphasise the above two positive elements. In addition, I respected the fact that there were prayer rugs in the apartment and that guests were not allowed to drink alcohol or step with their shoes inside the apartment. This adds to a sense of 'spiritual cleanliness' in this apartment which is in line with this area in general (the Fatih area and mosque). These were highly noticed and appreciated. I applaud the host for that! On the other hand, I give the host a maximum of 2 stars, due to her attitude, lack of understanding of and respect for her guests' right to privacy and to be left in peace without disturbance, and to her lack of taking responsibility for any problems in her apartment or for actions that she herself takes. We were basically expected to choose from three options: (1) either to interrupt our schedule/sleep/etc by attending to technicians who will come to fix problems that were there BEFORE we checked in the apartment, or (2) accept the absurd idea that these technicians would come to the apartment in our absence and while our belongings are there (PS: no available safe box in the apartment!), or (3) just choose to stay without that missing amenity (WiFi, TV etc). At the beginning, we accepted to attend to technicians at a time that was not arranged with us by the host (she just told us that they will come at a particular time - we have to change our schedule accordingly!). But when this behaviour continued, we said we were busy and cannot interrupt our schedule to help the host fix things in her property! We said we will then deal with the 'lesser evil', which is to stay without a WiFi, than to accept the option of people coming with the key to the apartment during our absence! But then we get told that: well, this is your choice! A truly appalling attitude that unfortunately spoilt our stay in this otherwise excellent apartment! We never met with the owner. We were greeted and checked in by a lovely neighbour who made an effort to show us around and gave us her own WiFi password to use. However, that neighbour did not speak any English and so communication wasn't easy. I knew a bit of Turkish which somewhat helped, but that of course wasn't sufficient to understand all details or to communicate all questions and understand the neighbour's responses. It would have been nice of the owner/host to at least explain the reason of her absence, not that she had to offer such an explanation, but just as a courtesy and a show of respect for her guests - an element that was clearly missing. In short, the host should: 1- fix things in the apartment BEFORE the check in date of her guests. She should make time for that and attend to it herself rather than expect other people (guests, neighbours etc) to take care of these matters. 2- She should take responsibility of problems rather than continuously blame others for them (e.g. the remotes of two ACs were missing but this was the previous guests' fault as they took the remotes! The absence of a WiFi is the fault of the company/provider not the the fault of the owner who didn't fix the problem before the check-in date. The technicians ringing the bell at an early hour of the morning is their fault, not the fault of the host who sent them despite the guest begging her the night before not to send anymore technicians until the check-out date!). It is always someone else's fault. 3- She (the host) needs to be informed about guests' rights to privacy and comfort. She needs to first ASK the guest if it is okay to send people to the apartment and arrange a mutual time that suits everyone rather than just INFORM the guests that someone is coming at such and such a time. She needs to know that it is NOT OKAY to send someone with the keys while the apartment is booked by guests and while they are not present in the apartment. There is a clear lack of understanding in this area. It is not the guest's job to educate the host on these matters and waste much precious time and energy on messages back and forth (this note is perhaps aimed at Airbnb that should make sure that hosts are aware of these basics before they are allowed to let their properties via this website). Apart from the above, I can say that during the period of our booking, the apartment had all the basic needs including three ACs that worked well and that were sufficient (but only one remote control that operated them all). There was a washing machine (but no dryer and no balcony to hang the clothes - you will hang your clothes on a line inside...

It was a great stay at this apartment. The place was super clean and exactly as shown in the photos. The host was extremely friendly and responsive throughout. When we first arrived, we requested additional pots for cooking, and he immediately provided brand new ones, which we really appreciated. The location is great, only a 2-minute walk to Fatih Mosque. Highly recommended. You will be dealing with a very professional and responsive host, which will make the whole experience easy and comfortable. A huge thanks to the host for hosting us and for his respectful communication.

My family had an excellent stay at Faruk’s place. The space was welcoming and clean. The apartment was comfortable and cozy, but spacious enough to accommodate our family with ease. The bedrooms provided comfortable beds and nice storage for our belongings. Kitchen had everything we needed for our stay. Wi-fi was strong. We loved the Fatih location as we prefer a slower more peaceful pace than the bustling Taksim Square area. We enjoyed the pedestrian bazaar just up the street in front of the Fatih Mosque, and it was great local source for fresh bread, cheese, meats, veggies, and fish. Faruk was an excellent host. So easy to work with and very responsive and accommodating. We will definitely be recommending his place to our friends and family visiting the city, and look forward to staying there again ourselves. Thanks Faruk!

description: Beautiful authentic ottoman home in the heart of the old city. Close to the metro station and access to the Bosphorus. The unique style high ceiling living room with original engraved wooden ceiling gives a sense of authentic Ottoman Istanbul. The large windows boast an abundance of natural sunlight. Our kitchen & bathroom are fully equipped. The cozy two bedrooms(1 queen/1 double) are perfect for a peaceful night's sleep.

reviews.text: The apartment was just as described. A beautiful traditional main living room with high ceilings, a kitchenette with all we needed and a great location to access restaurants, bars, local attractions and public transport. VNG we’re very responsive and helpful if we had any queries, would definitely recommend for friends or a family (we were two adults and two children).

Great location close to everything. The dishwasher and washer/dryer were a huge convenience and bonus for us, who were traveling with an 8 month old. The front window is picture perfect. Everything was clean. Beds comfortable. Towels soft. Other travelers have mentioned the noise on the weekend, which does exist, but the sound didn't affect our sleep in the rear bedrooms. We would definitely stay here again.

Most perfect location in the heart of Istanbul with loads of sites and attractions just walking distance. Communication was super easy and the place is just how it is described. It can be a little bit noisy at night but the rooms are in the back so it’s fine.

This apartment is in a fantastic location and is very comfortable. There are two bedrooms, which are towards the back of the unit and are quiet at night. It has a washer and a dryer, which in our experience was very rare in Turkey (the dryer). There are tons of restaurants and shops around, and the trains and buses are a short walk away. The unit is truly like you see it in the pictures -- filled with thoughtful and stylish details. The team that manages it is very accessible and wants to ensure you have a good experience. I highly recommend it!

Very good communication. VNG helped me out with every question I had. Check-in was easy, the apartment was clean, very well located. A bit noisy on the weekends becuase the street in front of the apartment gets really busy at night. Rooms are at the back so you wouldn't hear much noise. The decoration is beautiful and overall the apartment is a great place to stay.

description:
A beautifully furnished, roof-top terrace dream flat with 2 bedrooms, 1 bath in a historical building next to Istanbul’s most famous tourist attraction – Galata Tower!

The flat is serene and restful, yet right in the heart of the hustle and bustle, your flat is on the 4th floor – of a historical 19th century building 50 steps from Galata Tower with easy access to all public transport and tourist attractions!

reviews.text:
There are pros and cons to this Airbnb
The pros are
Very close to Galata Tower, restaurants,Café, grocery store, shopping are all within easy walking distance, beautiful terrace with exceptional views of Istanbul, beds are comfortable, shower has great water pressure, washing machine works great, the heat works great as we were staying when it was cold. 2 bedrooms back to back, can see the Galata tower from the terrorist, looking up and over,
The cons of this place are
There is no lift & there are 5 flights of stairs to get to the unit, it is located right next to a mass the morning prayer goes off at 5:30 am the noise is blaring into the unit, the terrace has a beautiful view, but when the temperature is hot is very hard to keep cool, there is sewer smell when walking up the stairs, no TV, the pictures are accurate but what you don’t see is everything is wearing out and run down, the furniture the bathrooms the kitchen everything is old. It is not new like the Photots show.

This apartment is at an amazing location and has a beautiful view of the Golden Horn. We had problems with hot water but the host was very responsive and fixed it quickly. This is an old apartment (as expected in this area). However, all the furniture was cheap, very outdated, and very uncomfortable (e.g., springs poking out of the mattress, plastic chairs on the balcony instead of nice lounge furniture as advertised, dirty plastic plates in the kitchen, stained towels). For the price we paid we were expecting more comfort. We were told by locals that this apartment frequently hosts parties, and the apartment reflects that.

To keep it simple, I will start with pros then cons.
Pros:
-view: great view of Istanbul
-large terrace
-location is close to Galata tower & walking distance to Hagia Sofia, taksim, Galata port etc
-coffee, some clean water & a few spices were provided
-air conditioning worked well and efficiently
-host was great at communicating
Cons:
-there is an ant infestation, really off putting
-the electricity cut mid-day for a bit
-the beds and furniture are all of really cheap quality
-the place itself is rustic, yet really run down & needs some fixing
-the unit is up 5 extremely narrow flights of stair & there is no lobby or even entrance to gather your self or belongings. the street it’s on is also closed to vehicles and you have to walk with your luggage
-some of the lights/ fixtures don’t work including at the entrance and bedroom-
All in all, we had a great time but I would not stay here again nor would I recommend it to anyone.

The place is located right by the Galata Tower, and it was an incredible experience. The highlight of the apartment is undoubtedly the terrace, which offers breathtaking views. Climbing the stairs is absolutely worth it for the panoramic scenes of Istanbul.
Our host was exceptionally hospitable. He left some snacks and a cute note on the blackboard, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The apartment itself is not only in an amazing location but also clean and cozy, providing a comfortable retreat after exploring the city.
One aspect to consider is the proximity of a mosque, as the call to prayer can be loud, especially at 5 am. As someone accustomed to living in a Muslim country, I found it manageable, but it might be a consideration for light sleepers💤.

Reception and communication were really very good. Moussaab is a great host and Salih's appartement is beautiful. It looks exactly like in the pictures. You will not find a better location. The roof terrace is great and the rooms are clean. When you are in Istanbul and want to stay well with a small group this is really a good option. Fair price for what you get. Keep in mind that this is a very busy area with a lot of noise. But that didn't matter to us because the location is fantastic. Thanks Salih and Moussab!

Great host and views and convenient for the historic center of the city. The location is well described and also commented on in other recent reviews.
The stairs to the first floor are steep and narrow and in my opinion unsuited for less mobile or fit people. Our host lifted our cases up on arrival and took them down on departure and we were very grateful for that; it would have been difficult to do ourselves.
The second floor stairs are also steep but as luggage does not need to be lifted up them more manageable.
The bedroom is dominated by the bed which is accessible via the foot and right side, the left side being firmly against a wall. There is not much room to maneuver and again could be challenging for some.
The first day there was an overwhelming damp odour of "blocked drains" type which I ascribe to the "laundry " outside the apartment door. The smell dissipated over the next few days.
We recommend this place for its location, views, and very helpful host. Thank you

Mehmet and his brother were very kind. Our flight was delayed and it was very late already. Finally landed around midnight at the airport and so glad we booked the pick up service from him in prior. During this period Mehmet‘s brother had been very patient and always responsive to our messages.
The apartment was just as described. The bed was comfy. In the streets there were many hotels. The apartment was at the end of a road, so it was quite. You can hear seagulls and birds chirping from there, though you’re in the middle of the big city. So nice.
The location is great. You can go around Istanbulwith the tram from sultan ahmet station (10-15‘ walk), or try the bus BN1 from the seaside Çatladıkapı station (5‘ walk).
Only a minor problem when we arrived, the bathroom smelled a bit musty. I think there was no active fan in the shower, just a window. But we kept the window open all the time, on the second day the smell was gone. Definitely highly recommended place to stay in Fatih.

Nice host. Good communication. The room was smaller than I anticipated. The location is at the dead-end street in the rough area. It's not in the city center. It's near the southern end by the water. The upstairs where the water view is was warm. The host also gave me a big bottle of water. There was a strong smell of argan oil or a cleaning product of something.

This place is great for two single people or a couple and a single person unless a second couple wants to sleep on the futon in the living room/kitchen. Also, there isn't a door for the bedroom so you can hear each other easily. We chose this for the price and location. The views from both terraces are stunning! The upstairs living/kitchen room has plenty of natural light too. It is a 10-15 minute walk to the Haggai Sophia and the Blue Mosque is not far either. The host and his brother were very hospitable and set-up a tour for us. He had other great recommendations too! I recommend to take the pickup and drop-off service from airport offered by the host. It was 40 euros or 48 dollars one way. We did uber/taxi on our own and it was 65 dollars. Unless you know how to negotiate take the service. Great place and great host! Highly recommend!

This apartment was fabulous!! Ali and his brother Mehmet are amazing hosts, and the apartment is even better than you think. I’d kill to go back in the summer with its view and balcony (it was snowing the whole time were there—still super atmospheric) and it was really walkable to the main bit of the Hagia Sophia and blue mosque, and very easy to get to transport from there. The kitchen is sweet and very usable, the bedroom is really nice, and it was clean and easy to get in. Highly worthwhile, especially for the price. They also run a sweet and very convenient small grocery store just over the railway tracks towards town, which is great for extra water and snacks :)

description: A spacious private room

reviews.text: I can honestly say that Lal represents & sets the standard that you would expect from a super host. She’s taking more precautions than hotels and expect same sensitiveness from the guests . you will have your privacy in this room .Perfect Internet speed great location which requires 5 to 10 minute walk to seaside ,peaceful environment , friendly host.For sure I ‘d come back;)

The host is friendly and very helpful. Great central location with a park and sea-view running track nearby. The room was comfortable, and everything you need is within 15 minutes. Highly recommend and will return hopefully!

Perfect choice for someone who might need a clean, convenient spot to stay. I was able to stay in such a clean and convenient location. Public transportation was super close to any of the touristy spots. Communication was easy with owner Lal and her assistant.They assisted me literally with everything 24/7.Local malls are within walking distance from the flat and they have free delivery service until late hours.

The location was perfect for me, just a 15-minute walk to Galatasaray University. The area had everything I needed—supermarkets, ATMs, banks, pharmacies, cafes, and restaurants. There were also local fruit markets twice a week, which added a nice touch to the neighborhood.
My room and the shared spaces were always clean and tidy, and the host was quick to respond to any questions or concerns. Yildiz Park was a great escape, offering a peaceful spot to relax and enjoy nature.
This town is famous for its stunning sea views, and it's a popular destination for tourists. A fantastic spot, really, with both convenience and beauty right at your doorstep.

I stayed here after my relatives' stay. It was very quite , clean house.Lal was so quick to respond everytime , she welcomed me at first day of my stay and explained me the rules of the house ,helped with whatever I needed during my whole stay. There were 2 more guests in the house and common areas were clean and tidy all the time. House is located in a quiet neighborhood but not far at all from everything you might need: Supermarkets, banks, cafes.. I already recommended this place to my friends.

description: Make yourself at home in our gorgeous, light and stylish apartment in the heart of the old city, close to the lively Istiklal street and the iconic Galata Tower, visible from the extensive private rooftop terrace garden where you can enjoy an outstanding view of the city and catch the sunset after a days exploring. This apartment is renovated and decorated by us with many vintage and handmade details.

reviews.text:
It was a LOVELY stay, we didn’t want to leave! Spotless and beautifully decorated apartment with lovely balcony and views. The air conditioners in each room were much needed and worked great even in the hottest days! I had the back bedroom with balcony entrance and the bed was super comfortable!
So much to do and see! I recommend walking up to Istiklal street, taking the one stop tunnel to Karakoy, then train or waterways to wherever! So many transportation options near by! Really was super convenient. As a family of 5, we really appreciated the ride Ozgur set up for us from the airport too!
Galata tower and area is much calmer during the morning hours. The Airbnb’s street is less busy and more quiet. We slept with no issues regarding noise. The stairs were a workout, but our host helped us with the luggage. Like many said, they are worth the view, the apartment and the location! We will happily return!
Thank you so much to Ozgur and Naomi!!

This Airbnb is a wonderful home base while exploring Istanbul. The space is very comfortable and the view from the terrace is amazing. Ozgur and Naomi are very nice hosts and we’re very responsive during our stay. The neighborhood is very charming and close to many restaurants and cafes, many of which are open until the early hours of the AM. There are two things you should know before booking: (1) there is no elevator so please be sure everyone in your party is able to walk up 4 flights of stairs and (2) in the summer it gets hot and there is only AC in the bedrooms. We slept very well; beds are comfy and AC works very well in the bedrooms. Overall the place is perfect for most groups as large as 5 adults (though we enjoyed it just the two of us) and as long as you don’t mind the stairs and lack of central AC you are sure to LOVE this Airbnb!

This was a lovely stay in a fun and bustling part of the city. Ozgur was attentive, with a warm welcome and great recommendations. The roof terrace was absolutely beautiful and the apartment nicely decorated, simple and a comfortable stay for three of us. I loved the location and the authentic feel of the flat. Things to be aware of are a long walk-up staircase, tough for big luggage but worth the gorgeous view from above. Bathrooms are small for sharing, but the rooms are very comfortable. I loved this location, and would come back next time in Istanbul!

This place was perfect! Özgür was incredibly responsive and flexible with us during our time, which made everything easy. The apartment is in the middle of an awesome neighborhood within walking distance to lots of sights, restaurants and things to do. The balcony overlooking an amazing view was beautiful and we were able to enjoy our time outside while looking over Istanbul. The beds were incredibly comfortable, everything was clean and the air conditioning was welcomed during hotter times. Thank you so much for such a wonderful stay, we highly recommend!

Upon arrival, we were greated by the host, who helped us to get our luggage upstairs. The apartment is clean, well furnished, with comfortable beds and pillows. The views from the terrace are stunning and worth the climb to the 5th floor :). Hosts responded quickly to all our communications. We enjoyed our stay very much!

description: Stay in a historic 200-year-old flat with 3.5m spacious high ceilings and authentic wooden floors, located at the entrance of Istiklal Street and just 2 minutes from Galata Tower & Şişhane Metro. Fully equipped with fast WiFi, TV, washing machine, dishwasher, kitchen essentials and counting. Self check-in via secure code lockbox. Perfect location to explore Istanbul’s cultural and historic heart, with cafés, shops, and landmarks right outside your door.

reviews.text: As a regular Istanbul visitor, I was pleasantly surprised by this apartment. It was close to public transport and all the places I like to visit locally, beautifully renovated and kept true to its original style, while the kitchen and bathroom were clean and modern. The stairs are quite steep - so keep this in mind if you have heavy luggage or issues with stairs - but you only need to get your luggage up the stairs once! Coming down is much easier! This apartment has the only balcony in the building and has a great sunset view down the street. The bed was very comfortable and location relatively quiet for the area. I think I had the best sleep out of all the Airbnb apartments I’ve stayed in, in Istanbul. Highly recommended, and i would definitely stay again!

Excellent apartments in the center of Istanbul. The location is very convenient — the metro is just a few minutes away, and major attractions, cafes, and shops are right nearby. The apartment was clean and tidy, which made a great first impression. It has all the necessary appliances for a comfortable stay. I’d like to especially note the shower — it doesn’t leak, which, unfortunately, is a rarity in Istanbul and was a pleasant bonus. I was completely satisfied with my stay and would gladly stay here again.

The location is perfect. I can’t emphasize enough how good it is. You’re in the best possible spot, with easy access to everywhere in the city. At the same time, the street itself is quiet and very clean. The apartment is beautiful, with charming old wooden floors. The shower has hot water with great pressure. It’s easy to end up staying in the wrong area in Istanbul, but this place is fantastic!
Great host. The apartment is very near Galata Tower and there are a lot of shops and restaurants around. Just note that there is no AC and elevator.

Burak is a friendly, helpful young man. he received me on arrival and looked after me until I left. he always got in touch with me and obtained information. He was available around the clock and answered very quickly.
The apartment is very central, a 3-minute walk is a metro station. there are restaurants and shops around the house. Galata Tower can be reached in 3 minutes by foot, Istiklal Street in a maximum of 5 minutes.
The apartment is very comfortably furnished and you feel very comfortable. everything is there what you need. The bed is very comfortable, so you can get a good night's sleep.
Due to the central and lively location, it could get a bit noisy from time to time.
The area is safe and the neighborhood is nice.
I recommend this accommodation 100% and would use it again and again without thinking twice.
Thank you for everything it was a amazing time

description:
Up to 4 people may comfortably accomodate in my 1 + 1 apartment.
Your apartment in Taksim square, entertainment venues, transport to a safe place and a 3-minute walk from Istiklal Street. Grocery stores and cafes open 7/24 and there are many hotels around around. Offering a comfortable stay in the heart of the city with mixed modern and traditional Turkish décor just 150 meters from Taksim Square.Also the famous Cihangir cafe streets are only 800 meters away.

reviews.text: Severe bait-and-switch. I booked a spacious 4-person apartment with a separate living room and two real beds because I was traveling with my mother. In the pre-booking chat, the host explicitly promised us a 2-bed apartment on an upper floor for an early check-in. However, upon arrival, he downgraded us to a tiny single room with only one real bed and a sofa.When we refused the downgrade, the host tried to intimidate us and demand unauthorized extra cash for the early check-in he had previously agreed to for free. We felt completely unsafe, refused to pay his extortion fees, and physically walked out of the property to check into a real hotel. Airbnb Support had to step in under AirCover to handle the issue. Avoid this host and his listings entirely
Hassan is very kind, he is super helpful. The rooms were true to the pictures and overall the place was clean.

Unfortunately, the accommodation I received was significantly different from what was advertised in the listing. The room and overall condition of the property did not match the photos provided. Additionally, many of the household items and facilities were either damaged or completely unusable, which made my stay extremely uncomfortable.
Furthermore, I was unexpectedly charged an additional $40 without a clear or justified explanation. This situation is not acceptable and does not reflect fair or transparent service.

Hassan is a great host. He is very helpful and is available all day. He provided us information on where to go and eat as well as setting up a private airport shuttle. The apartment is located right in Taksim close to everything.
Hasan is an amazing host, his apartments are located right next to Takism Square and all its ammenties.Help for any enquiries was instant and would happily stay there again.

description: Stay in the heart of Çukurcuma, one of Istanbul's most charming and historic neighborhoods, just a short walk from Galata, Cihangir, Karaköy, and İstiklal Street. Hosted by Homie Suites, this stylish one-bedroom apartment offers seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and everything you need for a comfortable stay. Surrounded by antique shops, art galleries, cafés, and local restaurants, you'll experience one of Istanbul's most authentic neighborhoods.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful two-week stay at this apartment. The place matched the photos exactly and was very clean and comfortable. The host, Gizem, was very responsive and easy to communicate with. The second complementary cleaning after the first week was also a nice bonus. Internet speed was fast, water pressure was excellent. The apartment is compact, but well-designed and had everything needed for a longer stay. Will repeat, highly recommended!

We had a nice stay in home suite for a week. The host are always responsive promptly for our enquiry. The room is spacious and well equipped. Sofa bed is set up upon our request before we check in. Toilet is sparkling clean. We find out some issues during check in and host immediately change a similar room for us in the same building. Wifi is unstable sometimes but it doesn’t affect us much since we stay outside most of the time. Good location situated in Cihangir. This area is so chill with so many restaurants , cafe and antiques shops . Be prepared to walk uphills and downhills in most part of Istanbul. Taking taxi maybe a good idea if you carry big luggage

I have stayed in another one of Homie's apartments in the same building, and while the bedroom and bathroom were a bit smaller in this apartment than the other, they were absolutely perfect for 1 person. What I love most is how responsive and accommodating the Homie team are with questions. The apartment is perfect and exactly as described, very clean and well equipped, and the location cannot be matched ! I would definitely stay again, and look forward to my next visit.

I stayed in this apartment for a month and I have to say it's one of my best experiences on airbnb.
First of all the location is great, close to transportation and touristic areas.
The apartment was clean and comes with everything you will need to have a comfortable and enjoyable time, like good Internet, smart tv with services subscriptions, washing machine and everything esle you can think of.
in addition to that the host was great, always very responsive and helpful, he also sent me a gift for ramadan.
I really recommend this apartment if you're 1-2 people.

Very comfortable stay! The hosts were very helpful, quick & responsive to our questions & needs. The manual provided was very clear and check in/out was super smooth. We actually rebooked the place as the location was so good and felt very comfortable at the apartment. Everything was very clean and well maintained. Thank you very much once again!

description:
The residence locates in the heart of Şişli/Bomonti district.

One bedroom residence with Balcony.

The residence features;
-Terrace pool
-Indoor Pool (heated)
-Underground private parking lot
-Gym
-24/7 security

5min walk to Osmanbey Metro Station
There are many cafes and restaurants nearby

reviews.text: The apartment is clean and the decor is modern. Everything is available in the apartment, including cleaning and kitchen tools. Air conditioning is available in all rooms, and the building has an elevator. The location is good. There are more than one supermarket nearby in addition to cafes. Başar is very helpful regarding the early check-in time and anything we ask for is provided for us Immediately on the same day. It was a very good experience in terms of the price. Thank you Başar for everything.

This apartment is really well maintained with a comfortable living room and bedroom. It is located in a really safe and peaceful neighbourhood with 24/7 security and I felt safe and welcome at all times. The pictures are exactly as it is shown and the check in / out process was very easy. It is located just 5 minute walk from the nearest metro station of Osmanbey which can connect you directly to the old city. The host, Baçar, was very helpful throughout and made the check in very easy and drama free. He also helped book a taxi for us on the way back to the airport, for which I’m very grateful. Thanks again, I would defiantly come back here!

Not suitable for demanding guests. We lived there for almost 2 months, and here’s what it’s like:
1. Cleanliness - the cooker, floors etc were not perfectly clean.
2. The vacuum cleaner did not really clean, the fridge door and the sink were broken, the iron leaked, shower stream was extremely low. Most of the things we complained about were fixed, but it took several days, and quite some nerves.
3. Flexibility. We asked for cleaning and changing bedsheets, but host wasn’t happy about it and said this is an extra service. We paid a lot of money during our stay. I think cleaning at least once a week and changing sheets should have been without asking. Also, we asked for later checkout several days in advance but got a refusal.
4. Accuracy. There are many things in the apartment that need minor fixing, but they are just fixed with scotch, or even plaster. If it’s called „luxury apartment“ it should be treated this way.
5. Details that make a difference. Holes in bedsheets are absolutely unacceptable, but no matter how many times we asked for new ones, they all came with holes. Cups and forks - there were not enough for 3 people to use them during one day, if you cook at home. No napkins, sanitizer, oil, etc.
Overall, it wasn’t a bad stay, and would suit you if you eat out, stay for a short time, and are not demanding or spoiled with top hosts 😉

The apartment was very secure with 24 hour security presence. Rooftop pool and bar were amazing. Basement pool was also amazing. Free parking is available. The accommodation is now in need of a fresh coat of paint and new bedding. Terrace was nice to sit in. AC worked well. All kitchen accessories were available. The kitchen peninsular table was where we mostly sat in the evening. TV was difficult to operate so we never used this. Plenty storage available. Shower was fine. We would return to Istanbul but would prefer closer proximity to Taksim Square. Metro about 15 minute walk. Plenty super markets in the vicinity. We had a great holiday!

This apartment is a gem of a place, in an urban neighborhood very close to markets and Nishantshai. The bed is comfortable, bathroom is spacious abd water pressure is OK, apartment is very spacious with ample space for kitchen, living room and a lovely balcony. The host are gracious and welcomed me with genuine interest. Definitely a must stay, recommend to everyone. My ratings is 4.5/5

description:
The adress is very easy to find and its 3 minutes to sishane metro station and Istiklal street (most popular street in Ist).Taksim square 15 min. by walking
Live like a local in my high ceilinged apartment with balcony near the Galata Tower!

Our building age more than 100 years and historical building. There are special handmade embroidery designs in the room .

Accommodates up to 4 people which make it perfect for families,friends and work retreats.

reviews.text:
My stay was wonderful! The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared. The key locker system made check-in/out seamless, which I really appreciated after a long day of travel.
The neighborhood was safe, quiet, and conveniently located, with easy access to local spots.

Great location and clean and cozy one bedroom flat. The apartment does not have an elevator so if you have big bags need to consider this or contact Ahmet who was super helpful and sent someone to help me out with my bags. The communication was super smooth and I enjoyed my stay very much.

First of all, place is even lot better than photos. Location is exactly at the heart of İstanbul but also quite peaceful and calm. Ahmet is very easy to communicate and helpful, worth every second and definitely want to visit again🙏

The place was truly amazing!
It was spacious, very comfortable, and perfectly clean, which made our stay really enjoyable. The location could not have been better, with plenty of bars and restaurants just around the corner and Galata within walking distance. One of the best parts was definitely the terrace, located right in front of a beautiful church, where we were able to watch the sunrise and enjoy a wonderful view of the sea.
The host was very responsive and extremely helpful throughout our stay, always ready to assist us whenever we had a question. We really appreciated the flexibility, as we were able to check in earlier than expected, and it was also possible to safely store our luggage in a locker, which made everything so much more convenient.
This place is a must!

Ahmet was an incredible host. the place was clean and well maintained, although the beds were just a little uncomfortable but as I only stayed 2 days that did not matter to us.
the location was great as everything was in walking distance.
Ahmet himself was so accommodating and responsive. with a added fee he accommodated us with a later check out which was really appreciated.

description:
Blue apartments located at perfect point that only one minute from Taxim Square. Location is center of Istanbul and it is compeletly safe and clean.
The Apartments renoveted and have all things that you need for personel comfort.
Managed by professionels like a hotel but you feel like at home.

reviews.text: Choose this place only if you have absolutely no other option. The photos on the listing do not match the apartment you get, as the host uses the same pictures for all units. The real place is tiny, damp, and has visible mold. The size is not indicated and should be, because even one person with a suitcase can barely move. The bathroom is essentially a closet and if you are taller than 155 cm the toilet is almost unusable. Only one roll of toilet paper was provided for a week, and when I asked for more I was told to buy it myself. On the third day the power went out; I came back soaked from the rain and could not dry myself, shower, or use heating. Nearby shops used diesel generators and the smell of gasoline filled the apartment. I had to leave immediately, and the steep, dangerous stairs made carrying luggage down in total darkness genuinely risky. Some places should honestly not be allowed to operate.

Check in is postponed until 4:30 pm - 5:00pm because the studio is not ready and not clean.
Very narrow stairs so dangerous to step on to arrive to the first floor where you can find the mini elevator, imagine yourself carrying a suitcase 🧳 on these dangerous stairs.
Too much etching when using the bed until they gave a new bedsheet
Cockroach 🪳 are everywhere
Smelly toilet all day
All kitchen equipments are damaged and out of days and dirty or broken , only the Air-conditioning and the fridge are ok with a lot of small alive cockroaches 🪳 inside the fridge.
Too much Meo Meo from the neighbors every night 👀 🔥
Location is perfect 👍🏻 just few steps to taksim square and all transportations

The value for price of this place exceeds all its cons. It is very cheap and surprisingly clean as well, I have been to many hotels within Istanbul and this Airbnb is really clean.
The studio we got was spacious and fully equipped with everything, we did not feel that anything was missing.
There was a problem with checking-in but the owners were professional in handeling it.
Be careful if you have heavy stuff as the first floor does not have an elevator.
If you are a light sleeper I do not suggest this place as it is located in a very busy area.
We felt safe as well, although the area did not seem that safe yet the studio itself is very well protected and you can find police officers all around the place.
Very good location with great value, hosts are very fast responding
It was fine no problems and cheap place, however you might hear upstairs neighbors clapping cheeks and smell them smoking

description:
The entire flat has been completely renovated and all products are brand new.
This place is better for white-collar who come home after work to spend night peacefully. Suitable for long term ( at least a month - not a party house -). Price includes all the bills ( gas, electricity, water, wifi, monthly apartment fee) and no need to pay any further extra payment like deposit or commission during stay.

Please contact me before making a reservation

reviews.text:
First of all, I need to say that I was amazed by hospitality of my host Utku! Everything went great and was super easy - comunication with host, welcoming.. Just everything.
My room and also the whole place was very clean, QUIET, with nice furniture, you just get that warm and homey feeling when you visit the place! Cozy, comfortable, inside you have everything you will probably need in your stay.
For me, location was also great. It is close to the cost - around 20 minutes, max 30 min walking (from the hill where the apartmant is, you can actually have a beeautiful view down on Bosfor)! Beykoz also has a lot of nice caffes, restaurants with cheap and good food.
Once again, I enjoyed my stay because of the great host Utku, who helped with everything I needed with a smile on his face :) Also because of the comfort of the place and location of colorfull and beautiful Beykoz. Thanks Utku once again!

Absolutely fantastic place and host! Clean all the time, quiet, warm and comfortable, perfect for rest after work, studying and location could not be better, every store or bus station you will need is in a range of 50-100m. The coast line with parks and excellent gym is 10 min away with bus and city center is, for Istanbul standards, relatively close and easy to go to. Utku is truly great as a host and a person, friendly, full of respect, great to communicate with and responding immediately to messages and questions. He was extremely helpful, by translating and explaining many hacks about transportation, currency, buying and everything else you need to know in order to manage in Istanbul. He also recommended excellent breakfast places and accompanied whenever he had time.
Huge recommendation, and many thanks to Utku for making this stay a home with a friend.
P.S. Combination of floor heating and very soft carpets was amazing.

This host has literally thought of everything a guest might need. The apartment is comfortable, clean, and very well positioned somehow both in the middle of the local municipal center and yet it was so quiet and felt secluded. Rooms are very well divided, so if one was staying up late this wasn’t disruptive to other people. The wifi signal was strong and of good quality for remote work. I would absolutely stay here again. This host was really great- very responsive and available to answer questions as well as to provide advice on local transport and visiting notable sights.

This accommodation cannot be described by any stereotypical review. I was lucky enough to stay here twice for longer periods. Utku is incredibly helpful and very hospitable. The apartment is being kept neat and clean, and everything is in its place as if I were here just a day before, and not three years ago. Kavacık is not too big to get around but has everything you need, adorable places for dining; it's well connected by transport to both the European and Asian sides.

Was a pleasant stay. Flat is clean and located in a good area. Utku, the host, speaks English. I stayed in a different room this time but it was just as good as the other one. Big bed, desk and two wardrobes- all you need for a short or longer stay. I will be back for sure. Thank you for your hospitality, Utku!

description: Completely renovated 70m2 apt. 4th floor w. elevator & sea-view. Few steps from elevator to aprt. door. Balcony with Bosphorus view. 2 bedrooms (queen bed+queen bed) + sofa, full kitchen, bathroom, linen, towels, toiletries and all amenities listed are available. 100 Mbps limitless WiFi, Netflix, SmartTV. 500m (8 min. walk) from Taksim Square and metro (M2 line). 650m (9 min. walk) from Kabataş ferrys, 350m to tram (T1 line). AC's IN LIVING ROOM & MAIN BEDROOM, THE SECOND BEDROOM HAS A FAN.

reviews.text: As an apartment I would give this a five star. It’s luxurious, comfortable and way above average. It has a dishwasher, washer and all the amenities you could possibly ask for. The ac is only in the living room but it cools the bedrooms as well. The apartment is exactly as listed in the description. And the cleaning service is excellent as well (make sure to ask for it, it’s worth the extra money). The only downside is the location for people who want to be super close to taksim square- it’s a 10 min uphill walk to taksim. So if you’re so looking to be in taksim, you will have to walk 10 min fully uphill. Other than that climb, everything else is perfect for this apartment. The views are breathtaking as shown in the pictures. The team managing the apartment is super responsive and clear in their communication.

Great location, walking distance to the main square (Taqsim), main tram station (T1), and touristic areas (Istiklal street, Galata tower/mall, Besiktas), amazing quiet neighbourhood 2 min away with highly rated boutique cafes serving local food.
Apartment was easily accessible via elevator, very clean, spacious and kitchen fully equipped. Although balcony/patio is only accessible through one of the bedrooms, the view is so worth it.
Really appreciated the booklet of recommendations in the apartment, with decent discounts for reputable cafes, restaurants, hammams, and retail shops.
Overall a great spot - highly recommended 👍

The apartment was beautiful. It was exactly as shown on the photos. There is everything one could need in the apartment. It is on the 4th floor but there is a lift in the building so no problem there. The location is very good (close to the Findikli Tram Station (tram T1) and from there it is 5-10 minutes walk uphill to the apartment. The apartment was clean and the view from the bedroom was really something special! Yildiray is a great host, very responsive and helpful. We would definitely stay here again.

Best check-in experience! The couch and plant didn’t match the photo but it was fine, beds are a little bit uncomfortable and bedrooms also don’t have AC which may have been written on the listing but we didn’t notice honestly and was a little bit frustrating given the heat wave in the summer.
The location is amazing, close to Kabataç ferry and lots of restaurants.
Our stay wasn’t long, but it was a good value for money considering the time.

Had a great time at this home. The apartment looks exactly as described and the view is stunning. The place is clean and has all you need.
It’s a bit noisy outside in the morning/during the day which kind of fits the city’s and this neighborhoods vibe. So it didn’t bother us at all. Very walkable and close to lots of cafes and bars. The tiny downside for some would be getting to the place you have to climb a lot of stairs, otherwise just get an uber. But again, didn’t really bother us as we love to walk.
Yildiray and the team were very responsive and very helpful as we needed an earlier check in. They were quick to answer all of our questions and help us promptly.
Would definitely recommend and stay there again.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: I didn't have much expectation from a budget hotel, but the room was too small, not like the picture. There was bad smell at night. But the good thing was, staffs were responsive.

We had a great time at this airbnb. The host was extremely responsive and kind. Our flight landed late so we checked in around 1am and the host was the front desk and waiting. They helped with our bags to the room and overall was kind. The room was clean but the towels appeared a little dirty as did the covers for one of the beds but nothing crazy. Bed was comfortable and room had a good temperature and blackout curtains so we could enjoy our sleep. I would recommend!
The place is a hotel, clean comfortable and well placed near all the transportation (tram, métro.....) and the staff are so welcoming. I Would love to stay there again

Tek basina Seyahat eden bi kadin olarak guvenlik acisindan sorun yasamadim benim icin en onemlisi buydu gorevliler ilgili ve cana yakinlardi saolsunlar tek eksi yani sokakta hep kaavehane oldugu icin girip cikarken rahatsiz ediciydi ama heryerdeki kaaveler boyle oldugu icin maalesef cok takilmadim oyuzden onun dışında cok merkezi bi yerde hemen ana caddenin ustunde nerdeyse ama konumdan gelirken dikkat edin yanlış yonlendirip dolandiriyor oda ve banyo temizdi sadece balkon biraz kirliydi ama nerdeyse hic kullanmadim zaten koyu perdelerin olmasi hem gece hem gunduz uyurken cok iyi onun disinda gun icerisinde full geziyordum aksamda gelip uyuyordum bu sekilde konakladim 5 gun ama herhangi bir sorun yasamadim cok guzel gecti sehahatim konum olarakta heryere cok yakin turistik yerler icin ozellikle tercih edilir bence
The hotel was nice. It’s close to bus stations, tram stations and subway stations. The staff were also very friendly. Firat himself was very helpful and communicated really well.

description: My apartment is located in the center of Besiktas, center of Istanbul. 2 bedrooms (10 and 13 square meters), 1 living room, 1 kitchen, 1 bathroom and 1 laundry room. Just 2 minutes walk to Besiktas bazaar(restaurants, bars, markets) 5 minutes walk to seaside and public transport, 15 minutes walk to Nisantasi. Well-equipped, stylishly furnished : Fridge, dishwasher, mini oven, microwave, kettle, washing machine, drying machine, Air Condition, high speed Wi-fi and 58 inch TV

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this immaculate apartment in Istanbul's Beşiktaş neighborhood! The host went above and beyond by giving me a small tour of the area, pointing out the best cafes, restaurants, and grocery stores nearby. The Internet connection was incredibly fast, and the TV offered a wide variety of channels, making my evenings even more enjoyable. The bed was incredibly comfortable, ensuring a good night's sleep. The apartment was fully equipped with everything I could need—from a well-stocked kitchen to a clean bathroom and even a laundry room. Would highly recommend for a comfortable and convenient stay in Istanbul!

Spent a month at Tunahan’s place which is located in the heart of the city with easy access to anywhere via ferry and bus. Despite the central location, it’s on a quiet small street with lots of restaurants and cafes. You’ll find good food and good coffee literally at your doorsteps. The apartment is spacious and was clean. WiFi connection worked great. The apartment is equipped with kitchen utensils for cooking as well.
Tunahan is an excellent host who responded to all queries fast despite being out of town. I had an issue with the house and he was quick to respond and fix. Strongly recommend the place for people who want to make the best of their trip to the city
Great apartment located at the great locations. It has a fast internet, big TV, washing machine, drying machine, dishwasher, gas stove and all other necessities in good condition!
We had a wonderfull long term stay in Tunahans flat! Youll find everything you need to make your stay comfortable and most convenient location!
Tunahan's place is the greatest location ever and Tunahan is a great host

description: We welcome you to our very luxuriously newly decorated apartment. Our building is located 5 minutes from Bahçelievler Memorial hospital, near old (closed) Ataturk Airport, CNR Expo center or The Sinan Erdem Arena and 10 minutes from Medicalpark hospital. Located only 3 minutes from Ataköy-Şirinevler public station on food. The apartment is 80 sqm on first floor. Can accommodate 4+1 people comfortably bed system...

reviews.text: We stayed and enjoyed at Emir's place for about 3 weeks. Emir was responsive and helpful host. The place was comfortable and super clean. The area was a bit busy, but everything was accessible. It is also worth mentioning the public transport. The place is within 5 minutes walk from subway, bus, metrobus and minibus stations.

Overall we had a great stay in Emir's place, and he is very kind and helpful and will visit to fix a problem you have despite him living far away from the apartment, he'll still quickly be there if you need any help. And of course contacting him on phone was great, he's very quick to respond. He even gave us a whole day for free, we were supposed to begin our stay on the 7th but we were already in Istanbul before that, and he let us move our stuff and begin our stay on the 6th instead!
We had an issue with the boiler and Emir eventually had to replace the whole boiler with a new one, but he did it quickly after we told him about the issues, and for the next guests in this place you'll have a new boiler which works perfectly, so enjoy that!
The apartment is clean and Emir really has thought of everything. There are notes around the place to let you know if you need to do a certain thing, for example charging the water dispenser and etc. There's a first aid kit, toolbox, vacuum cleaner, and pretty much everything you'd need in an apartment. We felt like we were staying in the home of a clean family that recently left. Almost anything we needed we'd find, and overall really goes to show how experienced Emir is with his guests. So even if most of your stay will be at home, you'll be very comfortable all day in his place. AC also works great, both for cooling and warming, so no worries there.
A quick negative note about the apartment is the internet, it's not great but it's good enough for social media and whatnot, it's just that watching 720p+ videos and streams was sometimes troublesome, and in rare occasions it was so bad that we couldn't use simple internet applications, but as I said that was rarely.
I'll mention a few things about the area now. And something bothersome, which isn't Emir's fault at all but we were pretty bothered by it, is how crowded it is.
This won't matter to you if you won't take public transportation, but if you'll rely on the metrobüs, you won't have a good time here. Unfortunately, Şirinevler, which is the station that's very conveniently only 3 minutes walking away from Emir's place, is one of the most crowded stations in Istanbul. No matter what time you leave, and that includes when we left at 5am to go back to the airport, you're not gonna find a place to sit in the buses. And if you go out pretty much any time between 7am-10pm, you're gonna find the station extremely full, and pretty much every bus you take will have you standing and almost squished between so many people. But I will mention that our stay was during summer, so there's a very small possibility that it's not as bad in the winter. Again, this isn't Emir's fault at all, but do keep this in mind if you're going to rely on the metrobüs. Ultimately it's just an issue that you'll find in many places in Istanbul, sadly the city is too crowded.
As for other mostly positive notes about the area, 3 minutes away from both the metrobüs and a metro (underground train) station is amazingly convenient. The area is full of life and restaurants and pharmacies and almost anything you can think of, however the grocery stores aren't very good. But an easy solution is to cross the metrobüs bridge to the other side and walk a very short distance, then you'll find an AVM (kind of a small mall) that has a massive grocery store in it where you'll find anything you'll need. Or ultimately just order groceries to your home if you want. Oh and if you love animals, the area is full of very cute cats and dogs that we had so much fun playing with and feeding.
And a last, mostly unimportant note, is that if you really care about the streets being fancy, and the people in the area being high class and young and modern, you won't really find that in this place. It's a very old district which also means the building is pretty old, however the apartment itself is amazing.
I think that wraps up all the important stuff I want to mention. The TV isn't smart but it has an HDMI input, so if you have a laptop that supports HDMI you can connect it. The TV remote almost doesn't work, but we managed to use it and hence we didn't tell Emir about it, which if we did I'm sure he would've helped us with it and replaced the remote. The stove isn't great but again we didn't tell him about it until now in the private review, so hopefully and I'm sure it'll be fixed for the next guests.
