Thanks to Emir for everything he's done for us, we had a pretty nice stay here and would definitely recommend to others.

The apartment is well equipped, clean and is just like to photos. The location did not get 5 stars only because it is not in the historical center, however, it is on a quiet and peaceful street, close to markets and restaurants and to the metro.
Emir was superb on his responses and went out of his way to help us with anything we needed.
It is a 5 star host for a 5 star apartment!

Emir was a really great host and responded really fast. The flat was clean and as described. The only thing you should be aware of is that the neighborhood is a little loud so it could bother you at night. Other than that everything was good.

We are a family of three who rented this apartment in March.
Excellent clean, warm apartment on the second floor with all amenities: air conditioning, heating system, dishwasher, washing machine, refrigerator, oven, TV, etc. all kitchen utensils, and clean linens, everything is in good condition. Within walking distance is the metro station, bus stop, shops. Very quiet at night.
In addition to this, Emir is a very hospitable host!

description: Welcome to our enchanting guest room located in the vibrant Küçük Ayasofya neighborhood, a stone's throw away from the timeless beauty of Sultanahmet. Nestled beside the historic Sokullu Mehmet Paşa Mosque and within walking distance to the awe-inspiring Grand Bazaar and Blue Mosque, our meticulously designed space invites you to immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Istanbul's history.

reviews.text:
For the price you pay, it’s what you get…..
1. Very old building. Needs renovation inside. You can see obvious cracks and stains. And stuff will fall off. So touch everything very gingerly
2. Not stable power. Power went out twice during my 3 day stay. No light, no wifi, no ac, no power at all. Happened twice
3. Host is not that responsive. He will respond, but takes time
4. Lots of bugs and small insects in the bathroom and the room.
5. There are seven rooms in the building. You have no control over who stays there. There are loud noises such as partying, music, and baby crying all the time
6. There are very steep stairs. Host will help you carry suitcase when he is around. But he gets off at 7pm. And if he is not around, you have to carry by yourself.
7. Location is center-ish. Takes around 10-15 to walk to blue mosque and historical center
I would have rather paid more for a more decent stay. This will take away from your overall Istanbul experience……

The place was perfect for me. Clean and organized and had good working air conditioning. Place was as described and fairly easy to get to from the airport. All the main attractions are within walking distance. Porta was great and he was always reaching out to make sure things were good. Communication was quick and responsive. Overall, It was a simple check in and location was great. I recommend! if you want something simple and close to everything.

It was a very pleasant experience, the host was very friendly and paying atention to our needs.
I went with a friend and they gave us 2 sets of keys to make our stay comfortable.
The room is a bit cold but there is central heating and if you ask for it they will take care of keeping it on.
We also received a lot of nice recommendations and even when we left the host helped us to get a taxi with a fixed price to the airport.
There is a very cuddly cat in the building that also makes the atmosfere more cozy.
We found everything clean.
The only thing i could say is that the room smells a bit moldy, you really need to air the room everyday, i guess is just because of the building and weather..
And if i can give any feedback i would suggest to receive guests with a bottle of water, is very cheap and can make the arrival experience way more welcoming as you cannot drink tap water in Istanbul.

We choose this place because it is close to attracting with walkable distance. the place has 2-3 floors. Host help us bring our luggage in our room on the 2nd floor which he doesn't have to. very sweet
The place is quiet. and he has cute Cat too. The environment feel safe enough to walk at night.
The toilet room is warm which make us feel nice after shower, no cool breeze from outside.
The place is big enough for us to open 2 luggage at the same time and still has comfortable walking space.
This place has washing machine.
overall we are really happen with our stay it has everything that we need. the price is good as well. recommended

Ozan was very polite and hospitable, and we felt at home from the very first day. The place was clean and exactly as described. The neighborhood is just what we were looking for—right in the heart of everyday life. Everything was within walking distance (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, etc.). The mosque next to the house creates a peaceful religious atmosphere that we really enjoyed. Great value for money—we would definitely come back.

description: A room and a living room within a fully serviced residential complex. A covered swimming pool that operates throughout the year. A Turkish bath, a gym, a table tennis table, 24-hour security, a private garden, and seating areas near markets and supermarkets.

reviews.text:
Actually owner Mosaab is a friendly good person. He meet us and deliver to the apartments. Big thx for it.
Apartments absolutely like on photos and at most comfort. But on check-in day it was a lot of hairs on the floor in the bathroom. And it smells inside the apartments, because people smoking there. I think, you need to include on room rules about do not smoking inside the apartments, because some sloppy people ignore it

So first of all Mosaab is really nice guy, but his apartment is a disaster. we were there for two months and waited for the stay to end. for a week it stank of ammonia and cigarettes. the apartment is on a busy street, you can't sleep at night, the apartment gets terribly hot it's twice as hot in there as outside and there's no air conditioning, the only thing left from the air conditioning is a sealed hole in the window. the apartment doesn't look like in the pictures, it's cluttered with old furniture and carpets. the walls are torn and the skirting boards are falling off... there are bugs in the kitchen!! after a month of living there we had a situation where it turned out that the electricity was unpaid and we didn't have electricity all day, we were lied to that there was no electricity in the entire building, but we asked and everyone had it and they cut off our electricity because of unpaid bills. I definitely don't recommend it

It was a really good experience, the host was so friendly and helpful, the house was as the description, comfortable and clean, the only thing is that it's so far away from the city centre and it needs too much time and money to go there.

My husband and I had a great time in Mr. Mosaab's appartment. easy check in and check out. Quick response on our needs. Naibours we're great. easy access to the grocery stores and taxi. Very clean building with three elevators at your cervice. We felt safe and what ever time we need to call Mr. Mosaab, he was available. Thank you Mr. Mosaab. We would love to stay at Mosaab's appartment for our next upcoming coming trip.
The place was great! Close to several grocery stores and within walking distance of the metro bus. Very quiet and pleasant area to be in.

description: Charming 1BR with authentic bay windows in both living room and bedroom. Queen bed and sofa bed. Stylish interior, Smart TV, fast Wi-Fi, full kitchen, washer/dryer, safe. 5-min walk to Istiklal Street. Baby equipment available upon request.

reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay at Erhan s place. The flat was vey clean and comfortable. We stayed there for 16 days. the building is very secure, there are cameras and security agents 24/7.
the flat is good equipped, you have all what you need in the kitchen. the beds are very comfortable. the bathroom is excellent. WE appreciate also the dryer machine.
Everything in the phots and in the description is the same in reality.
Erhan is very reactive, we had a very good communication. Thank you Erhan.
The place is very well situated, near Taksim Square and Metro station (5 to 10 mn walking), you have a lot of shops and restaurants.
we loved this appartement and we will for sure choose it for our next stay in Istanbul.
We highly recommend this flat.

I had the pleasure of staying at this stunning Airbnb apartment. From the moment I walked in, I was blown away by the beauty, cleanliness, and attention to detail in this apartment. The apartment exactly like the pictures – perhaps even better in person! The decor, furniture, and layout of the apartment were not only aesthetically pleasing but also extremely comfortable. The attention to detail was evident in every corner, making it feel like a true home away from home. Not to overlook the delightful welcome treat placed on the table.
I was impressed by the level of cleanliness in the apartment. It was spotless, and I couldn't find a speck of dust anywhere. The linens and towels were fresh. The apartment was well-equipped with everything you might need for a comfortable stay. Our host, Erhan was absolutely fantastic. From the moment we booked, he was responsive and accommodating. Throughout our stay, was always available for any questions or concerns and made us feel genuinely welcome.

We had an amazing stay and couldn’t have been happier with this apartment. The flat looks exactly like the photos; modern, stylish, and spotlessly clean. Everything was very well maintained and made us feel at home from the moment we arrived.
The hosts were exceptional: always responsive, respectful, and incredibly helpful. Communication was effortless thanks to their fluent English, which made everything much easier during our stay.
One of the biggest surprises was how peaceful the apartment was. Although it’s located very close to Taksim Square, the windows block out the noise so well that it felt quiet and relaxing throughout our stay.
We were a family of four and found the space comfortable, practical, and perfectly suited to our needs. We genuinely enjoyed every aspect of our stay and would not hesitate to book again the next time we’re in Istanbul.
Highly recommended!

The house quickly became a home! It was cozy, clean, and had everything we needed. The host was incredibly friendly, flexible, and genuinely hospitable. We stayed on the first floor, which gave us the chance to enjoy the buzz of Istanbul’s streets at night—and then completely tune it out thanks to the double-glazed windows.
The location is fantastic: very safe with friendly security, and literally just a street crossing away from Istiklal Street. If you keep walking down Istiklal, you’ll soon find yourself near Galata Tower. The area is full of life—there are plenty of pubs, bars, cafés, and supermarkets all within walking distance.
I came with my 60-year-old parents, and they absolutely loved the house—it felt comfortable and welcoming for all of us.
Also worth noting: for those driving, some of the nearby roads can be very steep so be careful when navigating the area by car.
Highly recommended!

The apartment was as listed through photos and very secure. The staff who checked us in were very friendly and helpful even though they didn’t speak English. We felt very comfortable in the apartment. Everything was clean and modern. Although there were double shades on the bedroom windows, at night the room was very light. I like a dark bedroom to sleep.
Other guests through their reviews mentioned noise. There is a bus and taxi stop right in front of the apartment. Even though the windows are insulated you can still hear noise into the night since this is a first floor apartment.
Within 5 minutes you can walk to Taksim Square and tons of shops, supermarkets and good restaurants. Obviously, getting a taxi is easy! Do Uber as you could get overcharged unless you ask your fare before you get in taxi.
This area, Taksim 360, is a popular one.

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

Giriş vaktinde geldiğimizde ev sahibi bize dairenin daha temizlenmediğini söyledi, daire hazır değildi. Banyoda sıcak su çok zor geliyordu ve banyo giderleri temizlenmediği için tıkanmıştı. Genel olarak 4/5.
a friendly host, clean home and it’s location is close to everything. i recommend to stay at this place.

the location is very noisy,the furniture is old and need maintenance
and no elevator in the building with high stairs and the wifi not working
Girişte kolaylık sağladı, nevresimler banyo temizdi konum iyiydi, ev sahibi hızlı yanıt verdi. Sessiz konforlu bir konaylamaydı. Teşekkür ederiz

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the hearth of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers fully equipped design apartment across partial Bosphorus (sea) view. Located right on the the famous Istiklal Street, you will find historic places, prestigious museums, night life, public transits and more just beside you.

With a restaurant cooking delicious meals downstairs, daily cleaning service and assistance for all kinds of concierge needs, this apartment is to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text:
A beautiful apartment. Spacious, clean, great location. Despite Istiklal being packed with shoppers, this space is quiet and peaceful (as it faces away from the street).
Location on lower part of Istiklal also worked well for us, as it is a bit more peaceful than spaces closer to Taksim.
At night you might hear the restaurant downstairs pack up chairs - but it didn’t bother us too much.
If you want to experience Istiklal, this is the place for you. Great and responsive hosts.
Thanks!

The flat was really amazing, in a very good location and the service was exceptional. Whenever we needed anything from the host, they’d respond right away and help us with whatever they can. I also loved the cleaning service and loved the ease of communication.

Very convenient apartment, with very good amenities: washer with built-in dryer, dishwasher, Smart TV (we used our Netflix account), convenient and large bed, as well as couch. The host is great and communicates very well and helped us with everything we needed. Convenient smart door lock. The apartment is located on Istiklal street which was a surprise for us when we moved in, however, for our apt the windows were looking at the back yard so there was no noise from the street.

Good location. It’s important to mention that even it has windows faced to the backyard it is still apt in a building on the busiest street of Istanbul. You still will get a bit of noise.
The room is clean, fresh furnitured and has simple checkin. Great experience.
Very nice appartment. Clean, cozy and great location

description:
Istanbul is one of the oldest cities in the world. This is a vibrant, colorful, beautiful city with a rich history. You can start exploring this magnificent city with the La Porte de Taksim. In the apartment, you can feel the peace of your home and find pleasure and comfort together.


La Porte de Taksim is 3 minutes walk from Taksim Square, which makes it easy to reach wherever you want to go.

There is reception 24 hours to answer your questions.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at the humble La Porte de Taksim.
The location could not be better, very convenient, central, short walking distance from metro/ bus, Taksim Square and Istiklal Street.
The room was very clean, comfy, nicely decorated and well equipped (exactly as shown in the photos). Check in and out was super simple and fast.
Orhan and his colleague has been a very warm, friendly and helpful host.
Would definitely recommend for all😁👍🏼

Great location right on the door stop to Taksim square and close to the metro station and taxi places. lovely side streets with lots to eat and 5 mins away from Istiklal Street which is lovely. The room was as described and cleaning was spot on! would recommend and would love to visit there again!
We liked staying at Orhans Hotel, it was very comfortable and clean. At reception they were helpful and available 24h. Thank you!

The location is excellent. The room
Was very clean good and had all necessary equipment. The host is very very helpful and friendly. One of my best stays in Istanbul. Superhost.
Hotel is well located. Easy to got to taksim square and public transport. Hotel wasn’t as clean as I would have liked and my room for two was quiet small. Other than that it was a good stay

description: This is a cozy private room with bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 4-5 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City.

reviews.text: The hotel is small and cosy. The location is great, 4 5 minute walk to the Blue Mosque. We were warmly welcomed. The staff were very nice and helpful. There were some issues with the hot water in the bathroom, but they said its already taken care of. From the balcony there is no view of the sea. There is a building site right next to the balcony and you can see the neighbors 15 meters away.
Comfortable bed, responsive staff, good location for sightseeing.

Perfect location walking distance to all the attractions and very safe even for solo travelers. The apartment was great as described and found all the amenities that i need . I stayed a week and if i will come back i will stay at the same place . Highly recommended. Thank you Zeynep

The whole experience was perfect. We had everything we needed. The location was great - minute walk to the Blue Mosque. There are restaurants all around and a hamam down the road too. I really would recommend staying here! The room as great, incredibly clean and very helpful hosts!

Alihan's accomodation and hospitality was great, I have no issues Our room was very clean. The only negative was the check-in. There was nobody to welcome us. We had to call a number on the door. I had to ask some staff from the hotel next door to make the phone call for us because we couldn't from our phones. I highly recommend this place

description: This bright studio apartment is designed to comfortably accommodate up to 4 guests. It features a queen-size bed (160×200), a separate single bedroom, and a sofa bed in the living area. Two air conditioners provide comfort throughout the apartment. The practical kitchenette includes a microwave, refrigerator, kettle, cookware and basic utensils for preparing simple meals. Three French balconies fill the apartment with natural light. Apartment is located on the 4th floor and there is no elevator.

reviews.text:
The place is wonderful! It has everything I could’ve asked for, clean bed, nice shower, washing machine and a laundry rack. Bükra went above and beyond communicating with us and making sure our check in went well.
The place is very peaceful and quiet, no music or nightclubs nearby, so we really had good night sleep.
The stairs were fun, gave me a nice legs workout but overall, I would surely stay here again in the future.

We had a wonderful stay! The location is perfect, very central and with beautiful surroundings, which made our visit even more enjoyable.
Cinar was a fantastic host: always attentive, helpful, and quick to respond to any questions. At our request upon arrival, he promptly rearranged the furniture and moved the bed in the middle of the living room to a more private position, to match the layout in the photos, which made a big difference.
The flat itself is cozy and minimalist, with a simple yet comfortable atmosphere. The kitchen is well-equipped for basic needs; however, if you're planning to cook extensively to avoid eating out all the time, it might feel slightly limited in terms of utensils and equipment.
Overall, we had a great time and would definitely recommend this place. Cinar’s hospitality made our stay exceptional, and when we return to Istanbul, we will definitely stay here. We wish Cinar all the best!
Great host, helped me with my luggage and made sure I was happy with the stay, very safe neighbourhood. A+++ location. Apartment was exactly as described totally enjoyed my stay thank you

As a local I can say that this is the best location in the town. The apartment is just like in the photos. It has enough equipment for cooking, and it’s very close to cafés, restaurants, and the tram. Just be prepared for the stairs. It was truly a great experience.. thanks to Çınar.
We had an unplanned stay in Istanbul. Isa was really helpful and the place itself was very clean. I cant believe we stayed in a premium location with such prices

description: A private room with shared big living area In Taksim heart of Istanbul. Furnished as you need. We have big shared kitchen. Only vegetarian foods are allowed to cook in the kitchen. There are many cafés in the vicinity. Our house have total 3 rooms. I am living in one of this room, and other two for rent. Sometimes my doctor brother also living here. At home, we prefer eco-friendly products instead of toxic chemical products. We are open to socializing with our guests who want to be socialized

reviews.text: We were welcomed by Sezer, Murat's cousin. The arrival was perfect, the communication upstream was accommodating. We had a very good stay. The accommodation itself is very pretty, well decorated, clean and practical. Its location is ideal, we did everything on foot. We enjoyed many shops and restaurants around. The room we had overlooks a quiet tree-lined courtyard (only the noise of the cats), you can sleep peacefully with the window open with the installation of the mosquito net. Thank you very much for the pleasant welcome and stay, thank you for your kindness Sezer, we will come back with pleasure :)

very cosy and homey ... very clean, amazing location and great value for money for such a vibrant area.
the host is very communicative and kind and I enjoyed my stay ♥️

From the very first meeting with Eylem I felt I met a friend. Great recommendations for anything I needed and would also check in on me to see if I was ok. Everything was clean, peaceful and I was able to have some good sleep there. The area is fantastic; great cafes, bars, restaurants in a really lively neighborhood yet also close to all the tourist sights you’d want to see. Very quiet in the room even though it’s a busy neighborhood!
Finally, I felt like I made friends with truly, caring people that I was staying with, it really made me feel welcome. What a great find!

If you’re looking for the love of your life or a turkish holiday fling this is the place to go, have your own eat, pray, love moment abroad look no further then this accommodation with a beautiful host who will always help you with whatever you need and is always down for a talk and to help you - the house was very clean and even better then I expected with a large room and kitchen and amazing destination with restaurants and stores closeby

Beautiful apartment — well furnished, spacious, and quiet, in the most lovely neighborhood. Excellent for longterm stays. This apartment will be my go-to during future stays in Istanbul. Murat is a top-tier host.

description: Fenerbahçe is a very-known area here in the asian part of İstanbul with it's beautiful sea view. Our building (also known with it's history, designed and built with the wave of Bauhaus) located at the heart of this wonderful neighborhood. You can also see our building at many famous turkish TV series and films because of it's unique decoration! :) You can take a walk near the sea side any time you want and the good thing is it's just 1 minute from your door to get there!

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described, clean, cozy, and in a great location. Our host was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and made sure we had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. I’d absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. Thank you so much for the hospitality!

Very pleasant experience, space was larger than we thought. Easy communication and checking in/out. Very quiet and calm. Cem was very helpful, booking us a taxi for our very early departure.
Thanks again.
Clean, well situated and enough space. Cem was very helpful and check-in was so easy.
Quite location, near the coastline where you can run and exercise. Place is clean and nice.
Yer çok merkeziydi. Her şey özenli ve tertemizdi. Sessiz,sakin ve huzurlu bir ortamda gönül rahatlığıyla 2 günümüzü geçirdik.

description: Located in the Cihangir Firuzağa neighborhood, Galataporta is within a five-minute walk of Istiklal Avenue, Taksim Square and Karaköy. It is within walking distance of cafes, markets and restaurants. It is very close to the Galata Tower and the historical peninsula of Sultan Ahmet and Hagia Sophia. Our apartment, known for its proximity to the beach, subway, tram, supermarket, hospital and entertainment centers, awaits its valued guests with the hope that you will have a nice holiday in Cihangir.

reviews.text: The apartment and neighborhood were perfect for us - close to public transit, restaurants, cultural sites and grocery stores. The apartment was very clean and Harun was a great host - very flexible, accommodating and responsive. It was nice to have a washer to clean our clothes and we appreciated being able to use the AC as a heater for the cold fall mornings. Please be aware that despite being listed as amenities, there was no microwave, dishwasher or ceiling fan when we stayed, and the clothes drying rack was a clothesline outside the apartment. Lack of these amenities was not a problem for us, but they would have been nice to have during our stay. Overall we really enjoyed the apartment and we'll be sure to stay with Harun when we return to Istanbul.

Harun Bey’in evinde konaklama deneyimimiz gerçekten çok güzeldi. Evin temizliği, düzeni ve konforu beklentilerimizin üzerindeydi. Fotograflarda görünenin birebir aynısı hatta daha da güzel bir ortamla karşılaştık. Konum olarak da oldukça merkezi ve ulaşımı çok rahattı.
Harun Bey son derece ilgili ve misafirperver bir ev sahibi. Her sorumuza hızlıca yanıt verdi, ihtiyaç duyduğumuz her konuda yardımcı oldu. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik.
Kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğimiz bir yer. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.
Çok teşekkürler Harun Bey 🙏✨

Great stay and Harun Bey is a very helpful host. The apartment matches the description — clean, cozy, and comfortable. The location is perfect, with cafés, shops, and transportation within walking distance. Check-in and check-out were super smooth, and the host kindly allowed us to check in earlier and check out later, which really helped. We had a great experience and would happily stay here again. Highly recommend!

Me and my family were very satisified with our stay, the house was very clean and had a lot of supplies that were really helpful. The house is located in a really good area that isn't far from the bus/train station and also only a few stops away or within walking distance from famous spots. The four of us had a comfortable stay and the neighborhood was calm day and night, we slept very well. Harun was very accomdating and helpful and very responsive whenever we reached out to him which made things easier. We're very thankful and recommend staying at his home.

This is a little gem in a great location. So many great restaurants and cafes as well as grocery stores just a few minutes walking distance. The train and Galata Port are also less than a 10 min walk.
Harun is wonderful!! So kind and great at communication. He gets a 10/10 as a host!!
I utilized both the kitchen and the washing machine and booked this specifically for those reasons.
I was a little sick this trip so I found myself needing extra rest. The couch is VERY comfy. I expanded it into the bed and I was able to relax and watch movies.
If you have mobility issues, please note that there is a lot of uphill and downhill for walking in this area. The location is 10/10 and I highly recommend wandering around the area to enjoy the little shops and cafes. Galata Tower is also close and really cool to experience at night. Grab a spot at a cafe beside it and enjoy the famous cheesecake.

description: Our house in Büyükada is located close to the center and is our home with double balconies for you to relax and have a family vacation.

reviews.text:
My parents and I had a wonderful stay at Sila’s apartment! The place is exactly as described, less than a 10 minute walk from the port, so no need for any transportation. We chose this apartment mainly for its terrace, and it did not disappoint, the view is absolutely beautiful! There’s also a lovely balcony on the other side overlooking the street.
The apartment is very clean, well equipped, with heating in every room, plenty of towels, blankets, and all the kitchen utensils you might need.
Sila is such a kind and attentive host, always quick to respond and making sure we had everything we needed to feel comfortable. We truly appreciated her care and hospitality. Would be happy to come back again!
If you’re looking for a pleasant and comfortable stay on Büyükada Island, Sila’s apartment is the place to be.

Ev görsellerde göründüğü gibiydi. Temiz, düzenli ve konforlu bir evdi. Akşam balkon keyfi yapmak oldukça eğlenceliydi. Ev sahibi iletişim kurmak kolaydı, canayakın ve misafirperver insanlardı. Evin tek eksiği banyonun aydınlatmasının olmamasıydı, akşam duş almak isteyenler için bu bir sorun. Biz 2 gece kaldığımız için mağdur olmadık ama göz önünde bulundurulmalı.

Sila was the sweetest! she welcomed us and showed us around the house and checked on us during our stay:) the place is even better than the pictures. The balcony is stunning with a view of the sea. we used the kitchen and it was equipped with everything we needed. The place was perfectly clean! We definitely enjoyed our stay. Thank you sila for your kindness❤️

Konumu iskeleye yürüyerek 5-6 dakika (ada için muhteşem bir konum). Balkonu gerçekten çok keyifliydi. Sibel hanım ilk günden çıkışa kadar hep iletişim halindeydi. Çok kibar ve nazik birisi. Ev çok temizdi. Çok sayıda çarşaf ve yastık bırakılmıştı. Çok rahattık ve çok keyif aldık.

Ev sahibi Sibel hanım gayet ilgiliydi, evin temizliği gayet iyiydi.
Konum olarak fena Sayilmaz feribottan inince 7,8 dk yürüme mesafesinde fiyat performans olarak fena değilde herkese tavsiye ederim.

description: Cozy and very bright apartment on 1th floor with 1 comfortable living room and 2 bedrooms.

reviews.text:
I would like to breakdown our stay into multiple categories:
1- Host: 5 stars for her communication and response time.
2- Location: I already knew the area but for others this is a 5 star location with walking distance almost everything. Parking was a plus!
3- Property: Unfortunately, this is where our expectations were not met, with all fairness for the issues we had, we did not contact the host as we had busy schedule:
- Issue 1: Bed frame, was squeaking in every move, both me and my wife are light sleepers and we were not able to sleep at all on our fist night and had to move the bed.
- Issue 2: Cleanness, dishwasher had items not washed, towels with Clorox stains, things tossed in drawers.
Overall, I am not expecting a hotel like service but airbnb experience should not be like here are my old couch, towels etc. go use them mentality. This is still hospitality service and for this stay our expectations not met.

In my opinion the apartment is located in one of the best areas of Istanbul. New beautiful house in a convenient location. The owner lives in the same building 9 floors up. This is a very pleasant bright apartment where you want to live, especially in a large living room with floor-to-ceiling windows. Disadvantages: creaky bed and a broken roller shutter in the bedroom, for this reason it is dark there. Low water pressure and frequent problems with the Internet due to the fault of the provider. Near the house there is an aviary with two dogs that can bark for a long time. Otherwise, this is a great place that I can confidently recommend.

Çok yeni ve temiz bir bina,nezih bir bölgede,açık/kapalı otoparkı olması benim içim çok önemliydi,Ev sahibi Rumeysa Hn.çok nazik ve kolay iletişim kurulan bir hanımefendi. Evdeki küçük eksik ya da sorunları hızlıca halledip konaklamamı çok konforlu bir hale getirdi.Tekrar kalmak isteyeceğim bir ev. Tavsiye Ederim.

The owner is a very friendly and nice woman. Her apartment is modern and clean, we felt at home. There is everything you need. The area is nice and quiet, there are shops nearby. 10 minutes to marmaray. 8 minutes to bagdat street. 15 minutes to a very beautiful park with a playground.
We enjoyed the stay :)
Yeni Bina olmasi guven verici. Ev marmaray istasyonuna ve caddeye yurume mesafinde dolayisiyla konumu mukemmel. Ev sahibi cok ilgili ve her konuda yardimci olmaya calisti.
