reviews.text: The host was very kind and responded quickly to messages. The accommodation is in an excellent location in the very center of Taksim. There is a metro station nearby and you can easily get to any part of the city. The accommodation is located above a cafe, so it can be noisy until late at night. if you've been walking around Istanbul all day, it won't be a problem because you'll be tired and fall asleep easily. The host could make an effort and arrange the apartment a little better. Stains are visible on the walls and the toilet bowl. Water is leaking from the faucet in the shower cabin, and there is no hot water in the sink. cables for electricity, air conditioning, television and extension cables hang from the walls in the room. If these little things were taken care of, the owner could ask for more money to rent the apartment.

The plaxe was clean and Ilyas was very responsive and polite though I have to note some issues with his place. First of all; there is a smoke scent in the apartment. I saw an ashtray on the table, which means he is letting people to smoke. This was not mentioned on the listing. Second issue is the noise. The apartment is in the first floor of a commercial building, just above cafes. Besides the noise coming from the cafes, there were people walking up and down in the building and talking loudly in the middle of the night. I woke up from a deep sleep as somebody was shouting in the building. The building entrance is also not pleasant; definitely not a suitable place to reside.

Very close to istiklal road, transportation is super easy. The host is very responsive, kind and helpful. The room is clean, its a like small studio with cute kitchen and private bathroom and located just on first floor. The place is not secluded coz there are shops and cafes below it.

It was an absolute pleasure to be the first Airbnb guest here because the apartment is perfect! Everything was so clean, neat and accessible. I highly recommend staying here especially if you want to be near all the hustle of Istiklal Street.
İlyas was a fantastic host, very attentive but not intrusive. It was a perfect stay and I’ll be coming back.
Do stay if you get a chance!
Very comfortable room with great location and restaurants around. Ilyas was always helpful.

description: Tiny Ballıca is located within the borders of Ballıca Village, 15 mins from Sabiha Gökçen Airport and Viaport Shopping Center and 5 mins from Intercity İstanbul Park. Being very close to the city makes it possible to get away from the crowd and meet with nature and calmness whenever you want. Our tiny house has an open kitchen, a double bedroom on the loft floor, a bathroom and has its own patio. With fireplace & air condition, the house is ideal for both summer and winter getaways.

reviews.text: Zeynep Hanım ve Mustafa Bey’in ev sahipliğinde, beklentilerimin tam karşılığını aldığım harika bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Hava hep yağmurlu olmasına rağmen evin içindeki huzur ve konfor sayesinde vaktimizi çok keyifli geçirdik. Ev, fotoğraflarda ne gördüyseniz aynen öyle; mobilyalar gayet rahat, temizlik ise kusursuzdu. Özellikle şömine ve barbekü yakma konusunda Mustafa Bey’in gösterdiği samimi destek ve yardımseverliği için kendisine tekrar teşekkür ederim. Evin teknik altyapısı da çok başarılı; mutfakta ihtiyacınız olan tüm araç gereçler mevcut, duşta su sıcaklığı ve basıncıyla ilgili hiçbir sorun yaşamadık. Şömine ve klimanın varlığı soğuk günler için gayet yeterli. Dış mekanda ise bahçenin, şezlongların ve salıncağın tadını çıkarmak paha biçilemez. Otopark imkanı ve garaj anahtarının teslim edilmesi giriş-çıkışlarda büyük bir özgürlük sağlıyor. Ev sahiplerinin flamingolarla kahvaltı ve at binme gibi yerel önerileri ise tatilimize ayrı bir renk kattı. Şiddetle tavsiye ederim!

We immediately moved to this amazing place just after the earthquake to feel safe and relaxed.
everything was amazing!
Host and all her family are so nice, kind, interesting, amazing, beautiful people!

They showed us forest and nature around, were helping to do fire at nights, even helped us to bring forgotten earrings to the airport when we left the accommodation.
Place is super close to SAW airport. the hosts dad can give a lift for a just 10€.
House is private. Has everything you may need and even more. We appreciate a lot when hosts cares for little really useful things for guests. That when you book place with kitchen for example you will have a pans, salt, oils, spices, napkins and coffee, tea and so on.
So when you arrive you can just relax,
It’s hard if you need to do this when traveling for every new accommodation.
By the way, if you need shops it’s just 5-10 min to walk from the house.
We were really happy to stay there. We would love to come back one day 🙏🏼

Serap hanım ve Mustafa beye ilgileri için teşekkür ederiz. Ev, konum olarak İstanbul dışı gibi hissettiren ama çok yakın bir konumda. Köyün havası doğası nefis. Ev, genel günlük kullanıma uygun. Biz sürekli kamp malzemeleri ile gezdiğimiz için kendi mutfak eşyalarımız vardı, evde o anlamda eksikler mevcut. Günlük temizlik çok yerinde, biraz tozlu noktalar var. Ev şömineyi güçlü yakarsanız ısınıyor, banyo ise soğuk taş zemin sebebiyle. Ek olarak duş başlığı kırıktı, değiştirilebilir. Rahatsız edilmeden huzurla 2 gün geçirdik.

Öncelikle bahçesi yetersiz fotoğraflandırılmış. Ev sahibi amcamızın bahçesine konulmuş bir tiny. Evinizin önüne, yanına gelmeler gitmeler geçmeler olabiliyor sürekli. Her tarafın cam olması sizi tedirgin edebilir. Bu konuda pek rahat edemedim. Malum şehirdeyiz, köpeğimi rahatça oynatabilecegim bir bahçe var diye burayı tercih etmiştim. Fakat ev sahibi bahçede köpeği gezdiremeyecegimi söyledi. Bu sebeple tamamen fiyasko oldu konaklama. Sadece eve hayvan alabiliyorsunuz diyelim. İlanda her ne kadar duman dedektörü yoktur, karbonmonoksit alarmı yoktur dese de içeride sigara içmenize de izin verilmiyor. Konum olarak da dışarıda çok çok fazla sayıda gruplaşmış sokak köpeği var. Köpeğiniz varsa bu da sizi tedirgin edebilir. Bu olumsuzluklar haricinde şirin bir yer ama maalesef benim beklentimi karşılamadı.

Konum olarak doğa ile iç içe,yeşilliklerle dolu bi ortamdan çok güzel bir zevkle döşenmiş, tertemiz, sıcacık ambiyansı olan bir evde geçirdiğimiz bir tatil için ev sahibi zeynep hanıma teşekkürlemizi iletiriz. Mahremiyete oldukça saygı duyulan, ince düşünceler ile sizi mutlu ettiren bir ortamda,gönül rahatlığı ile konaklayabilirsiniz. Evde her şey sizin için düşünülmüş,eksiksiz. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz:)

description:
Relax with the whole family or friends at this peaceful & luxurious place.
Stylish, modern and brand new fully furnished apartment.
On the Ground floor with a terrace having an amazing garden view full of greenery!
All the Building's Facilities from garden,gym,pool, and much more are all accessible by You!

reviews.text:
Our stay in the apartment (October 2022)
Let’s start with obvious positive moments
The apartment is new, clean, with nice design, located in a good new building with a nice inner garden!
The apartment has everything that is needed for your comfortable stay
Members of indigo team (landlord) - Mohammed and Ahmed are polite
Mohammed was waiting for us when we arrived
Showed everything
Near the building there is Oasis cadde (really small oasis with cafes and shops), not far away is Metro (big supermarket) and 212 outlet (mall)
Speaking about negative moments, unfortunately there were many of them
The Airbnb ad tells that apt includes safe and dryer machine
Neither safe nor dryer machine were in the apt
The building is located in the district with no fresh air at all (only in the inner garden of the building we were able to walk, we have a small baby)
It is near huge roads with traffic all the time and there are small chances to take a taxi, especially when you are in the city center and you need to go home or the price is very high
When you go out of the building pavement becomes very bad
Metro station is very far away and it is uncomfortable to reach it
Speaking about the landlord assistance-landlord was available in messenger , and was trying to solve our problems but we always needed to ask several times for the problem to be solved
Every our ask (to bring hairdryer for ex which should have been in the apartment but it actually wasn’t or buy dryer instead of dryer machine, or basic things like soap and toilet paper) took soooo much time or was not done at all
We had a problem with a balcony door since day one and it was fixed only 4 days after!
Another problem that we faced was wi fi, internet connection is crucial for us as we are working remotely and one day it stopped working, we texted about the problem at 2 pm daytime
Member of landlord team came at 10 pm in the evening, knowing we have a small baby
Couldn’t do anything
And left
After it next evening the technician came
So we had no internet for a really long time and needed to pay money for internet connection
We were surprised when suddenly Wassim (the main landlord as we understand) left the chat in messenger when we were communicating…
And the last but not least disappointment was when we were leaving the apartment
Check out is at 11, so Mohammed told us about it in advance
We asked even to come little earlier (10:40) as we had flight
No one came! To pick up keys
Insane
Very low quality service for such a huge price
We were again in the situation when we needed to reach the landlord and no one was replying to us!
So when we left we had a feeling that all in all it was okay but this little things made our stay much worse then it could be
We were staying in the apartment for 1 month
So our stay is like 6/10
Building 9/10
Location and transport availability 5/10
Landlord service 4/10
Apartment 8/10

I had a wonderful stay! The place was as described, clean, comfortable, and well-located. The host was very helpful and quick to respond. They made sure everything went smoothly. I’d definitely recommend this Airbnb and would be happy to stay again.
The apartment is very nice and comfortable. The pool is very clean, the gym is well-equipped, and the area is very quiet. Communication with the host was very good. I will return 😊😊😊

Excellent stay for a family of 3. Wassim provided a cot bed too for an additional fee.
All amenities ticked and a bonus with gym, pool.
Highly recommended as good as the location is, there is a local mall nearby and shop downstairs.
Thank you

Kesinlikle çok güzeldi, öncelikle fotoğraflardakiyle birebirdi konut. Çok güzel bir verandası vardı, ev çok temizdi, ayrıca gerekli her şey evde bulunmaktaydı. Giriş ve çıkış da çok kolaydı, çok keyifle konakladım. İlk girişte sorun yaşadığım an ev sahipleri benimle anında ilgilenip sorunumu çok hızlıca çözdü; iletişimleri hızlı ve çözüm odaklıydı, gerçekten Indigo ile konaklamaktan keyif alıyorum, bu 2. seferimdi, bir dahaki sefere de yalnızca Indigo’dan devam edeceğim. Teşekkürler.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located apartment. Independent apartment in a quiet alley within walking distance to Kadıköy center, shopping center, all public transportation (Metrobus, Marmaray, Metro). The apartment has basic kitchen and food utensils, personal hygiene supplies, a washing machine and internet speed suitable for remote work.

reviews.text: Great apartment: very cosy,clean and comfortable.Super fast wi fi connection.Amazing terrace.We felt like a home far from home.The location is very nice : quite and central.Many shops, restaurants near by .Nice walking distance to sea promenade.The host is great: very attentive and hospitable.We have everything you need in one place . Thank you very much for hosting us.

I had an wonderful stay! First I must say that Yahya is an excellent host and awesome guy. He is very helpful and communicative, he always checked and made sure I had everything I needed. He also made sure any little issues were taken care of. He goes above and beyond!
The apartment is also super nice. The balcony with it's nice view of the city, the rocking/swinging bench and the singing birds is very relaxing.
The apartment is well equipped and has everything you need for a great stay. The bathroom looks new and modern and well done with the hot water always working perfectly.
The location is also really great. It's just a short walk to get to cafes and shops in Kadiköy, and very conveniently, about a 10 minute walk to a Marmaray station which can connect you to the entire city of Istanbul.
If you're looking for a relaxing stay with access to explore the city, I recommend this place!

Bizim için en önemli iki şey olan evin konumu ve temizliği oldukça iyiydi. Evde ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz hemen hemen her şey mevcut, iletişim de çok iyiydi ve ekstra ihtiyaçlarımıza hemen destek oldular, tekrar teşekkürler. Evin terası gerçekten bu mevsimde akşamları vakit geçirmek harika. Yalnızca yatak/karyola iyileştirilmesini tavsiye edebilirim.

The host was very welcoming and easy to communicate. Everything you need for a short trip was accessible. Clean house, excellent location. Terrace was also beautiful to chill. 10/10 recommend this place

This is one of the best apartments we've ever rented. Excellent location (near YHT and Marmaray station, within walking distance to Kadikoy ferry berth), while in a quiet place where there is no fuss and noise. The apartment was perfectly clean and very well maintained. The apartment has absolutely everything for a comfortable life. Everything is thought out to the smallest detail! I would love to stay in this apartment for a longer time. Thank you to the owner for the love he has invested in this apartment.

description: Sea View Apartment in Taksim/ Center of Istanbul

reviews.text:
Flat is good. Everything as on Photo.
Location is comfortable, 5 minutes walking to Taksim square. Cleaning was good. For this price it is nice option. Wi-Fi was fast and water pressure in the shower always was good.
Nice view from the windows.
The owner Berat is kind and helpful guy, he recommended us many places near the flat and was always in touch.
Easy to find flat and check in.

I was looking for an apartment away from the hustle and bustle while being well located and Berat’s place was perfect.
First of all, Berat is an excellent host. He is responsive, helpful, friendly and wants to ensure you feel at home.
His apartment is very clean, minimalist (which I like), peaceful with an incredible bedroom view. Perfect to recharge your batteries and work remotely (wifi works great). Kitchen is equipped with the basics which is nice if you want to cook. Also appreciated that the living room had space to do yoga and workout!
The neighbourhood was perfect. Very local, cool and well located. Get ready to go up and down some hills.

Lovely apartment with a great location and view.
Pros:
+ Great communication with the host. Berat lives nearby and can help. Once I forget keys from the apartment, it takes 10 mins to get spare ones from Berat.
+ Location, close to the city center and underground station
+ Good internet connection
+ It's quiet at night.
Cons:
- Spiral staircase on the 5th floor

Nice, central apartment with a great view - from the front room you can see the Bosphorus, from the bedroom you can see all across the pretty Istanbul houses. Berat's place is ideal for people who want a base to easily explore all the areas of Istanbul - Taksim square is very close, but it's also very easy to walk to the ferry point to get to the Asian side, and the golden horn is only about half an hour's walk. The apartment is simple but has good facilities - stove to cook on, fridge, washing machine, air con (although didn't use it) etc, although bear in mind it - like most Istanbul flats - has no lift and is on the 4th floor. Berat's communication was brilliant, and he lives nearby so it's easy to get help if you need it. I recommend Berat's place!

I spent three months in Berat's apartment and he really is the best host you could wish for.
He was always available, super friendly, replied fast and always had a solution for my queries. He also showed me a little bit around in Istanbul what was super fun and even organised some plants for the flat! He also provided me with super helpful tips.
The flat is simple but equipped with everything you need. The bed is super comfy and there is plenty of space in the living room.
The location is nearly perfect: Two minutes to Taksim Place/Istiklal Street (also Metrostation) and 6 Minutes to the Tram which brings you directly to the touristic places in Sultanahmed (Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque etc).
I can highly recommend this flat, except if you are a noise-sensitive person since it is quite noisy in the bedroom (you hear the pidgeons, seagulls and the discos, but the latter only until 1 am).
Have fun in Istanbul!

description:
Only available for long-term stays, with a minimum of 101 days.
Historic tower-like building in a great location. You can enjoy strolling through hip neighborhoods like AsmalıMescid, İstiklal Caddesi, Karaköy,Galata Tower(all within 5-6 mins. as well as Şişhane metro and Tophane tram stops)

Ask for monthly prices. Weekly cleaning included.

With eclectic decoration, lots of windows and high ceilings you will feel in a unique space.

Solo travelers and remote workers are welcome!
Pet Friendly

reviews.text:
Our stay in Muhils apartment was wonderful. the location is perfect, the street is lively and filled with locals and kids playing.
Muhil was extremely helpful and proactive, we did a self check-in but he came to meet us the next day and provided a fantastic list of recommendations.
The apartment was comfortable, safe, and we appreciated the abundant natural light and balcony.
We would recommend it to anyone.

Great
Clean and comfortable, alot of activities nearby.

The apartment and the host Muhlis were great. Location of the apartment is really the best if you are planning a stay for few months in Istanbul. Everything is walking distance. Muhlis was a great host, always responsive and always there to help! He provided some great local recommendations which were really game changers!! Thank you for the wonderful stay.

Nice and perfect!!
We spent a pleasant month in Muhlis' apartment. We felt safe and at home. Muhlis is very kind, friendly and sincere. His availability was remarkable and warm throughout our stay. He responded promptly and happily to all our questions and requests and provided us with all recommendations and instructions to make our stay more enjoyable. The apartment was clean, well furnished and equipped for living and cooking. The water pressure was impressive.
We greatly thank Muhlis for his remarkable hospitality as well as Kadriye for her kindness and efficient housekeeping.
We would return without any hesitation.

Çok keyifli bir konaklama süreci geçirdim. Muhlis çok kibar, misafirperver, arkadaş canlısı, iletişime açık ve yardım severdi. Her konuda çok yardımcı oldu. Kendisini tanıdığım için çok mutlu oldum. Giriş ve çıkış süreci sorunsuz ve güzel geçti. Tekrar burada konaklamak isterim. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederim.

description: Welcome home to our beautiful bright intimate 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom in prime Nisantasi location! Walking distance to the American Hospital. Supermarket, taxi stand, cafes and restaurants are all at your doorstep! This fully equipped open kitchen, spacious living room is the perfect lounge spot to hang with friends and family. Situated on the 3rd floor with an elevator. Comes with A/C,Wifi & Netflix.

reviews.text:
I recently stayed at an apartment in Istanbul Şişli for 8 days and had a wonderful experience. The apartment was modern, clean, and well-maintained. It had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay, including a fully equipped kitchen, a spacious living area, and a comfortable bed.
The location of the apartment was fantastic. It was situated in the heart of Şişli, with easy access to various restaurants, shops, and public transportation. The neighborhood felt safe and vibrant, with plenty of options for dining and entertainment right at my doorstep.
The check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free, thanks to the helpful and responsive host. They provided clear instructions and were readily available to answer any questions or address any concerns I had during my stay.

The place is lovely for a short stay, very clean and as advertised in the photos!
The host was extremely responsive and nice, they helped us a lot throughout our stay :)
But the only inconvenient pointer is that the bathroom flush was not working properly and we asked for it to get fixed twice , and workers came but unfortunately with no luck... hope they fix it soon tho
Also the location is pretty nice but be aware that to get to the nearest metro/ bus station you have to walk around 10 mins so it wasn't the best scenario as we had our mom with us, so we had to take taxis everyday.
But overall it is a very clean and spacious apartment in a very safe neighborhood and there's a supermarket right in front of the building .
Thank you :)

Excellent property in a convenient location.
Stayed for a two week period which was, on the whole, a very comfortable stay. The apartment is located next to a gym, supermarket, mosque, high street and restaurants which made staying here very convenient.
The apartment was clean and actually looked like the pictures used to advertise it, which was a pleasant surprise.
The only suggestions for improvement would be to have slightly better beds and to add an extractor fan to the shower room. As we stayed for a two week period, the bed comfort was more of a concern for us, but for any shorter period, would be perfectly fine.
I would highly recommend this property and would definitely consider staying here again.
Thank you for everything.

the location is perfect. the apartment was clean and comfortable. the only thing what was surprising me was heating, which was turn off after 19:00. the hosts was always on line and ready to help. they brought me electric heater. and the bathroom is too small. but all in all it's a good apartment.

Good apartment in good location. Very polite communication and detailed instructions. Cafes and shops within walking distance. The building has an elevator. There is a mosque near the house, so take care of earplugs if the sound disturbs your sleep. The kitchen is very small, I wish it was bigger. But other than that, I recommend it!

description: A spacious, well-organized apartment with the necessary equipment, located in the heart of the city. It has a unique sea view. It overlooks Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace and the old city. Within walking distance to all public transportation and touristic locations. Close to Galataport Shopping Mall, Istanbul Modern and Mimar Sinan museums, popular cafes, bars, restaurants and antique shops. Cihangir is a center of attraction that hosts a cosmopolitan population that combines the old, the new and the cats.

reviews.text:
Greetings,
I’m writing this review to describe my experience in staying with Naj Apartment, I really really had a great stay and i enjoyed with the view very much! The Rise and Sunset was beautiful and gorgeous!
Everything was near the Apartment, Galataport, Taksim, galata tower, shops, restaurants, Groceries was near 1 minute walking.
The Apartment was clean, big, good shower, no noises at all, had all the necessary amenities, and the host Najia was supportive and kind, she’s very responsive and available at all times.
I will definitely book this apartment the second time i visit Istanbul.
sincerely.

Perfect Istanbul apartment! My teenage daughter and I stayed at Naj’s place on two several day occasions during our travels in Turkey this month, and I can’t say enough about how fantastic it is. Cihangir is a fun, lively neighborhood, and Naj’s apartment has an excellent location near all the restaurants and shops while also being peaceful. The views are jaw dropping at all hours, the best amenity to have in Istanbul! The apartment itself is spotless and thoughtfully laid out and designed with all the comforts, and the building has an elevator. Naj was a wonderful host, proactively reaching out to offer to keep our luggage in the apt for a few days while we travelled. The price premium is absolutely worth it for a memorable and seamless stay. I can’t wait to return!

Been to 6 air b and bs in all of Istanbul and never had such a great experience with a host, the greatest view in all of Istanbul, hands down, no question. The pictures you see, is what your getting. How clean the place was to how many amenities and extra towels, hand towels everything u need to stay there have not been seen anywhere else I have been here in Istanbul, hotels or air b and bs, she kept the place clean and so beautiful like your at home and it is unbeatable in the whole city for the price and the convenience. Recommend this host over any with all my knowledge this whole month being in Istanbul, you will not be disappointed. She’s so kind, sweet, helpful and has a gem that will take your breath away day and night staying there. Thank you so much Naj!!

We loved the place. Comfortable and cute, it has a picture postcard view of the city and the Bosphorus Strait. including the Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. It's in a great central location, there's tons of cute bohemian cafes and cats nearby, and it's a short walk to the water, and the tram. Great choice if you want to explore Istanbul.

This is a really great place:
1. Location 10 min walk to the tram stop; 15 min to Taksim Square or Istiklal Street.
2. Unique views: Bosphorus, Princes' Islands, Old Istanbul.
3. Sparkling cleanliness.
4. The apartment is equipped with everything you need.
5. Very comfortable beds.
6. The treasure of the house is the owner - caring, cordial, helpful.
I would like to come back here!

description: This stylish place offers everything you need for a luxurious stay. There is also a shared terrace and a kitchenette on the 2nd floor of our facility.

reviews.text:
We stayed 2 nights in the room. It is perfectly located just 3min from Taksim Square and very easy to find. The room was squeaky clean, warm and very comfortable.
Celal responds in less than 10min and the check-in and out was flawless.
The hotel also has a terrace which we didn‘t use, but looked very comfortable to sit and drink tea in, and potentially work. The wifi was flawless too.
Highly recommend this if you are staying near taksim and want to explore istanbul for a few nights.

The location here is exceptional. There is an extremely steep hill you need to walk up, but it’s only about 25 m to the top. Celal insisted on helping me with my bags both on arrival and departure so that was not an issue. It should not really be an issue anyway, but it was very kind of him. The place was quite clean and had everything I needed. Don’t miss the upstairs rooftop area. There is also a shared kitchen of sorts up there that you can utilize. I felt very safe there, especially since he was always nearby. This was a very good Airbnb experience.

The place met our expectations regarding cleanliness, equipment, location, and more. Even though the photos gave the impression of a more spacious accommodation, it was more than enough for two people. The apartment is located in the "European part" of the city, in the heart of Taksim Square and several sights. Celal was always open, communicative, present only as needed, and supportive. For example, we asked for the iron and forgot to return it during the day, but Celal was understanding. All in all, everything went wonderfully and I can say it is one of the best budget accommodations in Istanbul!

Celal was an amazing host, who always responded to our messages promptly. He is very friendly and helped us carry our luggage up the stairs. The room was clean and the location of the Airbnb was perfect.
The only negatives that I have is that the room is small and the Airbnb is on a very steep hill. This Airbnb is perfect for a couple who are looking to get away for a few days.

Konumu harika, yürüyerek 5 dakikada taksime ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Geceleri de sakin, sessiz bir lokasyondaydı rahat bir şekilde dinlenebildik. Celal Bey de çok ilgili bir ev sahibi, konaklama dışında ulaşım gibi ihtiyaç duyduğumuz diğer noktalarda ne zaman istesek yardımcı oldu. İstanbul’a tekrar yolumuz düştüğünde tercih edeceğimiz bir yer 🙏

description: Our apartments are distinguished by the spacious area suitable for family residence, as it contains all the necessary necessities for a comfortable and happy stay, where you feel as if you are in your own home. We also have a 24/24 reception desk to secure the needs of guests at any time, and the entire building contains a security system and cameras that work around the clock In addition to the availability of the Internet throughout the hotel, also the apartments have amazing city view

reviews.text:
Where do I even begin? Staying at the Hexa Hotel was less of a vacation and more of a nightmare situation. The check-in process was the only good thing with Abolaziz at the desk; the rest was sign of things to come.

The room itself defied all expectations of what a human dwelling should be. Very old furniture, stain couches and very cheap chairs and table, all and all low grade with every item in each room.
But the true highlight, or lowlight, was the bathroom. Very small bathroom with none functioning toilet seats,( I'm still not convinced the toilets were properly attached to the floor), and the thin wall between the neighboring rooms, could smell the cigarette smoke from other rooms in the bathrooms, Tiny shower area without proper enclosure, could not take shower without having the entire area wet, The towels were the consistency of very thin fabric and so on.
No TV channels/programming and no internet at all while it is advertized on Airbnb site of the facility.

Great value and location for our group. Beds were good enough for one night.
Hosts were responsive to any and all requests.
Hot water in showers and towels were fresh!
The smoke from surrounding apts would make its way into our unit, but according to our patient and kind hosts, this is typical for all the smokers in Turkey.
The spa looked amazing when I toured it, but ran out of time.

Everything was beautiful as in the photo, the rooms were perfect, clean and quiet. Metro was not far by walking 10 min.
Taksim square was not that far. I recommend it to everyone. The hotel didn't call a taxi, that was a bit awkward.

The flat is spacious and well-maintained. While two of the rooms lack a view, they are clean and comfortable. The third room has a window, though it faces a nearby building. The living room offers plenty of space, making it a standout feature. However, there is a shortage of wall sockets, with only one available in each room.
Konum güzel ev güzel temizlik gayet iyi fakat fiyat biraz fazla ama konumu itibariyle normal denilebilir bu duruma da

description: This stylish place is close to must-see destinations.

reviews.text: Nice room. Not too big, but more than enough for two. Great location. Many beautiful sights within walking distance. Host responds quickly and clearly to questions.
Great location excellent value

The apartment is located in the city center. There are many attractions, a metro station, and a tram stop nearby. The room itself was not large and was well-appointed. I would recommend this accommodation for a short-term stay.
Alles super und top Location usw aber es war bissl klein aber passt schon
There were no available room.But they accepted my booking. When I reached this hotel 10pm, they said we don't have available room.

description: Located in Galata, inside a historical building (Han) built by Sultan Abdulhamit in 1890. With a space of 280 sqm, 5B+2Bathroom. We are loc on Camekan St, we are on 3rd floor. With its brick walls finished w modern art paintings and its 4m high ceilings decorated w murals by the best artists of its time, our authentic apt promises a memorable journey through Istanbul’s history. The apt consists of high speed wi-fi service, as well as fully equipped bathrooms & kitchen.

reviews.text: The apartment is as wonderful as it appears in the ad. The AC works well in all rooms and was welcome to come home to after hours out in the heat. Easy and short access to restaurants, bars and shopping, and grocery stores and bakeries for everyday needs in the apartment. We expected noise from nearby bars and restaurants as well as being woken up by calls to prayer at night, but the apartment is in a brick courtyard which insulated a lot of sound. Also, restaurants and bars close to the apartment closed at midnight so we experienced no disturbances. The apartment was very clean and tidy. The host responded very quickly to questions and needs we had. Tip: we used Mayer's transport to and from the airport and it was worth its weight in gold!

Absolutely fantastic stay in the heart of Galata! The location is unbeatable, just a stone's throw from Galata Tower with easy access to Old Town sights and the transport system (as long as you are OK with with walking up/down the hill on which Galata neighborhood is built). Plenty of restaurants and a MigrosJet nearby made it super convenient to eat out or in.
The apartment itself was exactly as described - clean, spacious, and stylish. One room was a master suite, another was large, and there were three smaller ones, all very comfortable. Our host was incredibly responsive and helpful with all our questions.
It was perfect for our stay, and we would definitely stay here again - highly recommend it for others.

This is a truly excellent apartment located in the historic center of the city. The description of the place is accurate, and the host is very responsive. The flat is quite spacious, occupying an entire floor of a building with high ceilings. It's modern and equipped with air conditioning in all rooms, except for one. Additionally, there are plenty of good restaurants nearby.
The only drawback is that the hot water in the showers can be a bit unstable at times, but it's not a major issue. The kitchenware provided is not extensive, and it might be helpful to have a microwave oven added. Nevertheless, everything else about the place is fantastic. I would definitely recommend it, especially for large groups of travelers (7 or more).

We had a fantastic stay and can highly recommend this apartment, especially for larger groups.
The location is perfect, just a few steps from the iconic Galata Tower and within easy reach of everything Istanbul has to offer. The apartment itself is very spacious, with five bedrooms, two bathrooms, an additional toilet, and a large common area combining the living room and kitchen, making it ideal for families or groups of friends.
Meyer was incredibly helpful and responsive at all hours of the day, assisting us with anything we needed. They also arranged both our airport pickup and return transfer, which made the trip much more convenient.
The surrounding streets are full of independent shops, charming cafés, and great breakfast spots, giving the neighborhood a very authentic atmosphere.
Overall, this apartment is an excellent base for exploring Istanbul. Most attractions, restaurants, and neighborhoods are within easy reach. We would definitely stay here again.

We had a great stay the house is in a fantastic location right in the heart of Taksim, with easy access to all the main attractions. It’s very spacious, comfortable, and equipped with good amenities, making it a great choice for a group.
The only downside was that the house is on the third floor, and the elevator wasn’t working, so we had to carry our luggage up the stairs. Additionally, the Wi-Fi had some issues initially, but once I raised the concern, the host promptly sent a technician, and the problem was resolved.
Despite these minor inconveniences, I’d still recommend this place for its great location and overall comfort.

description: This apartment is centrally located and 2 stops from Istanbul Expo Center (IFM) by M1 metro. It is 5 km by taxi or private vehicle. You can get to the bus stop to the airport, metro and metrobus in just 5 minutes on foot. In addition, the market, bank, hospital, pharmacy, restaurant, cafe and shopping malls are located on the same main street as the apartment. You can reach all of these just by walking.

reviews.text:
Ayse was a nice host. Her husband met us at the Airbnb after a late flight. The Airbnb was affordable and spacious for 4 people, and okay for what we needed.
Location was very accessible to public transport.
A few things worth mentioning:
1) WiFi is poor - there is no connection in the bedrooms.
2) The bathroom is slightly outdated. The shower unit is old and rusty, which isn’t pictured. 3) There was only 2 toilet rolls for a 10 day stay between 4 people, and when asked if the host could provide more, she said that I could buy it myself from the supermarket - even though toilet roll is listed in the amenities.

The place is in a convenient location, close to the subway and several cities.
In the summer the apartment is a bit stuffy as there is no air conditioning in it. And since you need to open the windows at night to let in fresh air, the noise from the street makes it difficult to sleep.
The rest of the apartment is good clean, the hostess is very polite and pleasant.
If you need a not too expensive apartment and spend one or two nights in Istanbul - this apartment will suit you.

The place is 5 minutes walk to metro and bus stations including Havaist bus from the airport. We are 4 people ( 2 couples) each couple had their own room. There is a full kitchen with full size refrigerator and stove.
Asya met us personally to give us the keys, she is a very sweet, beautiful and kind person and we were honored to meet her. The price was fair. The area is very alive, busy with shops and restaurants. The apartment is quiet on the 5th floor. There is NO street noise when you open the windows as wrongly mentioned in a previous review. There is an elevator. Good stay overall.

We had a wonderful stay at this host house. The location is excellent and very convenient. The rooms are spacious, warm, and very comfortable, with good heating throughout the house.
Everything was extremely clean and well maintained. There was plenty of space, and the overall atmosphere made us feel relaxed and at home.
Honestly, there are many good things to mention, but overall it was the best experience we’ve had.The host was very kind, welcoming, and always helpful throughout our stay.
I would highly recommend this place and would happily stay here again.

Asya Hanımla çok hızlı iletişim kurduk ve sorduğumuz her şey için güzelce cevap aldık. Ev temiz ve sevimli bir evdi. Rahat bir konaklama oldu bizim için. Muhit kalabalık bir muhit aslında, gece de gündüzde kalabalık ama ev yüksekte olduğu için çok etkilenmiyorsunuz. Park yeri bulmakta çok zorlandım sadece oda zaten İstanbul’un genel problemi. Evin hemen karşısında migros var, biraz aşağıda bir merkez var yemek, ve ihtiyaçlarınız için merkez gibi. Ayrıca metro ve metrobüs durağına çok yakın ve bizim için çok kolaylık oldu. İstanbulda kalacaklar için tavsiye ederim.

description:
Historical, elegant and modern. The location is super, near iconic Galata Tower like 1 min by walk.

The loft has its own glass sliding doors opening to the private big terrace with an amazing view. This is a very special loft apartment on the 5th floor.

We have several apartments in the building. Just ask availability for your groups.

reviews.text:
Ah, the terrace apartment—our roost for five memorable nights!
Self-check-in and finding the location? no sweat.
Reaching the 5th floor? Okay, maybe some sweat 😅.
Once we were up there and out of breath, the shimmering views of Haliç and Galata Tower reaching for the sky took our breaths away again 💙🌃
What we saw in the photos is what we got—a clean, cozy space with character.
the essentials already being there (from some coffee, tea to garbage bag, water, sponges, etc) were convenient as it allowed us to skip the hassle of a shopping trip.
added delights:
a family of kittens, cautious yet curious making visits to the balcony
squeaky wooden floors that whisper stories of the building`s history
✻ something to look into: a thorough cleaning for the subtle cat-related odor from some furniture pieces might enhance the comfort level for future guests.
We’ll treasure the memories, the views, and the charm of this time in Istanbul 🙏

Ozgur was a great host. We really enjoyed our stay in the in the airbnb. Any help required was promptly delivered. If you would like to have a memorable istanbul trip then definitely choose this place. The place was clean, it looks better than the photos and well looked after. The view is worth the climb up the stairs.

We had a very comfortable stay in Galata. Yes the walk up to the 5th floor is tough but you do get used to it. And the view is lovely. Very comfortable bed, and lots of space! Clean linens and comfortable sofa. The hob worked well, we didn’t test the oven. Nice big fridge and freezer. Basic equipment. Very helpful to have the water dispenser!!
Super cute cat with her little one came to the balcony at times, shy but curious.
We’ve taken away one star, as the shower was very weak, at times, maybe due to being at the top of the building, difficult as also a very hot bathroom (maybe next to the boiler or air con unit?).
The balcony could also do with some work, some of the wooden slats on the floor are broken, one entirely off. Which we didn’t feel was very safe.
Couldn’t have been happier with the hosts, very responsive, we had some issues with the WiFi and tv at one point and they fixed it all within a day which was very much appreciated.
Location couldn’t be better!!

First of all this is a wonderful place with excellent potential. Location, value, views, and host communication was all class. The other reviews mention it but just get ready to climb the spiral staircase up 5 floors to the apartment. After you get your bags up there it’s very manageable.
Our only grievance and the thing that took 2 stars off my overall rating was the quality of the mattress. Istanbul is a wonderful city with a lot to explore and a lot to walk. When you are retiring for the day and looking for some comfortable rest, it can’t be the springs of the mattress keeping you from restful sleep. My opinion only and I was surprised not to see any past reviews on this.

Fantastic Airbnb - I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Istanbul! The space was comfortable and the view is spectacular. The shower had surprisingly good/strong water pressure and I had the water temp was great. The area is very busy and the hills are steep - but all of that was worth it for the location to everything and views. Derya was a very communicative and responsive host. They also were very helpful and kind when I realized I had left my credit cards/personal things after checking out. They went to look for them in the apt right away and a friend of mine picked them up for me since I was already on my way to the airport.

description:
Some apartments are just a place to sleep... but in this one, you feel a family atmosphere, and from the very first moment, you say, "This is what we wanted." 🤍

We have designed our apartments to be places where you can gather with your family in complete privacy, around a coffee pot, a plate of dates, and a comfortable seating area that makes you forget the fatigue of the souk, as if to say: "Please, make yourself at home," to the extent that whenever someone says, "One last cup," the reply is: "Okay, this is the last one." 😉☕🫖🌴🪔

If this is your vibe, send a message to inquire and ask us about:
‼️Special Welcome Offer‼️🎁
We will understand that and will make you a special offer that suits you. God willing, we will respond to you directly within five minutes.

reviews.text: We had an amazing week-long stay at this apartment in Istanbul with a group of 12 people. The location was fantastic—very close to the metro, Cevahir Shopping Center, and Nişantaşı, with plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby. The apartment was spacious and clean, making it perfect for a large group. The host was incredibly welcoming and greeted us with snacks and some essentials, which made us feel right at home. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in Istanbul!

We had a lovely time in this huge apartment. The host was very helpfull from the first moment we arrived. Everything was clean and well maintained.
The area of the apartments location is full of shops and it's close to the subway station.
I recommend this location

We were very satisfied and happy with the place and hospitality provided by the care taker, Sarah and Omar. Both were very helpful, warm and accommodating to all of our request. Place is clean and spacious suitable for big family. Walking distance to shops, restaurants and metro station. Very recommended!

Sarah and her husband were amazing hosts. We had an awful experience with our previous Airbnb and it felt like they “saved us”. They were extremely helpful and even set up an extra internet router to increase bandwidth so my husband and I could both work. The location is convenient because the subway stop is very close and takes you into the touristy areas. The location also felt very safe - we walked around at night and there were no issues. I definitely recommend this apartment!

The Host Sarah was available all the time, and very responsive every time we had a question or needed sth, they provided it in very short time.
The location is very accessible and close to public transport.
Would definitely recommend it if you want to have a place for a big group.
Would visit again

description: This stylish place creates a fashionable background for your stay.

reviews.text: The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and communication with the host was smooth and friendly. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

We enjoyed 2 nights stay at this hotel and really enjoyed it. It’s a beautiful and spacious hotel and looks just like the photos. Good location with lots of resturants and shops nearby, also they allowed a flexible check-in which we really appreciated. I would say the only improvement they can make is by providing more amenities such as an iron.

The hotel was exactly as we expected — perfect. The service was great, the food and drinks were delicious and reasonably priced. Everything was very clean and beautifully designed. Highly recommended!

The location was great the staff are really friendly and helpful, room is was tidy and clean, the only thing I would knock a point of for is that All the rooms are smoke free and it leaves a lingering smell in the room and as a non smoker I wish some rooms were for non smokers, but lovely place and people overall ❤️

Konaklamamız harika geçti. Fotoğraflardaki gibi birebir aynısıydı. Girişte resepsiyonda ilgili ve sıcakkanlılardı. Biz çok memnun kaldık tekrar gideceğimiz yerler arasında. kendilerine buradan teşekkür ediyoruz. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edilebilir tamamıyla fiyat performans ürünü ve hakkıyla bunu veriyorlar, küçük bir mutfağı var orada istediğiniz şeyleri de yapabilirsiniz o kısımda düşünülmüş eşyalar var; tabak çatal vs gibi mikrodalga ve buzdolabının büyük olması da cabası istediğiniz pek çok şeyi mikrodalgada bile ısıtabilirsiniz. gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edilebilir bir lokasyonda.
